;;; $8000..807E: Data: initial animation tile pointers ;;;
{
;; Pointers (24-bit, bank $7E) to the first frame of the three scrolling tiles: $B480, $B498, $B4B0.
$04:8000              .db $80,$B4,$98,$B4,$B0,$B4     ; Initial animation tile frames: $7E:B480, $7E:B498, $7E:B4B0

$04:8006              .db $00,$B3,$18,$B3,$30,$B3,$48,$B3 ; Animated tile 0, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:800E              .db $60,$B3,$78,$B3,$90,$B3,$A8,$B3 ; Animated tile 0, frames 4-7: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:8016              .db $C0,$B3,$D8,$B3,$F0,$B3,$08,$B4 ; Animated tile 1, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:801E              .db $20,$B4,$38,$B4,$50,$B4,$68,$B4 ; Animated tile 1, frames 4-7: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:8026              .db $80,$B4,$98,$B4,$B0,$B4,$C8,$B4 ; Animated tile 2, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:802E              .db $E0,$B4,$F8,$B4,$10,$B5,$28,$B5 ; Animated tile 2, frames 4-7: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:8036              .db $40,$B5,$58,$B5,$70,$B5,$88,$B5 ; Animated tile 3, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:803E              .db $A0,$B5,$B8,$B5,$D0,$B5,$E8,$B5 ; Animated tile 3, frames 4-7: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:8046              .db $00,$B6,$18,$B6,$30,$B6,$48,$B6 ; Animated tile 4, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:804E              .db $60,$B6,$78,$B6,$90,$B6,$A8,$B6 ; Animated tile 4, frames 4-7: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:8056              .db $C0,$B6,$D8,$B6,$F0,$B6,$08,$B7 ; Animated tile 5, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:805E              .db $20,$B7,$38,$B7,$50,$B7,$68,$B7 ; Animated tile 5, frames 4-7: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:8066              .db $80,$B7,$98,$B7,$B0,$B7,$C8,$B7 ; Animated tile 6, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:806E              .db $E0,$B7,$F8,$B7,$10,$B8,$28,$B8 ; Animated tile 6, frames 4-7: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8
$04:8076              .db $40,$B8,$58,$B8,$70,$B8,$88,$B8 ; Animated tile 7, frames 0-3: pointers into $7E:B300-B8E8

;;; $8086: Load initial overworld animation tiles ;;;
{
;; Copies three animation tiles (via $80B9) into the buffer at $0AF6, slots 0-2, from $8000.
;; The buffer ($0160 bytes, 11 tiles) is DMAed to VRAM $0750 by NMI.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:8EEB: Overworld setup and process 0 (level exit)
$04:8086 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:8088 64 03        STZ $03                         ; [$03] = 0: index into $8000
$04:808A 64 05        STZ $05                         ; [$05] = 0: offset into the tile buffer at $0AF6
$04:808C A6 03        LDX $03                         ; \
$04:808E BD 00 80     LDA.W $8000,X                   ; } [$00] = pointer to the tile's first frame
$04:8091 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:8093 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; \
$04:8095 A0 7E        LDY.B #$7E                      ; } [$02] = $7E: bank of the 24-bit source pointer
$04:8097 84 02        STY $02                         ; /
$04:8099 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$04:809B A6 05        LDX $05                         ; X = destination offset in the $0AF6 buffer
$04:809D 20 B9 80     JSR.W $80B9                     ; Copy one 3bpp tile as a 4bpp tile
$04:80A0 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$04:80A2 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:80A3 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; } [$05] += $20: next tile slot
$04:80A6 85 05        STA $05                         ; /
$04:80A8 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$04:80AA 1A           INC A                           ; |
$04:80AB 1A           INC A                           ; } [$03] += 2: next pointer
$04:80AC 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$04:80AE 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; \
$04:80B1 C9 06 00     CMP.W #$0006                    ; } Loop for 3 tiles (pointer index != 6)
$04:80B4 D0 D6        BNE $808C                       ; /
$04:80B6 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:80B8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:80B9 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0: offset into the source tile
$04:80BC A9 08 00     LDA.W #$0008                    ; \
$04:80BF 85 07        STA $07                         ; } [$07] = [$09] = 8 (row counters)
$04:80C1 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$04:80C3 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; Load a word of bitplanes 0/1 (one row)
$04:80C5 9D F6 0A     STA.W $0AF6,X                   ; Store it in the buffer at $0AF6
$04:80C8 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:80C9 C8           INY                             ; |
$04:80CA E8           INX                             ; } Source and destination += 2
$04:80CB E8           INX                             ; /
$04:80CC C6 07        DEC $07                         ; \
$04:80CE D0 F3        BNE $80C3                       ; / Copy 8 words (16 bytes, bitplanes 0 and 1)
$04:80D0 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; Load a byte (one row of bitplane 2)
$04:80D2 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; Clear the high byte: bitplane 3 = 0
$04:80D5 9D F6 0A     STA.W $0AF6,X                   ; Store as a word (planes 2/3)
$04:80D8 C8           INY                             ; Source offset += 1
$04:80D9 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:80DA E8           INX                             ; / Destination += 2
$04:80DB C6 09        DEC $09                         ; \
$04:80DD D0 F1        BNE $80D0                       ; / Copy 8 rows (16 bytes, bitplanes 2 and 3)
$04:80DF 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $80E0: Animate overworld water tiles (OW_Tile_Animation) ;;;
{
;; Every 8 frames rotates the bits of animated tile 0 and tile 2 in the $0AF6 buffer, and scrolls tile 1 and 2
;;     vertically.
;; Then selects the current frame for eight further tiles from $8006 (8 frames each; the first two
;;     change every 16 frames, the others every 8) and copies them in.
;; Subroutines: $0480B9 copies a 24-byte 3bpp tile as 4bpp; $048172 scrolls a tile's rows by one.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:8267: Game mode 0E: overworld (GameMode_0E_Prim)
;;     $04:8EEE: Overworld setup and process 0 (level exit)
$04:80E0 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:80E2 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Skip the tile 0 animation unless [$13] is a multiple of 8
$04:80E4 D0 1B        BNE $8101                       ; /
$04:80E6 A2 1F        LDX.B #$1F                      ; X = $1F: last byte of tile 0 at $0AF6
$04:80E8 BD F6 0A     LDA.W $0AF6,X                   ; Read one byte of the tile
$04:80EB 85 00        STA $00                         ; Copy it to [$00] (carry source for the rotate)
$04:80ED 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:80EE 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; } Bytes with bit 3 of the index clear rotate left, others right
$04:80F0 D0 07        BNE $80F9                       ; /
$04:80F2 06 00        ASL $00                         ; \
$04:80F4 3E F6 0A     ROL.W $0AF6,X                   ; / Rotate the byte left by one bit
$04:80F7 80 05        BRA $80FE                       ; Skip the right rotate

$04:80F9 46 00        LSR $00                         ; \
$04:80FB 7E F6 0A     ROR.W $0AF6,X                   ; / Rotate the byte right by one bit
$04:80FE CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:80FF 10 E7        BPL $80E8                       ; / Next byte; loop for all 32 bytes
$04:8101 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:8103 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Skip tile 1 unless [$13] is a multiple of 8
$04:8105 D0 05        BNE $810C                       ; /
$04:8107 A2 20        LDX.B #$20                      ; X = $20: tile 1 at $0AF6+$20
$04:8109 20 72 81     JSR.W $8172                     ; Scroll the tile's rows by one
$04:810C A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:810E 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Skip tile 2 unless [$13] is a multiple of 8
$04:8110 D0 11        BNE $8123                       ; /
$04:8112 A2 1F        LDX.B #$1F                      ; X = $1F: last byte of tile 2 at $0B36
$04:8114 BD 36 0B     LDA.W $0B36,X                   ; Read one byte of tile 2
$04:8117 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:8118 3E 36 0B     ROL.W $0B36,X                   ; / Rotate the byte left by one bit
$04:811B CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:811C 10 F6        BPL $8114                       ; / Next byte; loop for all 32 bytes
$04:811E A2 40        LDX.B #$40                      ; X = $40: tile 2
$04:8120 20 72 81     JSR.W $8172                     ; Scroll the tile's rows by one
$04:8123 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:8125 A9 60 00     LDA.W #$0060                    ; \
$04:8128 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; / [$0D] = $60: destination offset of tile 3 in the $0AF6 buffer
$04:812A 64 0B        STZ $0B                         ; [$0B] = 0: pointer table offset (16 bytes per tile)
$04:812C A2 38 00     LDX.W #$0038                    ; X = $38: frame counter mask (8 frames, changes every 8 frames)
$04:812F A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$04:8131 C9 20 00     CMP.W #$0020                    ; } Tiles 3-4 (first two) use the slower mask
$04:8134 B0 03        BCS $8139                       ; /
$04:8136 A2 70 00     LDX.W #$0070                    ; X = $70: mask for 8 frames changing every 16 frames
$04:8139 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:813A 25 13        AND RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$04:813C 4A           LSR                             ; } A = (frame counter AND mask) as a word index 0-14
$04:813D 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:813E E0 38 00     CPX.W #$0038                    ; \
$04:8141 F0 01        BEQ $8144                       ; } Shift once more for the $70 mask so both give the same range
$04:8143 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:8144 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:8145 65 0B        ADC $0B                         ; } X = [$0B] + frame offset: index into $8006
$04:8147 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8148 BD 06 80     LDA.W $8006,X                   ; \
$04:814B 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = pointer to the current frame of this tile
$04:814D E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; \
$04:814F A0 7E        LDY.B #$7E                      ; } [$02] = $7E: bank of the source pointer
$04:8151 84 02        STY $02                         ; /
$04:8153 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$04:8155 A6 0D        LDX $0D                         ; X = destination offset
$04:8157 20 B9 80     JSR.W $80B9                     ; Copy the tile into the buffer
$04:815A A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; \
$04:815C 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:815D 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; } [$0D] += $20: next destination tile
$04:8160 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; /
$04:8162 A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$04:8164 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:8165 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; } [$0B] += $10: next tile's pointer row
$04:8168 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; /
$04:816A C9 80 00     CMP.W #$0080                    ; \
$04:816D D0 BD        BNE $812C                       ; / Loop for 8 tiles
$04:816F E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:8171 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:8172 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:8174 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: rows done
$04:8176 DA           PHX                             ; Save the start of this 8-row half
$04:8177 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8178 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:8179 69 0E 00     ADC.W #$000E                    ; } X += $0E: last row of the half
$04:817C AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:817D BD F6 0A     LDA.W $0AF6,X                   ; \
$04:8180 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = last row (wraps to the top)
$04:8182 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X to the first row
$04:8183 BD F6 0A     LDA.W $0AF6,X                   ; \
$04:8186 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = this row
$04:8188 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:818A 9D F6 0A     STA.W $0AF6,X                   ; / Row = previous row (shifted down by one)
$04:818D A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:818F 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Carry this row to the next
$04:8191 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:8192 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2: next row
$04:8193 C8           INY                             ; Rows done++
$04:8194 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; \
$04:8196 F0 DE        BEQ $8176                       ; / After 8 rows, start the second half (planes 2/3)
$04:8198 C0 10        CPY.B #$10                      ; \
$04:819A D0 E7        BNE $8183                       ; / Loop until 16 rows are done
$04:819C E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:819E 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $819F..81DF: Stripe image: overworld scroll arrows ;;;
{
;; Stripe image 15 (see ImagePointers): draws the look-around arrows with BG3 tilemap records at VRAM $50CF...
$04:819F              .db $50,$CF,$00,$03,$7E,$78,$7E,$38 ; Arrow 0: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81A7              .db $50,$EF,$00,$03,$7F,$38,$7F,$78 ; Arrow 1: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81AF              .db $51,$C3,$00,$03,$7E,$78,$7D,$78 ; Arrow 2: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81B7              .db $51,$E3,$00,$03,$7E,$F8,$7D,$F8 ; Arrow 3: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81BF              .db $51,$DB,$00,$03,$7D,$38,$7E,$38 ; Arrow 4: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81C7              .db $51,$FB,$00,$03,$7D,$B8,$7E,$B8 ; Arrow 5: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81CF              .db $52,$EF,$00,$03,$7F,$B8,$7F,$F8 ; Arrow 6: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81D7              .db $53,$0F,$00,$03,$7E,$F8,$7E,$B8 ; Arrow 7: VRAM address, 2 tiles ($0003 = 4 bytes), tile+attribute words
$04:81DF              .db $FF                         ; End of image

}

;;; $81E0..8210: Stripe image: remove scroll arrows ;;;
{
;; Stripe image 18: fills the arrow positions with the blank tile $FC.
$04:81E0              .db $50,$CF,$40,$02,$FC,$00,$50,$EF ; Records: VRAM address, RLE ($4002 = 3 tiles), tile $FC, attr $00
$04:81E8              .db $40,$02,$FC,$00,$51,$C3,$40,$02
$04:81F0              .db $FC,$00,$51,$E3,$40,$02,$FC,$00
$04:81F8              .db $51,$DB,$40,$02,$FC,$00,$51,$FB
$04:8200              .db $40,$02,$FC,$00,$52,$EF,$40,$02
$04:8208              .db $FC,$00,$53,$0F,$40,$02,$FC,$00
$04:8210              .db $FF                         ; End of image

}

;;; $8211..8219: Table: look-around scroll step ;;;
{
;; Words indexed by (d-pad bits * 2); 0, +2, -2, +2 for X (first row) and again for Y (second row, indices
;;     8-14).
$04:8211              .db $00,$00,$02,$00,$FE,$FF,$02,$00 ; Scroll step X: none, +2, -2, +2
$04:8219              .db $00,$00,$02,$00,$FE,$FF,$02,$00 ; Scroll step Y: none, +2, -2, +2
}

;;; $8221..8229: Table: look-around scroll limits ;;;
{
;; Words: scroll limits per direction. X: $0111 / -$11. Y: $0132 / -$29.
$04:8221              .db $00,$00,$11,$01,$EF,$FF,$11,$01 ; Limit X: -, $0111, -$11, $0111
$04:8229              .db $00,$00,$32,$01,$D7,$FF,$32,$01 ; Limit Y: -, $0132, -$29, $0132
}

;;; $8231..8239: Table: ground shake masks ;;;
{
;; AND masks with the frame counter, indexed by [$1BA0] >> 4; smaller mask = more frequent shaking.
$04:8231              .db $0F,$0F,$07,$07,$07,$03,$03,$03 ; Shake masks for [$1BA0] >> 4 = 0-7 (more shaking at higher values)
$04:8239              .db $01,$01,$03,$03,$03,$07,$07,$07 ; Shake masks for [$1BA0] >> 4 = 8-15

}

;;; $8241: Game mode 0E: overworld (GameMode_0E_Prim) ;;;
{
;; Runs every frame in the overworld. Positions Mario, animates tiles, then runs one of: switch blocks flying
;;     away, Continue/End message, player switch,
;; look-around scrolling (Start on the main map) or the Bowser's valley reveal shake, otherwise the overworld
;;     process for [$13D9] via $8576.
;; [$13D4]: 0 = normal, odd = looking around, >= 2 = returning the screen to the saved position ([$1DF0],
;;     [$1DF2]).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:A1C7: Clear RAM; game mode 0E: overworld (Clear_1A_13D3)
$04:8241 8B           PHB                             ; \
$04:8242 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($04)
$04:8243 AB           PLB                             ; /
$04:8244 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: loop over both players
$04:8246 BD A6 0D     LDA.W RAM_OWControllerA,X       ; Read the player's overworld controller
$04:8249 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; Select button pressed?
$04:824B 80 14        BRA $8261                       ; Always branch: the debug code below is disabled

$04:824D BD BA 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlyrYoshiColor,X      ; \
$04:8250 1A           INC A                           ; |
$04:8251 1A           INC A                           ; |
$04:8252 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; |
$04:8254 B0 02        BCS $8258                       ; |
$04:8256 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; |
$04:8258 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; |
$04:825A 90 02        BCC $825E                       ; |
$04:825C A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; } Unused debug code: cycle the Yoshi color on Select (colors 4-$0A, else 0)
$04:825E 9D BA 0D     STA.W RAM_PlyrYoshiColor,X      ; /
$04:8261 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:8262 10 E2        BPL $8246                       ; / Next player
$04:8264 20 A7 85     JSR.W $85A7                     ; Position Mario on the border and run its code
$04:8267 20 E0 80     JSR.W OW_Tile_Animation         ; Animate the overworld water/waterfall tiles
$04:826A AD D2 13     LDA.W $13D2                     ; \
$04:826D F0 06        BEQ $8275                       ; / [$13D2] = 0: no switch-block flying away animation
$04:826F 20 90 F2     JSR.W $F290                     ; Run the switch palace blocks flying away animation
$04:8272 4C 0D 84     JMP.W $840D                     ; Finish the frame

$04:8275 AD C9 13     LDA.W $13C9                     ; \
$04:8278 F0 07        BEQ $8281                       ; / [$13C9] = 0: no Continue/End message
$04:827A 22 80 9B 00  JSL.L $9B80                     ; Run the Continue/End message
$04:827E 4C 10 84     JMP.W $8410                     ; Finish (skip border drawing call)

$04:8281 AD 87 1B     LDA.W $1B87                     ; \
$04:8284 F0 0F        BEQ $8295                       ; / [$1B87] = 0: no player switch in progress
$04:8286 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$04:8288 B0 05        BCS $828F                       ; / [$1B87] >= 5: run it regardless
$04:828A AC B2 0D     LDY.W $0DB2                     ; \
$04:828D F0 06        BEQ $8295                       ; / [$0DB2] = 0 (one player): ignore the switch
$04:828F 20 E5 F3     JSR.W $F3E5                     ; Run the player switch animation
$04:8292 4C 13 84     JMP.W $8413                     ; Exit

$04:8295 AD D4 13     LDA.W $13D4                     ; \
$04:8298 4A           LSR                             ; } Look-around mode ([$13D4] >> 1) active? (first press = 1 is not)
$04:8299 D0 03        BNE $829E                       ; /
$04:829B 4C 56 83     JMP.W $8356                     ; Not returning: go handle normal input

$04:829E C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:82A0 AD F2 1D     LDA.W $1DF2                     ; \
$04:82A3 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:82A4 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } [$01] = saved Y scroll [$1DF2] - current Y scroll
$04:82A6 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$04:82A8 10 04        BPL $82AE                       ; \
$04:82AA 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; |
$04:82AD 1A           INC A                           ; } A = |delta Y| / 2
$04:82AE 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:82AF E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:82B1 85 05        STA $05                         ; [$05] = |delta Y| / 2
$04:82B3 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:82B5 AD F0 1D     LDA.W $1DF0                     ; \
$04:82B8 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:82B9 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } [$00] = saved X scroll [$1DF0] - current X scroll
$04:82BB 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:82BD 10 04        BPL $82C3                       ; \
$04:82BF 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; |
$04:82C2 1A           INC A                           ; } A = |delta X| / 2
$04:82C3 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:82C4 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:82C6 85 04        STA $04                         ; [$04] = |delta X| / 2
$04:82C8 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; \
$04:82CA C5 05        CMP $05                         ; } X = 1 if X distance >= Y distance (A = larger distance)
$04:82CC B0 03        BCS $82D1                       ; /
$04:82CE CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:82CF A5 05        LDA $05                         ; / Else X = 0, A = Y distance
$04:82D1 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; \
$04:82D3 B0 18        BCS $82ED                       ; / Distance < 2: close enough, snap back to the saved position
$04:82D5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:82D7 AD F0 1D     LDA.W $1DF0                     ; \
$04:82DA 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } Screen X = saved X scroll (and BG2 mirror [$1E])
$04:82DC 85 1E        STA $1E                         ; /
$04:82DE AD F2 1D     LDA.W $1DF2                     ; \
$04:82E1 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Screen Y = saved Y scroll (and BG2 mirror [$20])
$04:82E3 85 20        STA $20                         ; /
$04:82E5 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:82E7 9C D4 13     STZ.W $13D4                     ; [$13D4] = 0: leave look-around mode
$04:82EA 4C BD 83     JMP.W $83BD                     ; Remove the scroll arrows ($12 = $18) and finish

$04:82ED 9C 04 42     STZ.W $4204                     ; \
$04:82F0 B4 04        LDY $04,X                       ; |
$04:82F2 8C 05 42     STY.W $4205                     ; } Divide: [smaller distance] * 256 / [larger distance]
$04:82F5 8D 06 42     STA.W $4206                     ; /
$04:82F8 EA           NOP                             ; \
$04:82F9 EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:82FA EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:82FB EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:82FC EA           NOP                             ; } Wait for the hardware division to finish
$04:82FD EA           NOP                             ; /
$04:82FE C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:8300 AD 14 42     LDA.W $4214                     ; |
$04:8303 4A           LSR                             ; } A = quotient / 4: speed of the shorter axis (max $40)
$04:8304 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:8305 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:8307 B4 01        LDY $01,X                       ; \
$04:8309 10 03        BPL $830E                       ; |
$04:830B 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } Apply the sign of that axis' delta
$04:830D 1A           INC A                           ; /
$04:830E 95 01        STA $01,X                       ; Store the speed of the shorter axis in [$01,X]
$04:8310 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8311 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } X ^= 1: the other (longer) axis
$04:8313 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8314 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$04:8316 B4 01        LDY $01,X                       ; |
$04:8318 10 02        BPL $831C                       ; } Longer axis speed = +$40 or -$40 by sign of its delta
$04:831A A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; /
$04:831C 95 01        STA $01,X                       ; Store the speed in [$01,X]
$04:831E A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: loop over Y axis then X axis
$04:8320 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:8321 0A           ASL                             ; } X = Y * 2 (index into screen scroll words)
$04:8322 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8323 B9 01 00     LDA.W $0001,Y                   ; \
$04:8326 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8327 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8328 0A           ASL                             ; } A = speed * 16: fractional part
$04:8329 0A           ASL                             ; /
$04:832A 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:832B 79 7C 1B     ADC.W $1B7C,Y                   ; } Add to fraction accumulator [$1B7C+Y], carry = pixel step
$04:832E 99 7C 1B     STA.W $1B7C,Y                   ; /
$04:8331 B9 01 00     LDA.W $0001,Y                   ; A = speed
$04:8334 5A           PHY                             ; \
$04:8335 08           PHP                             ; / Save Y and the carry flag
$04:8336 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:8337 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8338 4A           LSR                             ; } A = speed >> 4: whole pixels
$04:8339 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:833A A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte of the move
$04:833C 28           PLP                             ; \
$04:833D 10 03        BPL $8342                       ; |
$04:833F 09 F0        ORA.B #$F0                      ; } Sign-extend negative speeds (high byte = $FF)
$04:8341 88           DEY                             ; /
$04:8342 75 1A        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,X        ; \
$04:8344 95 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,X        ; } Screen X/Y position low += pixels + carry (and BG2 mirror)
$04:8346 95 1E        STA $1E,X                       ; /
$04:8348 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:8349 75 1B        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi,X        ; |
$04:834B 95 1B        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi,X        ; } Screen position high byte += sign extension + carry (and mirror)
$04:834D 95 1F        STA $1F,X                       ; /
$04:834F 7A           PLY                             ; \
$04:8350 88           DEY                             ; } Next axis
$04:8351 10 CD        BPL $8320                       ; /
$04:8353 4C 0D 84     JMP.W $840D                     ; Finish the frame

$04:8356 AD D9 13     LDA.W $13D9                     ; \
$04:8359 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; } [$13D9] = 3: player idle, accept input
$04:835B F0 09        BEQ $8366                       ; /
$04:835D C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; \
$04:835F D0 39        BNE $839A                       ; / [$13D9] = 4: only when [$0DD8] = 0
$04:8361 AD D8 0D     LDA.W $0DD8                     ; [$0DD8] != 0: ignore input
$04:8364 D0 34        BNE $839A
$04:8366 AD A8 0D     LDA.W $0DA8                     ; \
$04:8369 0D A9 0D     ORA.W $0DA9                     ; |
$04:836C 29 30        AND.B #$30                      ; } L or R pressed (both controllers)?
$04:836E F0 05        BEQ $8375                       ; /
$04:8370 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$04:8372 8D 87 1B     STA.W $1B87                     ; / [$1B87] = 1: start the player switch
$04:8375 AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; X = current player
$04:8378 BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:837B D0 1D        BNE $839A                       ; / Not on the main map (submap non-zero): no look-around
$04:837D A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$04:837F 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Start button pressed?
$04:8381 F0 17        BEQ $839A                       ; /
$04:8383 EE D4 13     INC.W $13D4                     ; [$13D4]++: toggle look-around mode
$04:8386 AD D4 13     LDA.W $13D4                     ; \
$04:8389 4A           LSR                             ; } Not the first press (already looking, now leaving)? skip saving
$04:838A D0 0E        BNE $839A                       ; /
$04:838C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:838E A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$04:8390 8D F0 1D     STA.W $1DF0                     ; / Save current X scroll in [$1DF0]
$04:8393 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$04:8395 8D F2 1D     STA.W $1DF2                     ; / Save current Y scroll in [$1DF2]
$04:8398 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:839A AD D4 13     LDA.W $13D4                     ; \
$04:839D F0 24        BEQ $83C3                       ; / Not looking around: go handle other events
$04:839F A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: horizontal axis
$04:83A1 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$04:83A3 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } A = left/right bits * 2: table index
$04:83A5 0A           ASL                             ; /
$04:83A6 20 15 84     JSR.W $8415                     ; Scroll the screen horizontally
$04:83A9 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: vertical axis
$04:83AB A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$04:83AD 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; |
$04:83AF 09 10        ORA.B #$10                      ; } A = (up/down bits | $10) / 2: table index 8-14
$04:83B1 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:83B2 20 15 84     JSR.W $8415                     ; Scroll the screen vertically
$04:83B5 A0 15        LDY.B #$15                      ; Y = $15: image 'draw scroll arrows'
$04:83B7 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:83B9 29 18        AND.B #$18                      ; } Blink: every 8th frame of 32
$04:83BB D0 02        BNE $83BF                       ; /
$04:83BD A0 18        LDY.B #$18                      ; Y = $18: image 'remove scroll arrows'
$04:83BF 84 12        STY $12                         ; Request the arrows stripe image
$04:83C1 80 4A        BRA $840D                       ; Finish the frame

$04:83C3 AE A0 1B     LDX.W $1BA0                     ; \
$04:83C6 F0 42        BEQ $840A                       ; / [$1BA0] = 0: no ground shake, run the overworld process
$04:83C8 E0 FE        CPX.B #$FE                      ; \
$04:83CA D0 0A        BNE $83D6                       ; / [$1BA0] = $FE: first frame of the Bowser's valley reveal
$04:83CC A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; \
$04:83CE 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $21
$04:83D1 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$04:83D3 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Request music $08 (probably the Bowser's valley reveal)
$04:83D6 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:83D7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:83D8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:83D9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:83DA 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = [$1BA0] >> 4
$04:83DB A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:83DC A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:83DE 39 31 82     AND.W $8231,Y                   ; } Shake only on frames where [$13] AND mask is 0
$04:83E1 D0 10        BNE $83F3                       ; /
$04:83E3 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$04:83E5 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$04:83E7 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } Toggle bit 0 of screen X (and BG2 mirror)
$04:83E9 85 1E        STA $1E                         ; /
$04:83EB A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$04:83ED 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$04:83EF 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Toggle bit 0 of screen Y (and BG2 mirror)
$04:83F1 85 20        STA $20                         ; /
$04:83F3 E0 80        CPX.B #$80                      ; \
$04:83F5 B0 07        BCS $83FE                       ; / [$1BA0] >= $80: count down regardless
$04:83F7 AD D9 13     LDA.W $13D9                     ; \
$04:83FA C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Below $80: only count down when [$13D9] = 2, else process
$04:83FC D0 0C        BNE $840A                       ; /
$04:83FE CE A0 1B     DEC.W $1BA0                     ; \
$04:8401 D0 0A        BNE $840D                       ; / [$1BA0]--; still running: finish the frame
$04:8403 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$04:8405 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Timer ended: play sound effect $22
$04:8408 80 03        BRA $840D                       ; Finish the frame

$04:840A 20 76 85     JSR.W $8576                     ; Run the overworld process for [$13D9]
$04:840D 20 08 F7     JSR.W $F708                     ; Run the overworld sprites/animation code (probably)
$04:8410 20 2E 86     JSR.W $862E                     ; Draw/update the overworld border (probably)
$04:8413 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$04:8414 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$04:8415 A8           TAY                             ; Y = table index
$04:8416 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:8418 B5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,X        ; A = current screen position [$1A,X]
$04:841A 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:841B 79 11 82     ADC.W $8211,Y                   ; / + step from $8211
$04:841E 48           PHA                             ; Save the new position
$04:841F 38           SEC                             ; \
$04:8420 F9 21 82     SBC.W $8221,Y                   ; / - limit from $8221
$04:8423 59 11 82     EOR.W $8211,Y                   ; \
$04:8426 0A           ASL                             ; / Carry = sign of (new - limit) differs from sign of step
$04:8427 68           PLA                             ; Restore the new position
$04:8428 90 04        BCC $842E                       ; \
$04:842A 95 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,X        ; } Within the limit: store the scroll position (and BG2 mirror)
$04:842C 95 1E        STA $1E,X                       ; /
$04:842E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:8430 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8431..8461: Table: warp tile X positions ;;;
{

$04:8431              .db $11,$00,$0A,$00,$09,$00,$0B,$00 ; Warp tile X (bits 0-8), submap in high byte: warps 0-3

$04:8441              .db $03,$02,$10,$04,$12,$04,$1C,$04 ; Warp tile X (bits 0-8), submap in high byte: warps 8-11
$04:8449              .db $14,$04,$12,$06,$00,$02,$12,$06 ; Warp tile X (bits 0-8), submap in high byte: warps 12-15
$04:8451              .db $10,$00,$17,$06,$14,$00,$1C,$06 ; Warp tile X (bits 0-8), submap in high byte: warps 16-19

;;; $84D3..8503: Table: warp destination Y positions ;;;
{
;; 27 words: Y pixel position after the warp.
$04:84D3              .db $48,$01,$B8,$00,$38,$00,$18,$00 ; Destination Y pixel: warps 0-3
$04:84DB              .db $98,$00,$98,$00,$D8,$01,$78,$00 ; Destination Y pixel: warps 4-7
$04:84E3              .db $38,$00,$08,$01,$E8,$00,$78,$01 ; Destination Y pixel: warps 8-11
$04:84EB              .db $88,$01,$28,$01,$88,$01,$E8,$00 ; Destination Y pixel: warps 12-15
$04:84F3              .db $68,$01,$F8,$00,$88,$01,$08,$01 ; Destination Y pixel: warps 16-19
$04:84FB              .db $D8,$01,$38,$00,$38,$01,$88,$01 ; Destination Y pixel: warps 20-23
$04:8503              .db $78,$00,$D8,$01,$D8,$01     ; Destination Y: warps 24-26

}

;;; $8509: Find warp and run overworld process ;;;
{
;; $048509: finds the warp tile under the player (tables at $8431). Returns: [$1DF6] = index * 2, or
;;     negative if none.
;; $04853B (RTL): moves the player to the destination of warp [$1DF6].
;; $048576: runs overworld process [$13D9] through PtrsLong04857D.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:9165: Overworld: button pressed on a tile (OWPU_ABXY)
;;     $04:9188: Overworld: enter pipe (OWPU_IsOnPipe)
$04:8509 AC B3 0D     LDY.W $0DB3                     ; \
$04:850C B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; } [$01] = player's submap (high byte of the compare value)
$04:850F 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$04:8511 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0
$04:8513 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:8515 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = current character * 4 (player position slot)
$04:8518 A0 34        LDY.B #$34                      ; Y = $34: last warp index * 2 (27 entries)
$04:851A B9 31 84     LDA.W $8431,Y                   ; \
$04:851D 45 00        EOR $00                         ; / A = warp X tile EOR (submap << 8)
$04:851F C9 00 02     CMP.W #$0200                    ; \
$04:8522 B0 0D        BCS $8531                       ; / Skip if the submap differs (result >= $200)
$04:8524 DD 1F 1F     CMP.W $1F1F,X                   ; \
$04:8527 D0 08        BNE $8531                       ; / Warp X tile != player's X tile [$1F1F]: next
$04:8529 BD 21 1F     LDA.W $1F21,X                   ; \
$04:852C D9 67 84     CMP.W $8467,Y                   ; } Warp Y tile == player's Y tile [$1F21]: found
$04:852F F0 04        BEQ $8535                       ; /
$04:8531 88           DEY                             ; \
$04:8532 88           DEY                             ; } Next warp; loop until Y < 0
$04:8533 10 E5        BPL $851A                       ; /
$04:8535 8C F6 1D     STY.W $1DF6                     ; [$1DF6] = warp index * 2 (negative if none)
$04:8538 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:853A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:853B 8B           PHB                             ; \
$04:853C 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($04)
$04:853D AB           PLB                             ; /
$04:853E C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:8540 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = current character * 4
$04:8543 AC F6 1D     LDY.W $1DF6                     ; Y = [$1DF6]: warp index * 2
$04:8546 B9 9D 84     LDA.W $849D,Y                   ; A = destination X word
$04:8549 48           PHA                             ; Save it for the submap bits
$04:854A 29 FF 01     AND.W #$01FF                    ; \
$04:854D 9D 17 1F     STA.W $1F17,X                   ; / Player X position = destination X (low 9 bits)
$04:8550 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:8551 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8552 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8553 4A           LSR                             ; } Player X tile = X / 16
$04:8554 9D 1F 1F     STA.W $1F1F,X                   ; /
$04:8557 B9 D3 84     LDA.W $84D3,Y                   ; \
$04:855A 9D 19 1F     STA.W $1F19,X                   ; / Player Y position = destination Y
$04:855D 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:855E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:855F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8560 4A           LSR                             ; } Player Y tile = Y / 16
$04:8561 9D 21 1F     STA.W $1F21,X                   ; /
$04:8564 68           PLA                             ; Restore the destination word
$04:8565 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:8566 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:8567 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; } [$13C3] = bits 9-12 (probably the destination submap)
$04:856A 8D C3 13     STA.W $13C3                     ; /
$04:856D C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$04:856F 20 93 9A     JSR.W $9A93                     ; Reload position-related data for the new location ($9A93)
$04:8572 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:8574 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$04:8575 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$04:8576 AD D9 13     LDA.W $13D9                     ; A = [$13D9]: overworld process number
$04:8579 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; Jump to the routine from PtrsLong04857D

}

;;; $857D: Pointer table: overworld processes (PtrsLong04857D) ;;;
{
;; 13 long pointers indexed by [$13D9]. The JSR at $0485A4 after the table starts the border code.
$04:857D F1 8E 04     .dw $8EF1 .db :$CODE_048EF1     ; Process 00: $8EF1
$04:8580 70 E5 04     .dw $E570 .db :$CODE_04E570     ; Process 01: $E570
$04:8583 87 8F 04     .dw $8F87 .db :$CODE_048F87     ; Process 02: $8F87
$04:8586 20 91 04     .dw $9120 .db :$CODE_049120     ; Process 03: $9120
$04:8589 5D 94 04     .dw $945D .db :$CODE_04945D     ; Process 04: $945D
$04:858C 9A 9D 04     .dw $9D9A .db :$CODE_049D9A     ; Process 05: $9D9A
$04:858F 22 9E 04     .dw $9E22 .db :$CODE_049E22     ; Process 06: $9E22
$04:8592 D1 9D 04     .dw $9DD1 .db :$CODE_049DD1     ; Process 07: $9DD1
$04:8595 22 9E 04     .dw $9E22 .db :$CODE_049E22     ; Process 08: $9E22
$04:8598 4C 9E 04     .dw $9E4C .db :$CODE_049E4C     ; Process 09: $9E4C
$04:859B EF DA 04     .dw $DAEF .db :$CODE_04DAEF     ; Process 0A: $DAEF
$04:859E 52 9E 04     .dw $9E52 .db :$CODE_049E52     ; Process 0B: $9E52
$04:85A1 C6 98 04     .dw $98C6 .db :$CODE_0498C6     ; Process 0C: $98C6

}

;;; $85A4: Draw border icon and player map sprites (DrawOWBoarder?) ;;;
{
;; Per-frame overworld sprite drawing. First computes both players' screen positions ($862E), then draws
;;     Mario's regular
;; sprite at a fixed spot in the border (probably the player icon) plus a 4x4 block of 8x8 tiles ($7E,
;;     property $36) at (24,7),
;; probably its backdrop. The Mario routine is the level one ($E2BD).
;; $04862E: hides off-screen players (Y = $F0), applies the sprite offsets (-8, -9; walking poses 5 pixels
;;     higher than swimming
;; ones), draws the current player and, in a two player game on the same submap, the other one with
;;     $894F, and clears their
;; OAM size bits. $048789: if the player's lives are negative (out of lives), draws a 2-tile marker above the
;;     map sprite.
;; Parameters of $048789: X = OAM offset (0 or $20), [$04] = palette offset, [$8A]/[$8B] = sprite position.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:8EE8: Overworld setup and process 0 (level exit)
$04:85A4 20 2E 86     JSR.W $862E                     ; Compute screen positions and draw both players' map sprites ($862E)
$04:85A7 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:85A9 A9 1E 00     LDA.W #$001E                    ; \
$04:85AC 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:85AD 65 1A        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } Mario X = screen X + $1E (fixed spot in the border)
$04:85AF 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$04:85B1 A9 06 00     LDA.W #$0006                    ; \
$04:85B4 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:85B5 65 1C        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Mario Y = screen Y + 6
$04:85B7 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$04:85B9 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:85BB A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$04:85BD 8D 7B 00     STA.W RAM_MarioSpeedX           ; / Mario X speed = 8 (probably sets the walk animation rate)
$04:85C0 8B           PHB                             ; \
$04:85C1 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$04:85C3 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $00 (old bank saved)
$04:85C4 AB           PLB                             ; /
$04:85C5 22 B1 CE 00  JSL.L $CEB1                     ; Update Mario's pose/cape animation ($CEB1)
$04:85C9 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$04:85CA A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$04:85CC 8D F9 13     STA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; / [$13F9] = 3: Mario sprite priority flags (probably so he draws over the border)
$04:85CF 22 BD E2 00  JSL.L $E2BD                     ; Draw Mario's sprite at that spot ($E2BD)
$04:85D3 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$04:85D5 8D 84 0D     STA.W $0D84                     ; / [$0D84] = 6: Mario GFX DMA segment count (probably)
$04:85D8 AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$04:85DB F0 03        BEQ $85E0                       ; } Count down the Mario animation timer [$1496] if non-zero
$04:85DD CE 96 14     DEC.W $1496                     ; /
$04:85E0 AD A2 14     LDA.W $14A2                     ; \
$04:85E3 F0 03        BEQ $85E8                       ; } Count down [$14A2] (cape animation timer) if non-zero
$04:85E5 CE A2 14     DEC.W $14A2                     ; /
$04:85E8 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$04:85EA 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $18: X of the first backdrop tile
$04:85EC A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$04:85EE 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = $07: Y of the first backdrop tile
$04:85F0 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: tile counter (16 tiles in a 4x4 block)
$04:85F2 BB           TYX                             ; X = 0: OAM offset, starting at sprite slot 0
$04:85F3 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:85F5 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; / OAM X = [$00]
$04:85F8 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:85F9 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } [$00] += 8: next tile to the right
$04:85FB 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:85FD A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$04:85FF 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; / OAM Y = [$01]
$04:8602 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$04:8604 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; / OAM tile = $7E
$04:8607 A9 36        LDA.B #$36                      ; \
$04:8609 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; / OAM property = $36 (priority 3, palette 3)
$04:860C DA           PHX                             ; \
$04:860D BB           TYX                             ; |
$04:860E A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$04:8610 9D 20 04     STA.W $0420,X                   ; } Size/X-high entry [$0420+tile counter] = 0 (8x8, X < 256)
$04:8613 FA           PLX                             ; /
$04:8614 C8           INY                             ; Next tile
$04:8615 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:8616 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } If not at the end of a row of 4, skip the row advance
$04:8618 D0 0B        BNE $8625                       ; /
$04:861A A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$04:861C 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $18: X back to the left edge
$04:861E A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$04:8620 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:8621 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } [$01] += 8: next row down
$04:8623 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$04:8625 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:8626 E8           INX                             ; |
$04:8627 E8           INX                             ; } X += 4: next OAM slot
$04:8628 E8           INX                             ; /
$04:8629 C0 10        CPY.B #$10                      ; \
$04:862B D0 C6        BNE $85F3                       ; / Loop for all 16 tiles
$04:862D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:862E C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:8630 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:8633 BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; / A = current player's map X ([$1F17], X = [$0DD6]: 0 Mario, 4 Luigi)
$04:8636 38           SEC                             ; \
$04:8637 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; / A = map X - screen X
$04:8639 C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; \
$04:863C B0 0F        BCS $864D                       ; / If >= $100 (off-screen), go hide the sprite at $04864D
$04:863E 85 00        STA $00                         ; \
$04:8640 85 08        STA $08                         ; / Store the screen X in [$00] and [$08]
$04:8642 BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:8645 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:8646 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$04:8648 C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; } A = map Y - screen Y; if >= $100 go hide it, else keep it
$04:864B 90 03        BCC $8650                       ; /
$04:864D A9 F0 00     LDA.W #$00F0                    ; Off-screen: Y = $F0 (hides the sprite)
$04:8650 85 02        STA $02                         ; \
$04:8652 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / Store the screen Y in [$02] and [$0A]
$04:8654 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8655 49 04 00     EOR.W #$0004                    ; } X = other player's index (0 <-> 4)
$04:8658 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8659 BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; \
$04:865C 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:865D E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$04:865F C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; } A = other player's screen X; if >= $100 go hide it at $048673
$04:8662 B0 0F        BCS $8673                       ; /
$04:8664 85 04        STA $04                         ; \
$04:8666 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / Store the screen X in [$04] and [$0C]
$04:8668 BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:866B 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:866C E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$04:866E C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; } A = other player's screen Y; if >= $100 go hide it
$04:8671 90 03        BCC $8676                       ; /
$04:8673 A9 F0 00     LDA.W #$00F0                    ; Off-screen: Y = $F0
$04:8676 85 06        STA $06                         ; \
$04:8678 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / Store the screen Y in [$06] and [$0E]
$04:867A E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:867C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:867E 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:867F E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } [$00] = player sprite X = screen X - 8
$04:8681 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:8683 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:8685 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:8686 E9 09        SBC.B #$09                      ; } [$01] = player sprite Y = screen Y - 9
$04:8688 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$04:868A A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:868C 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:868D E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } [$02] = other player's sprite X = screen X - 8
$04:868F 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$04:8691 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; \
$04:8693 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:8694 E9 09        SBC.B #$09                      ; } [$03] = other player's sprite Y = screen Y - 9
$04:8696 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$04:8698 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$04:869A 85 8C        STA $8C                         ; / [$8C] = 3: tile counter for a 2x2 sprite
$04:869C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:869E 85 06        STA $06                         ; } [$06] and [$8A] = X of the first tile
$04:86A0 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; /
$04:86A2 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$04:86A4 85 07        STA $07                         ; } [$07] and [$8B] = Y of the first tile
$04:86A6 85 8B        STA $8B                         ; /
$04:86A8 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:86AB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:86AC A8           TAY                             ; } A = current player's pose ([$1F13] or [$1F15])
$04:86AD B9 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13,Y                   ; /
$04:86B0 C9 12        CMP.B #$12                      ; \
$04:86B2 F0 11        BEQ $86C5                       ; / Pose $12 (swimming): no Y shift, go to $0486C5
$04:86B4 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; \
$04:86B6 90 04        BCC $86BC                       ; / Pose < 7 (walking): go shift Y
$04:86B8 C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; \
$04:86BA 90 09        BCC $86C5                       ; / Poses 7-$0E (swimming): no Y shift, go to $0486C5
$04:86BC A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$04:86BE 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:86BF E9 05        SBC.B #$05                      ; |
$04:86C1 85 8B        STA $8B                         ; } Walking poses are drawn 5 pixels higher: [$8B] and [$07] -= 5
$04:86C3 85 07        STA $07                         ; /
$04:86C5 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:86C7 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:86CA EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:86CB 4A           LSR                             ; } [$04] = $0000 for Mario, $0200 for Luigi (+1 to the OAM palette)
$04:86CC 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$04:86CE A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0: OAM offset of the first player's sprites (slot 39)
$04:86D1 20 89 87     JSR.W $8789                     ; Draw the out-of-lives marker if needed ($8789)
$04:86D4 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:86D7 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = player index * 2 (pose table index)
$04:86D8 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:86D9 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0: OAM offset
$04:86DC 20 4F 89     JSR.W $894F                     ; Draw the player's map sprite ($894F)
$04:86DF E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:86E1 9C 47 04     STZ.W $0447                     ; \
$04:86E4 9C 48 04     STZ.W $0448                     ; |
$04:86E7 9C 49 04     STZ.W $0449                     ; |
$04:86EA 9C 4A 04     STZ.W $044A                     ; |
$04:86ED 9C 4B 04     STZ.W $044B                     ; |
$04:86F0 9C 4C 04     STZ.W $044C                     ; |
$04:86F3 9C 4D 04     STZ.W $044D                     ; } Size/X-high entries of OAM slots 39-46 = 0 (8x8, X < 256)
$04:86F6 9C 4E 04     STZ.W $044E                     ; /
$04:86F9 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$04:86FB 85 8C        STA $8C                         ; / [$8C] = 3: tile counter for a 2x2 sprite
$04:86FD AD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11                     ; A = Mario's submap [$1F11]
$04:8700 AC D9 13     LDY.W $13D9                     ; \
$04:8703 C0 0A        CPY.B #$0A                      ; } If OW process [$13D9] = $0A (player switch) do the next line
$04:8705 D0 02        BNE $8709                       ; /
$04:8707 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; Flip bit 0 of the submap (probably accounts for the player switch)
$04:8709 CD 12 1F     CMP.W $1F12                     ; \
$04:870C D0 78        BNE $8786                       ; / Draw the second player only if both are on the same submap
$04:870E A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:8710 85 06        STA $06                         ; } [$06] and [$8A] = second player's sprite X
$04:8712 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; /
$04:8714 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$04:8716 85 07        STA $07                         ; } [$07] and [$8B] = second player's sprite Y
$04:8718 85 8B        STA $8B                         ; /
$04:871A AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:871D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:871E 49 02        EOR.B #$02                      ; } Y = other player's index * 2
$04:8720 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8721 B9 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13,Y                   ; \
$04:8724 C9 12        CMP.B #$12                      ; } A = other player's pose; pose $12 (swimming): no Y shift
$04:8726 F0 11        BEQ $8739                       ; /
$04:8728 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; \
$04:872A 90 04        BCC $8730                       ; / Pose < 7 (walking): go shift Y
$04:872C C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; \
$04:872E 90 09        BCC $8739                       ; / Poses 7-$0E (swimming): no Y shift
$04:8730 A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$04:8732 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:8733 E9 05        SBC.B #$05                      ; |
$04:8735 85 8B        STA $8B                         ; } Walking poses are drawn 5 pixels higher: [$8B] and [$07] -= 5
$04:8737 85 07        STA $07                         ; /
$04:8739 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:873B AD B2 0D     LDA.W $0DB2                     ; \
$04:873E 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$0DB2] = 0 (one player game): skip the second player
$04:8741 F0 43        BEQ $8786                       ; /
$04:8743 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$04:8745 C9 F0 00     CMP.W #$00F0                    ; } Second player's X >= $F0 (off-screen): skip
$04:8748 B0 3C        BCS $8786                       ; /
$04:874A A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$04:874C C9 F0 00     CMP.W #$00F0                    ; } Second player's Y >= $F0 (off-screen): skip
$04:874F B0 35        BCS $8786                       ; /
$04:8751 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:8753 49 00 02     EOR.W #$0200                    ; } [$04] ^= $0200: palette offset of the other player
$04:8756 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$04:8758 A2 20 00     LDX.W #$0020                    ; X = $20: OAM offset of the second player's sprites (slot 47)
$04:875B 20 89 87     JSR.W $8789                     ; Draw the out-of-lives marker if needed ($8789)
$04:875E AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:8761 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8762 49 02 00     EOR.W #$0002                    ; } Y = other player's index * 2
$04:8765 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8766 A2 20 00     LDX.W #$0020                    ; X = $20: OAM offset
$04:8769 20 4F 89     JSR.W $894F                     ; Draw the player's map sprite ($894F)
$04:876C E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:876E 9C 4F 04     STZ.W $044F                     ; \
$04:8771 9C 50 04     STZ.W $0450                     ; |
$04:8774 9C 51 04     STZ.W $0451                     ; |
$04:8777 9C 52 04     STZ.W $0452                     ; |
$04:877A 9C 53 04     STZ.W $0453                     ; |
$04:877D 9C 54 04     STZ.W $0454                     ; |
$04:8780 9C 55 04     STZ.W $0455                     ; } Size/X-high entries of OAM slots 47-54 = 0 (8x8, X < 256)
$04:8783 9C 56 04     STZ.W $0456                     ; /
$04:8786 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:8788 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:8789 A5 8A        LDA $8A                         ; \
$04:878B 48           PHA                             ; / Save [$8A] (sprite X)
$04:878C DA           PHX                             ; Save X (OAM offset)
$04:878D A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:878F EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:8790 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player index (0 Mario, 1 Luigi) from the palette offset [$04]
$04:8791 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8792 BD B3 0D     LDA.W $0DB3,X                   ; Read the player's lives byte ([$0DB4]/[$0DB5]) into the high byte
$04:8795 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$04:8796 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; \
$04:8799 10 2C        BPL $87C7                       ; / Lives >= 0: no marker, go to $0487C7
$04:879B E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:879D A5 8A        LDA $8A                         ; \
$04:879F 9D B4 02     STA.W $02B4,X                   ; / Marker 1 X = [$8A]
$04:87A2 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:87A3 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Marker 2 X = [$8A] + 8
$04:87A5 9D B8 02     STA.W $02B8,X                   ; /
$04:87A8 A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$04:87AA 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:87AB 69 F9        ADC.B #$F9                      ; |
$04:87AD 9D B5 02     STA.W $02B5,X                   ; } Both markers: Y = [$8B] - 7
$04:87B0 9D B9 02     STA.W $02B9,X                   ; /
$04:87B3 A9 7C        LDA.B #$7C                      ; \
$04:87B5 9D B6 02     STA.W $02B6,X                   ; } Both markers: tile $7C
$04:87B8 9D BA 02     STA.W $02BA,X                   ; /
$04:87BB A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$04:87BD 9D B7 02     STA.W $02B7,X                   ; / Marker 1 property = $20 (priority 2, palette 0)
$04:87C0 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$04:87C2 9D BB 02     STA.W $02BB,X                   ; / Marker 2 property = $60 (same, X-flipped)
$04:87C5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:87C7 68           PLA                             ; \
$04:87C8 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; / Restore [$8A]
$04:87CA 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $894F: Draw player map sprite (2x2 tiles) ;;;
{
;; Draws one player's 4-tile map sprite into OAM from $87CB, or jumps to $8CE6 if the player has a
;;     Yoshi.
;; Parameters: Y = player index * 2, X = OAM offset into $029C (0 first player, $20 second), [$04] =
;;     $0000/$0200 palette offset
;; (Luigi = +1), [$8A]/[$8B] = sprite X/Y, [$06] = X of the left edge. A player out of lives is not animated.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:86DC: Draw border icon and player map sprites (DrawOWBoarder?)
;;     $04:8769: Draw border icon and player map sprites (DrawOWBoarder?)
$04:894F E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:8951 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y (pose table index)
$04:8952 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:8953 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = player index (0 Mario, 1 Luigi)
$04:8954 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8955 B9 BA 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlyrYoshiColor,Y      ; \
$04:8958 F0 08        BEQ $8962                       ; / A = Yoshi color for this player; 0 = no Yoshi, go to $048962
$04:895A 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; \
$04:895C 64 0F        STZ $0F                         ; / [$0E] = Yoshi color (16-bit)
$04:895E 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$04:895F 4C E6 8C     JMP.W $8CE6                     ; Draw the player riding Yoshi ($8CE6)

$04:8962 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$04:8963 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:8965 B9 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13,Y                   ; \
$04:8968 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8969 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:896A 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:896B 0A           ASL                             ; } [$00] = pose * 16: offset of this pose in the tile table
$04:896C 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:896E A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:8970 29 18 00     AND.W #$0018                    ; |
$04:8973 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:8974 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } Y = pose offset + animation frame * 8 (frame advances every 8 frames)
$04:8976 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8977 DA           PHX                             ; Save X (OAM offset)
$04:8978 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:897A EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:897B 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player index from the palette offset [$04]
$04:897C AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:897D BD B3 0D     LDA.W $0DB3,X                   ; Read the player's lives byte into the high byte
$04:8980 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$04:8981 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; \
$04:8984 10 05        BPL $898B                       ; / Lives >= 0: animate normally, go to $04898B
$04:8986 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:8988 A8           TAY                             ; } Out of lives: Y = pose * 16, no animation
$04:8989 80 1C        BRA $89A7                       ; /

$04:898B E0 00 00     CPX.W #$0000                    ; \
$04:898E D0 17        BNE $89A7                       ; / Only for the first player's sprite (X = 0)
$04:8990 AD D9 13     LDA.W $13D9                     ; \
$04:8993 C9 0B 00     CMP.W #$000B                    ; } Only while OW process [$13D9] = $0B (probably a turn-around spin)
$04:8996 D0 0F        BNE $89A7                       ; /
$04:8998 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:899A 29 0C 00     AND.W #$000C                    ; |
$04:899D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:899E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:899F A8           TAY                             ; |
$04:89A0 B9 4B 89     LDA.W $894B,Y                   ; |
$04:89A3 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Y = facing offset from $894B, changes every 4 frames
$04:89A6 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:89A7 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:89A9 A5 8A        LDA $8A                         ; \
$04:89AB 9D 9C 02     STA.W $029C,X                   ; / OAM X and Y of this tile = [$8A] and [$8B]
$04:89AE B9 CB 87     LDA.W $87CB,Y                   ; \
$04:89B1 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:89B2 65 04        ADC $04                         ; } OAM tile and property = [DATA_0487CB+Y] + [$04] (Luigi palette)
$04:89B4 9D 9E 02     STA.W $029E,X                   ; /
$04:89B7 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:89B9 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:89BA E8           INX                             ; |
$04:89BB E8           INX                             ; } X += 4: next OAM slot
$04:89BC E8           INX                             ; /
$04:89BD C8           INY                             ; \
$04:89BE C8           INY                             ; / Y += 2: next tile word
$04:89BF A5 8A        LDA $8A                         ; \
$04:89C1 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:89C2 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } [$8A] += 8: next tile to the right
$04:89C4 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; /
$04:89C6 C6 8C        DEC $8C                         ; \
$04:89C8 A5 8C        LDA $8C                         ; |
$04:89CA 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Tile counter--; after every second tile start a new row
$04:89CC F0 0B        BEQ $89D9                       ; /
$04:89CE A5 06        LDA $06                         ; \
$04:89D0 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; / [$8A] = [$06]: back to the left edge
$04:89D2 A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$04:89D4 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:89D5 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } [$8B] += 8: next row down
$04:89D7 85 8B        STA $8B                         ; /
$04:89D9 A5 8C        LDA $8C                         ; \
$04:89DB 10 CA        BPL $89A7                       ; / Loop until all 4 tiles are drawn
$04:89DD 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8CE6: Draw player riding Yoshi (8 tiles) ;;;
{
;; Draws the rider and Yoshi as 8 OAM tiles from $89DE, with per-tile offsets from
;;     $8B5E/$8C1E. Yoshi tiles
;; are recolored from the Yoshi color; the rider gets the player's palette offset.
;; Parameters: Y = player index * 2, X = OAM offset, [$0E] = Yoshi color, [$04] = palette offset, [$8A]/[$8B]
;;     = position.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:895F: Draw player map sprite (2x2 tiles)
$04:8CE6 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$04:8CE8 85 8C        STA $8C                         ; / [$8C] = 7: tile counter for 8 tiles (rider + Yoshi)
$04:8CEA C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:8CEC B9 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13,Y                   ; \
$04:8CEF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8CF0 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8CF1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8CF2 0A           ASL                             ; } [$00] = pose * 16: offset of this pose in the tile tables
$04:8CF3 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:8CF5 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:8CF7 29 08 00     AND.W #$0008                    ; |
$04:8CFA 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8CFB 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:8CFC 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } Y = pose offset + 0 or $10 (2 frames, switching every 8 frames)
$04:8CFE A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8CFF E0 00 00     CPX.W #$0000                    ; \
$04:8D02 D0 17        BNE $8D1B                       ; / Only for the first player's sprites (X = 0)
$04:8D04 AD D9 13     LDA.W $13D9                     ; \
$04:8D07 C9 0B 00     CMP.W #$000B                    ; } Only while OW process [$13D9] = $0B (probably a turn-around spin)
$04:8D0A D0 0F        BNE $8D1B                       ; /
$04:8D0C A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:8D0E 29 0C 00     AND.W #$000C                    ; |
$04:8D11 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8D12 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8D13 A8           TAY                             ; |
$04:8D14 B9 4B 89     LDA.W $894B,Y                   ; |
$04:8D17 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Y = facing offset from $894B, changes every 4 frames
$04:8D1A A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8D1B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:8D1D 5A           PHY                             ; Save the tile word index
$04:8D1E 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:8D1F 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = Y / 2: byte index into the per-tile offset tables
$04:8D20 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8D21 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:8D23 B9 5E 8B     LDA.W $8B5E,Y                   ; \
$04:8D26 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:8D27 65 8A        ADC $8A                         ; } OAM X = [DATA_048B5E+Y] + [$8A]
$04:8D29 9D 9C 02     STA.W $029C,X                   ; /
$04:8D2C B9 1E 8C     LDA.W $8C1E,Y                   ; \
$04:8D2F 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:8D30 65 8B        ADC $8B                         ; } OAM Y = [DATA_048C1E+Y] + [$8B]
$04:8D32 9D 9D 02     STA.W $029D,X                   ; /
$04:8D35 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the tile word index
$04:8D36 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:8D38 B9 DE 89     LDA.W $89DE,Y                   ; A = tile word (tile number, property) from $89DE
$04:8D3B C9 FF FF     CMP.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$04:8D3E F0 27        BEQ $8D67                       ; / $FFFF = unused slot: leave its tile alone
$04:8D40 48           PHA                             ; Save the tile word
$04:8D41 29 00 0F     AND.W #$0F00                    ; \
$04:8D44 C9 00 02     CMP.W #$0200                    ; } Palette bits = 1 ($0200): this is a Yoshi tile, recolor it
$04:8D47 D0 15        BNE $8D5E                       ; /
$04:8D49 84 08        STY $08                         ; Save the tile word index in [$08]
$04:8D4B A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$04:8D4D 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:8D4E E9 04 00     SBC.W #$0004                    ; } Y = Yoshi color - 4
$04:8D51 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8D52 68           PLA                             ; Restore the tile word
$04:8D53 29 FF F0     AND.W #$F0FF                    ; Clear its palette bits
$04:8D56 19 DE 8C     ORA.W $8CDE,Y                   ; Insert the palette for this Yoshi color ($8CDE)
$04:8D59 48           PHA                             ; Save the recolored tile word
$04:8D5A A4 08        LDY $08                         ; Restore the tile word index
$04:8D5C 80 05        BRA $8D63                       ; Go store it ($048D63)

$04:8D5E 68           PLA                             ; Restore the tile word (rider tile)
$04:8D5F 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:8D60 65 04        ADC $04                         ; / Add the player's palette offset [$04] (Luigi)
$04:8D62 48           PHA                             ; Save the tile word
$04:8D63 68           PLA                             ; Restore the tile word
$04:8D64 9D 9E 02     STA.W $029E,X                   ; Store tile and property in OAM
$04:8D67 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:8D69 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:8D6A E8           INX                             ; |
$04:8D6B E8           INX                             ; } X += 4: next OAM slot
$04:8D6C E8           INX                             ; /
$04:8D6D C8           INY                             ; \
$04:8D6E C8           INY                             ; / Y += 2: next tile word
$04:8D6F C6 8C        DEC $8C                         ; \
$04:8D71 10 A8        BPL $8D1B                       ; / Loop for all 8 tiles
$04:8D73 60           RTS                             ; Return


}
