;;; $8D91: Overworld load: reset poses, set music ;;;
{
;; Called by JSL from the map loader. Resets both players to an idle pose ($02 walking, $0A swimming), runs
;;     $8E55, then decides
;; whether to restart the map music: always when no cutscene is pending, else only if the level is beaten or
;;     in $8D74.
;; Leaves the music alone after beating translevel $18. Music = $8D8A[submap] written to [$1DFB].
;; Called by:
;;     $00:A161: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode)
$04:8D91 8B           PHB                             ; \
$04:8D92 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $04
$04:8D93 AB           PLB                             ; /
$04:8D94 9C 9E 1B     STZ.W $1B9E                     ; [$1B9E] = 0 (purpose unclear)
$04:8D97 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$04:8D99 8D 4E 14     STA.W $144E                     ; / [$144E] = $0F (purpose unclear)
$04:8D9C A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = $02: idle walking pose
$04:8D9E AD 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13                     ; A = Mario's map pose [$1F13]
$04:8DA1 C9 12        CMP.B #$12                      ; \
$04:8DA3 F0 04        BEQ $8DA9                       ; / Pose $12 (swimming): use the idle swimming pose
$04:8DA5 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; \
$04:8DA7 F0 02        BEQ $8DAB                       ; / Bit 3 clear (not swimming): keep pose $02
$04:8DA9 A2 0A        LDX.B #$0A                      ; X = $0A: idle swimming pose
$04:8DAB 8E 13 1F     STX.W $1F13                     ; Mario's pose = X
$04:8DAE A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = $02: idle walking pose
$04:8DB0 AD 15 1F     LDA.W $1F15                     ; A = Luigi's map pose [$1F15]
$04:8DB3 C9 12        CMP.B #$12                      ; \
$04:8DB5 F0 04        BEQ $8DBB                       ; / Pose $12 (swimming): use the idle swimming pose
$04:8DB7 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; \
$04:8DB9 F0 02        BEQ $8DBD                       ; / Bit 3 clear (not swimming): keep pose $02
$04:8DBB A2 0A        LDX.B #$0A                      ; X = $0A: idle swimming pose
$04:8DBD 8E 15 1F     STX.W $1F15                     ; Luigi's pose = X
$04:8DC0 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers = 8-bit
$04:8DC2 20 55 8E     JSR.W $8E55                     ; Set up the player's tile, level name and sprites ($8E55)
$04:8DC5 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:8DC7 AD D4 0D     LDA.W $0DD4                     ; \
$04:8DCA 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; / High byte = [$0DD5] (level exit result)
$04:8DCD F0 10        BEQ $8DDF                       ; No exit recorded: go to $048DDF
$04:8DCF 30 0E        BMI $8DDF                       ; Bit 7 set: go to $048DDF
$04:8DD1 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; \
$04:8DD4 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:8DD7 C9 18 00     CMP.W #$0018                    ; } Current translevel [$13BF] = $18? If not go to $048DDF
$04:8DDA D0 03        BNE $8DDF                       ; /
$04:8DDC 82 55 00     BRL $8E34                       ; Exit from translevel $18: leave the music alone ($048E34)
$04:8DDF AD C6 13     LDA.W $13C6                     ; \
$04:8DE2 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$13C6] low byte (cutscene) = 0: set the map music ($048E38)
$04:8DE5 F0 51        BEQ $8E38                       ; /
$04:8DE7 AD C6 13     LDA.W $13C6                     ; \
$04:8DEA 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; } Clear the low byte of [$13C6]
$04:8DED 8D C6 13     STA.W $13C6                     ; /
$04:8DF0 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers = 8-bit
$04:8DF2 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]: current player index
$04:8DF5 BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; \
$04:8DF8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8DF9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8DFA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8DFB 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = player map X / 16 (tile column)
$04:8DFC 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:8DFE BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:8E01 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8E02 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8E03 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8E04 4A           LSR                             ; } [$02] = player map Y / 16 (tile row)
$04:8E05 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$04:8E07 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8E08 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8E09 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player number (0 or 1)
$04:8E0A AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8E0B 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Compute the tile offset [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:8E0E C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index registers = 16-bit
$04:8E10 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile offset
$04:8E12 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:8E16 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } X = translevel number of that tile ([$7ED000])
$04:8E19 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8E1A BD A2 1E     LDA.W $1EA2,X                   ; \
$04:8E1D 29 80 00     AND.W #$0080                    ; } Level already beaten ([$1EA2] bit 7)? Set the map music ($048E38)
$04:8E20 D0 16        BNE $8E38                       ; /
$04:8E22 A0 14 00     LDY.W #$0014                    ; Y = $14: last entry of the $8D74 list
$04:8E25 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; \
$04:8E28 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:8E2B D9 74 8D     CMP.W $8D74,Y                   ; } Current translevel in the list? Then set the map music ($048E38)
$04:8E2E F0 08        BEQ $8E38                       ; /
$04:8E30 88           DEY                             ; \
$04:8E31 88           DEY                             ; } Next list entry
$04:8E32 10 F1        BPL $8E25                       ; /
$04:8E34 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:8E36 80 0F        BRA $8E47                       ; Skip the music change

$04:8E38 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:8E3A AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; \
$04:8E3D BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; } X = current player's submap ([$1F11] + player)
$04:8E40 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8E41 BD 8A 8D     LDA.W $8D8A,X                   ; \
$04:8E44 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Request the map music for that submap ([$1DFB])
$04:8E47 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$04:8E48 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

$04:8E49              .db $28,$01,$00,$00,$88,$01     ; Unused: X positions $0128, $0000, $0188

;;; $8E55: Overworld setup and process 0 (level exit) ;;;
{
;; $048E55: sets [$0DD6] = player * 4, converts the player's tile to an offset [$04], writes the level name to
;;     the stripe buffer,
;; stores the tile number in [$13C1], then updates the camera, draws the border sprites and runs the tile
;;     animation.
;; The [$0EF7] block ($048EA5-$048EDE) is probably unused: [$0EF7] seems never set outside unreferenced code.
;; $048EF1 (OW process 0, first entry of PtrsLong04857D): after a level, sets [$0DB1] = 8; at one map spot
;;     goes to process $0C;
;; else marks the level: midway flag if died with [$13CE] set, or beaten (bit 7) and process += 1 on exit.
;;     Then updates the camera.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:8DC2: Overworld load: reset poses, set music
;;     $04:9E03: Overworld level name text and builder (LevelNameStrings)
$04:8E55 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:8E57 AD B3 0D     LDA.W $0DB3                     ; \
$04:8E5A 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:8E5D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:8E5E 0A           ASL                             ; } [$0DD6] = current player * 4 (index into per-player tables)
$04:8E5F 8D D6 0D     STA.W $0DD6                     ; /
$04:8E62 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]
$04:8E65 BD 1F 1F     LDA.W $1F1F,X                   ; \
$04:8E68 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = player's tile column ([$1F1F])
$04:8E6A BD 21 1F     LDA.W $1F21,X                   ; \
$04:8E6D 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = player's tile row ([$1F21])
$04:8E6F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8E70 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8E71 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player number (0 or 1)
$04:8E72 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8E73 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Compute the tile offset [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:8E76 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0
$04:8E78 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile offset
$04:8E7A BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:8E7E 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:8E81 0A           ASL                             ; } X = translevel number at the player's tile * 2 ([$7ED000])
$04:8E82 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8E83 BD FC A0     LDA.W LevelNames,X              ; \
$04:8E86 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = level name data for that translevel (LevelNames)
$04:8E88 20 07 9D     JSR.W $9D07                     ; Write the level name to the stripe image buffer ($9D07)
$04:8E8B A6 04        LDX $04                         ; \
$04:8E8D 30 0F        BMI $8E9E                       ; / Tile offset negative: no tile number, go to $048E9E
$04:8E8F E0 00 08     CPX.W #$0800                    ; \
$04:8E92 B0 0A        BCS $8E9E                       ; / Tile offset >= $0800: out of range, go to $048E9E
$04:8E94 BF 00 C8 7E  LDA.L $7EC800,X                 ; \
$04:8E98 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$13C1] = OW tile number under the player ([$7EC800])
$04:8E9B 8D C1 13     STA.W $13C1                     ; /
$04:8E9E E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:8EA0 AE F7 0E     LDX.W $0EF7                     ; \
$04:8EA3 F0 3C        BEQ $8EE1                       ; / [$0EF7] = 0 (always, apparently): skip the block below
$04:8EA5 10 32        BPL $8ED9                       ; Bit 7 clear: go to $048ED9
$04:8EA7 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8EA8 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; } X = [$0EF7] & $7F
$04:8EAA AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8EAB 9E F5 0D     STZ.W $0DF5,X                   ; Clear [$0DF5+X]
$04:8EAE AD F6 0E     LDA.W $0EF6                     ; A = [$0EF6]
$04:8EB1 AE D5 0D     LDX.W $0DD5                     ; \
$04:8EB4 10 17        BPL $8ECD                       ; / [$0DD5] bit 7 clear: go to $048ECD
$04:8EB6 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:8EB7 AA           TAX                             ; / X = [$0EF6] * 2
$04:8EB8 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:8EBA AC D6 0D     LDY.W $0DD6                     ; Y = [$0DD6]: current player index
$04:8EBD BD 49 8E     LDA.W $8E49,X                   ; \
$04:8EC0 99 17 1F     STA.W $1F17,Y                   ; / Player map X = $8E49[X]
$04:8EC3 BD 4F 8E     LDA.W $8E4F,X                   ; \
$04:8EC6 99 19 1F     STA.W $1F19,Y                   ; / Player map Y = $8E4F[X]
$04:8EC9 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:8ECB 80 14        BRA $8EE1                       ; Continue at $048EE1

$04:8ECD AA           TAX                             ; X = [$0EF6]
$04:8ECE BD 85 FB     LDA.W $FB85,X                   ; \
$04:8ED1 0D F5 0E     ORA.W $0EF5                     ; } [$0EF5] |= $FB85[X] ($80, $40 or $20)
$04:8ED4 8D F5 0E     STA.W $0EF5                     ; /
$04:8ED7 80 08        BRA $8EE1                       ; Continue at $048EE1

$04:8ED9 AD D5 0D     LDA.W $0DD5                     ; \
$04:8EDC 30 03        BMI $8EE1                       ; / [$0DD5] negative: skip
$04:8EDE 9E E5 0D     STZ.W $0DE5,X                   ; Clear [$0DE5+X]
$04:8EE1 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:8EE3 20 31 98     JSR.W $9831                     ; Update the map camera to follow the player ($9831)
$04:8EE6 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 8-bit
$04:8EE8 20 A4 85     JSR.W DrawOWBoarder?            ; Draw the border icon and the players' map sprites (DrawOWBoarder?)
$04:8EEB 20 86 80     JSR.W $8086                     ; Copy animated OW tile graphics to the buffer at $0AF6 ($8086)
$04:8EEE 4C E0 80     JMP.W OW_Tile_Animation         ; Run the OW tile animation (OW_Tile_Animation) and return

$04:8EF1 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$04:8EF3 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; / [$0DB1] = 8 (OW mode timer, probably keeps the mode running)
$04:8EF6 AD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11                     ; \
$04:8EF9 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Mario's submap [$1F11] = 1? If not, go to $048F13
$04:8EFB D0 16        BNE $8F13                       ; /
$04:8EFD AD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17                     ; \
$04:8F00 C9 68        CMP.B #$68                      ; } Mario's map X low byte = $68? If not, go to $048F13
$04:8F02 D0 0F        BNE $8F13                       ; /
$04:8F04 AD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19                     ; \
$04:8F07 C9 8E        CMP.B #$8E                      ; } Mario's map Y low byte = $8E? If not, go to $048F13
$04:8F09 D0 08        BNE $8F13                       ; /
$04:8F0B A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$04:8F0D 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / OW process [$13D9] = $0C (a special event at this spot)
$04:8F10 82 67 00     BRL $8F7A                       ; Skip the exit handling, go to $048F7A
$04:8F13 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:8F15 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]: current player index
$04:8F18 BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; \
$04:8F1B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8F1C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8F1D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8F1E 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = player map X / 16 (tile column)
$04:8F1F 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:8F21 BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:8F24 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8F25 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8F26 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8F27 4A           LSR                             ; } [$02] = player map Y / 16 (tile row)
$04:8F28 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$04:8F2A 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8F2B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:8F2C 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player number (0 or 1)
$04:8F2D AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8F2E 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Compute the tile offset [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:8F31 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index registers = 16-bit
$04:8F33 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:8F35 AD CE 13     LDA.W $13CE                     ; \
$04:8F38 F0 1C        BEQ $8F56                       ; / Midway flag [$13CE] = 0: go to $048F56
$04:8F3A AD D5 0D     LDA.W $0DD5                     ; \
$04:8F3D F0 17        BEQ $8F56                       ; / [$0DD5] = 0 (no exit taken): go to $048F56
$04:8F3F 10 1E        BPL $8F5F                       ; Positive (level beaten): go to $048F5F
$04:8F41 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:8F43 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile offset
$04:8F45 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:8F49 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:8F4C AA           TAX                             ; } A = level flags of the translevel at the player's tile ([$1EA2])
$04:8F4D BD A2 1E     LDA.W $1EA2,X                   ; /
$04:8F50 09 40 00     ORA.W #$0040                    ; \
$04:8F53 9D A2 1E     STA.W $1EA2,X                   ; / Set bit 6 (midway point reached) in the level flags
$04:8F56 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$04:8F58 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$04:8F5A 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / OW process [$13D9] = 5 (player does nothing)
$04:8F5D 80 1B        BRA $8F7A                       ; Go to $048F7A

$04:8F5F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$04:8F61 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile offset
$04:8F63 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:8F67 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:8F6A AA           TAX                             ; } A = level flags of the translevel at the player's tile ([$1EA2])
$04:8F6B BD A2 1E     LDA.W $1EA2,X                   ; /
$04:8F6E 09 80 00     ORA.W #$0080                    ; \
$04:8F71 29 BF FF     AND.W #$FFBF                    ; } Set bit 7 (level beaten) and clear bit 6 (midway point)
$04:8F74 9D A2 1E     STA.W $1EA2,X                   ; /
$04:8F77 EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; OW process [$13D9] += 1 (next: path reveal and events)
$04:8F7A C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y = 16-bit
$04:8F7C 4C 31 98     JMP.W $9831                     ; Update the map camera and return ($9831)


}

;;; $8F7F..8F7F: Unused table: OW tile numbers ;;;
{

$04:8F7F              .db $58,$59,$5D,$63,$77,$79,$7E,$80 ; Unused: OW tile numbers $58, $59, $5D, $63, $77, $79, $7E, $80

;;; $8F87: Overworld state 2: after level, save data ;;;
{
;; Overworld state 2 ([$13D9] = 2, entry in PtrsLong04857D). Sets up the auto-walk from the level just cleared
;;     ($9903).
;; If the tile under the player is one of 8 in $8F7F (probably the ones that offer a save), copies the
;;     player data to the
;; save buffer at $1FA9 and mirrors the current player's position, tile and submap into the other player's
;;     slot.
;; Exit type [$0DD5] = $E0: waits for [$0DB1] to run out, then saves the level flags and sets [$13D9] = 4
;;     (becomes 5).
;; Finally reads the tile number under the player into [$13C1] and advances [$13D9].
;; $049037: if [$13CA] is set, copies the 96 level flag bytes $1EA2 to $1F49, clears [$13CA] and sets [$1B87]
;;     = 5. Preserves X, Y, P.
$04:8F87 20 03 99     JSR.W $9903                     ; Compute auto-walk direction from exit type [$0DD5] ($9903); no-op if 0 or negative
$04:8F8A A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: last entry of $8F7F
$04:8F8C AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; A = [$13C1]: tile number the player stands on
$04:8F8F DD 7F 8F     CMP.W $8F7F,X                   ; Compare with $8F7F[X] (8 special level tiles)
$04:8F92 D0 6C        BNE $9000                       ; No match: try the next entry
$04:8F94 A2 2C        LDX.B #$2C                      ; X = $2C: copy 45 bytes
$04:8F96 BD 02 1F     LDA.W $1F02,X                   ; \
$04:8F99 9D A9 1F     STA.W $1FA9,X                   ; |
$04:8F9C CA           DEX                             ; } Copy [$1F02]-[$1F2E] to the save buffer $1FA9-$1FD5
$04:8F9D 10 F7        BPL $8F96                       ; /
$04:8F9F C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:8FA1 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6] (current player * 4)
$04:8FA4 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8FA5 49 04 00     EOR.W #$0004                    ; } Y = X xor 4: the other player's slot
$04:8FA8 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:8FA9 BD BE 1F     LDA.W $1FBE,X                   ; \
$04:8FAC 99 BE 1F     STA.W $1FBE,Y                   ; / Save buffer: copy player X position ($1FBE) to the other player
$04:8FAF BD C0 1F     LDA.W $1FC0,X                   ; \
$04:8FB2 99 C0 1F     STA.W $1FC0,Y                   ; / Save buffer: copy player Y position ($1FC0) to the other player
$04:8FB5 BD C6 1F     LDA.W $1FC6,X                   ; \
$04:8FB8 99 C6 1F     STA.W $1FC6,Y                   ; / Save buffer: copy tile X position ($1FC6) to the other player
$04:8FBB BD C8 1F     LDA.W $1FC8,X                   ; \
$04:8FBE 99 C8 1F     STA.W $1FC8,Y                   ; / Save buffer: copy tile Y position ($1FC8) to the other player
$04:8FC1 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8FC2 4A           LSR                             ; } X = [$0DD6] / 2
$04:8FC3 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8FC4 49 02 00     EOR.W #$0002                    ; \
$04:8FC7 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = X xor 2: the other player's slot
$04:8FC8 BD BA 1F     LDA.W $1FBA,X                   ; \
$04:8FCB 99 BA 1F     STA.W $1FBA,Y                   ; / Save buffer: copy animation/facing ($1FBA) to the other player
$04:8FCE 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:8FCF E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; |
$04:8FD1 4A           LSR                             ; } A, X and Y 8-bit; X = player number (0 or 1)
$04:8FD2 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:8FD3 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; \
$04:8FD5 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = X xor 1: the other player
$04:8FD6 BD B8 1F     LDA.W $1FB8,X                   ; \
$04:8FD9 99 B8 1F     STA.W $1FB8,Y                   ; / Save buffer: copy submap ($1FB8) to the other player
$04:8FDC AD D5 0D     LDA.W $0DD5                     ; A = [$0DD5] (exit type)
$04:8FDF C9 E0        CMP.B #$E0                      ; \
$04:8FE1 D0 18        BNE $8FFB                       ; / Not $E0: just flag a pending save and go on
$04:8FE3 CE B1 0D     DEC.W $0DB1                     ; [$0DB1]-- (delay counter)
$04:8FE6 30 01        BMI $8FE9                       ; Went below 0: continue below
$04:8FE8 60           RTS                             ; Still counting: stay in this state until next frame

$04:8FE9 EE CA 13     INC.W $13CA                     ; Flag a save as pending ([$13CA]++)
$04:8FEC 20 37 90     JSR.W $9037                     ; Copy the level flags to the save buffer ($9037)
$04:8FEF A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:8FF1 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; / [$0DB1] = 2
$04:8FF4 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:8FF6 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / [$13D9] = 4 (INC at $049033 makes it 5)
$04:8FF9 80 08        BRA $9003                       ; Go find the tile under the player

$04:8FFB EE CA 13     INC.W $13CA                     ; Flag a save as pending ([$13CA]++)
$04:8FFE 80 03        BRA $9003                       ; Go find the tile under the player

$04:9000 CA           DEX                             ; Next entry of $8F7F
$04:9001 10 89        BPL $8F8C                       ; Loop for X = 7..0
$04:9003 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9005 64 06        STZ $06                         ; [$06] = 0
$04:9007 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6] (current player * 4)
$04:900A BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; \
$04:900D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:900E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:900F 4A           LSR                             ; } A = player X position / 16 (tile column)
$04:9010 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:9011 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = tile column
$04:9013 BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:9016 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9017 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9018 4A           LSR                             ; } A = player Y position / 16 (tile row)
$04:9019 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:901A 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = tile row
$04:901C 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:901D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:901E 4A           LSR                             ; } X = [$0DD6] / 4 (player number)
$04:901F AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:9020 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Compute the tile offset into [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:9023 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; X and Y 16-bit
$04:9025 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = [$04] (tile offset)
$04:9027 BF 00 C8 7E  LDA.L $7EC800,X                 ; A = overworld tile number at $7E:C800 + offset
$04:902B 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; Keep the low byte
$04:902E 8D C1 13     STA.W $13C1                     ; [$13C1] = tile number under the player
$04:9031 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:9033 EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; Next overworld state: [$13D9]++
$04:9036 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9037 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$04:9038 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$04:9039 08           PHP                             ; Save processor flags
$04:903A E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:903C AD CA 13     LDA.W $13CA                     ; A = [$13CA] (save pending flag)
$04:903F F0 13        BEQ $9054                       ; Not pending: skip
$04:9041 A2 5F        LDX.B #$5F                      ; X = $5F: copy 96 bytes
$04:9043 BD A2 1E     LDA.W $1EA2,X                   ; \
$04:9046 9D 49 1F     STA.W $1F49,X                   ; |
$04:9049 CA           DEX                             ; } Copy level flags $1EA2-$1F01 to the save buffer $1F49-$1FA8
$04:904A 10 F7        BPL $9043                       ; /
$04:904C 9C CA 13     STZ.W $13CA                     ; Clear the save pending flag [$13CA]
$04:904F A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$04:9051 8D 87 1B     STA.W $1B87                     ; / [$1B87] = 5 (probably tells a later state to show the save prompt)
$04:9054 28           PLP                             ; Restore processor flags
$04:9055 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$04:9056 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$04:9057 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9058..9074: Tables: direction steps and auto-walk fields ;;;
{
;; $049058: tile step per direction. $049060: shift counts for the 2-bit direction field in $7E:D800 (one
;;     field per exit type 1-4).
;; $049064: direction index per field value. $04906C: level numbers at which auto-walk ends.
$04:9058              .db $FF,$FF,$01,$00,$FF,$FF,$01,$00 ; Words -1, +1, -1, +1: tile step for direction Y (0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right)
$04:9060              .db $05,$03,$01,$00             ; Shift counts - 1 for exit type [$0DD5] = 1..4: which 2-bit field of $7E:D800

$04:9064              .db $00,$00,$02,$00,$04,$00,$06,$00 ; Words 0, 2, 4, 6: direction index (0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right) from the field
$04:906C              .db $28,$00,$08,$00,$14,$00,$36,$00 ; Level numbers where auto-walk ends and the next event starts: $28, $08, $14, $36
$04:9074              .db $3F,$00,$45,$00             ; Level numbers: $3F, $45 (end of the list)

}

;;; $9078: Hardcoded overworld paths and state 3 entry (HardCodedOWPaths) ;;;
{
;; Data ($049078-$04911F): paths for levels that leave the map without path tiles: level numbers, pipe
;;     position ($0178/$0128),
;; tile lists ($049086), direction lists ($0490CA) and offsets of each path in them ($04910E).
;; Code at $049120 is overworld state 3 ([$13D9] = 3): clears [$0DD8]; with auto-walk active goes straight to
;;     the walking code.
;; Otherwise reads Select and falls into OW_Player_Update (debug star-warp code after it is unreachable).
$04:9078              .db $09,$15,$23,$1B,$43,$44,$24,$FF ; Level numbers that have hardcoded paths ($FF = pipe, matched by position)
$04:9080              .db $30,$31                     ; Level numbers $30, $31 (last two paths)

$04:9082              .db $78,$01                     ; Pipe Y position $0178 (compared with [$1F19])

$04:9084              .db $28,$01                     ; Pipe X position $0128 (compared with [$1F17])

$04:9086              .db $10,$10,$1E,$19,$16,$66,$16,$19 ; Path 0 tiles $10,$10,$1E,$19,$16,$66; path 1 starts $16,$19
$04:908E              .db $1E,$10,$10,$66,$04,$04,$04,$58 ; Path 1 ends $1E,$10,$10,$66; path 2: $04,$04,$04,$58
$04:9096              .db $04,$04,$04,$66,$04,$04,$04,$04 ; Path 3: $04,$04,$04,$66; path 4 starts $04 x4
$04:909E              .db $04,$6A,$04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$66 ; Path 4 ends $04,$6A; path 5: $04 x5,$66
$04:90A6              .db $1E,$19,$06,$09,$0F,$20,$1A,$21 ; Path 6 tiles (from level $24 to the pipe) start
$04:90AE              .db $1A,$14,$19,$18,$1F,$17,$82,$17 ; Path 6 ends with the pipe tile $82; path 7 (pipe back to $24) starts $17
$04:90B6              .db $1F,$18,$19,$14,$1A,$21,$1A,$20 ; Path 7 tiles
$04:90BE              .db $0F,$09,$06,$19,$1E,$66,$04,$04 ; Path 7 ends $66; path 8 starts $04,$04
$04:90C6              .db $58,$04,$04,$5F             ; Path 8 ends $58; path 9: $04,$04,$5F

$04:90CA              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$06,$06,$04,$04 ; Path directions (0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right), same offsets as the tile list; path 0
$04:90D2              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$04,$04,$04,$04 ; Path directions (continued)
$04:90DA              .db $06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06 ; Path directions (continued)
$04:90E2              .db $06,$06,$04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$04 ; Path directions (continued)
$04:90EA              .db $02,$02,$06,$06,$00,$00,$00,$04 ; Path directions (continued)
$04:90F2              .db $00,$04,$04,$00,$04,$00,$04,$06 ; Path directions (continued)
$04:90FA              .db $02,$06,$02,$06,$06,$02,$06,$02 ; Path directions (continued)
$04:9102              .db $02,$02,$04,$04,$00,$00,$06,$06 ; Path directions (continued)
$04:910A              .db $06,$04,$04,$04             ; Path directions (end)

$04:910E              .db $00,$06,$0C,$10,$14,$1A,$20,$2F ; Offset of paths 0-7 in the tile and direction lists
$04:9116              .db $3E,$41,$08,$00,$04,$00,$02,$00 ; Offsets of paths 8 and 9; then words 8, 4, 2, 1 (direction bits, apparently unused)
$04:911E              .db $01,$00                     ; Words 8, 4, 2, 1 (cont.)

$04:9120 9C D8 0D     STZ.W $0DD8                     ; [$0DD8] = 0
$04:9123 AC F7 0E     LDY.W $0EF7                     ; Y = [$0EF7]
$04:9126 30 71        BMI OWPU_NotOnPipe              ; Negative: skip the button checks (OWPU_NotOnPipe)
$04:9128 AD D5 0D     LDA.W $0DD5                     ; A = [$0DD5] (exit type / auto-walk)
$04:912B 30 05        BMI $9132                       ; Negative: read buttons
$04:912D F0 03        BEQ $9132                       ; Zero: read buttons
$04:912F 82 B7 00     BRL $91E9                       ; Auto-walk active: skip buttons, go walk ($0491E9)
$04:9132 A5 16        LDA $16                         ; A = [$16] (buttons newly pressed)
$04:9134 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; Isolate Select
$04:9136 80 09        BRA OW_Player_Update            ; Always continue at OW_Player_Update (BEQ here would enable the debug code)

$04:9138 AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; Unreachable debug: A = [$13C1] (tile under player)
$04:913B F0 28        BEQ $9165                       ; Tile 0: warp to Star Road
$04:913D C9 56        CMP.B #$56                      ; Tile $56?
$04:913F F0 24        BEQ $9165                       ; Yes: warp to Star Road
}

;;; $9141: Overworld: L+R on Destroyed Castle (OW_Player_Update) ;;;
{
;; If L and R are both held and the player is on tile $81 (Destroyed Castle), enters the level; otherwise
;;     falls into OWPU_NoLR.
$04:9141 A5 17        LDA RAM_ControllerB             ; \
$04:9143 29 30        AND.B #$30                      ; |
$04:9145 C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; } If L and R are not both held, go to OWPU_NoLR
$04:9147 D0 07        BNE OWPU_NoLR                   ; /
$04:9149 AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; \
$04:914C C9 81        CMP.B #$81                      ; } If standing on tile $81 (Destroyed Castle), enter the level
$04:914E F0 4F        BEQ OWPU_EnterLevel             ; /
}

;;; $9150: Overworld: check A/B/X/Y pressed (OWPU_NoLR) ;;;
{
;; If A, B, X or Y was newly pressed go to OWPU_ABXY, otherwise go to the walking code at $0491E9.
$04:9150 A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$04:9152 05 18        ORA $18                         ; |
$04:9154 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; } If A, B, X or Y newly pressed, go to OWPU_ABXY
$04:9156 D0 03        BNE OWPU_ABXY                   ; /
$04:9158 82 8E 00     BRL $91E9                       ; Otherwise go to the walking code at $0491E9
}

;;; $915B: Overworld: button pressed on a tile (OWPU_ABXY) ;;;
{
;; Clears [$1B9E]. On a star tile ($5F) starts the star warp ([$13D9] = $0B, sound $0D). Otherwise tests for
;;     pipes and level tiles.
$04:915B 9C 9E 1B     STZ.W $1B9E                     ; [$1B9E] = 0
$04:915E AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; \
$04:9161 C9 5F        CMP.B #$5F                      ; } If not on a star tile ($5F), go to OWPU_NotOnStar
$04:9163 D0 18        BNE OWPU_NotOnStar              ; /
$04:9165 20 09 85     JSR.W $8509                     ; Check the player is exactly on the star/pipe spot ($8509); Z set if so
$04:9168 D0 2E        BNE OWPU_IsOnPipeRTS            ; Not there: return
$04:916A 9C F7 1D     STZ.W $1DF7                     ; Star fly-away speed [$1DF7] = 0
$04:916D 9C F8 1D     STZ.W $1DF8                     ; Star ground timer [$1DF8] = 0
$04:9170 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$04:9172 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect [$1DF9] = $0D (Star Road warp)
$04:9175 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$04:9177 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / [$13D9] = $0B: start the star warp
$04:917A 4C 52 9E     JMP.W $9E52                     ; Run the star warp code ($9E52)

}

;;; $917D: Overworld: check for pipe tiles (OWPU_NotOnStar) ;;;
{
;; Tile $82 (unused pipe 1) goes to OWPU_IsOnPipe, tile $5B (pipe 2) falls into it, anything else to
;;     OWPU_NotOnPipe.
$04:917D AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; \
$04:9180 C9 82        CMP.B #$82                      ; } If on tile $82 (unused pipe 1), go to OWPU_IsOnPipe
$04:9182 F0 04        BEQ OWPU_IsOnPipe               ; /
$04:9184 C9 5B        CMP.B #$5B                      ; \
$04:9186 D0 11        BNE OWPU_NotOnPipe              ; / If not on tile $5B (pipe 2), go to OWPU_NotOnPipe
}

;;; $9188: Overworld: enter pipe (OWPU_IsOnPipe) ;;;
{
;; If exactly on the pipe spot ($8509): [$1B9C]++, exit type [$0DD5] = 0 and game mode = $0B (fade to
;;     overworld, loads the other submap).
$04:9188 20 09 85     JSR.W $8509                     ; Check the player is exactly on the pipe spot ($8509)
$04:918B D0 0B        BNE OWPU_IsOnPipeRTS            ; Not there: return
$04:918D EE 9C 1B     INC.W $1B9C                     ; [$1B9C]++ (entered a pipe)
$04:9190 9C D5 0D     STZ.W $0DD5                     ; Exit type [$0DD5] = 0
$04:9193 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$04:9195 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; / Game mode = $0B: fade to overworld (loads the other submap)
}

;;; $9198: Return (OWPU_IsOnPipeRTS) ;;;
{
$04:9198 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9199: Overworld: tiles that cannot be entered (OWPU_NotOnPipe) ;;;
{
;; Tile >= $81: no level to enter, go walk ($0491E9). Lower tiles fall into OWPU_EnterLevel.
$04:9199 C9 81        CMP.B #$81                      ; \
$04:919B F0 4C        BEQ $91E9                       ; } Tile >= $81: cannot enter, go walk ($0491E9)
$04:919D B0 4A        BCS $91E9                       ; /
}

;;; $919F: Overworld: enter level, then walk (OWPU_EnterLevel) ;;;
{
;; $04919F: starts a level. Sets the raise-hand animation, copies the current player's coins, lives, power-up,
;;     Yoshi color and
;; reserve item into the in-level RAM, requests the music fade ([$1DFB] = $80) and increments the game mode
;;     (fade to level).
;; $0491E9: walking code. Converts the player's X/Y to tile coordinates, computes the tile offset into [$04].
;;     With auto-walk active,
;; ends on the levels in $906C ([$13D9] = 5) or takes the direction from the $7E:D800 field and jumps to
;;     $0492BC.
$04:919F AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:91A2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:91A3 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } X = player number * 2 (0 Mario, 2 Luigi)
$04:91A5 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:91A6 A0 10        LDY.B #$10                      ; Y = $10: 'raise hand' animation
$04:91A8 BD 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13,X                   ; A = [$1F13,X] (player animation)
$04:91AB 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; Isolate the swimming bit
$04:91AD F0 02        BEQ $91B1                       ; Not swimming: keep Y = $10
$04:91AF A0 12        LDY.B #$12                      ; Swimming: Y = $12 ('raise hand' in water)
$04:91B1 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:91B2 9D 13 1F     STA.W $1F13,X                   ; / Store the animation in [$1F13,X]
$04:91B5 AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; X = [$0DB3] (current player)
$04:91B8 BD B6 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerCoins,X         ; \
$04:91BB 8D BF 0D     STA.W RAM_StatusCoins           ; / Status bar coins = this player's coins
$04:91BE BD B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; \
$04:91C1 8D BE 0D     STA.W RAM_StatusLives           ; / Status bar lives = this player's lives
$04:91C4 BD B8 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerPowerUp,X       ; \
$04:91C7 85 19        STA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; / Mario power-up = this player's power-up
$04:91C9 BD BA 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlyrYoshiColor,X      ; \
$04:91CC 8D C1 0D     STA.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; |
$04:91CF 8D C7 13     STA.W RAM_YoshiColor            ; } Yoshi color for the map and the level = this player's Yoshi color
$04:91D2 8D 7A 18     STA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; /
$04:91D5 BD BC 0D     LDA.W $0DBC,X                   ; \
$04:91D8 8D C2 0D     STA.W $0DC2                     ; / Reserve item [$0DC2] = this player's reserve item [$0DBC,X]
$04:91DB A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:91DD 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; / [$0DB1] = 2 (fade speed)
$04:91E0 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$04:91E2 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / [$1DFB] = $80: fade out the music
$04:91E5 EE 00 01     INC.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode++: fade to level
$04:91E8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:91E9 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:91EB AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6] (current player * 4)
$04:91EE BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; A = player X position
$04:91F1 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:91F2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:91F3 4A           LSR                             ; } A = X position / 16
$04:91F4 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:91F5 85 00        STA $00                         ; \
$04:91F7 9D 1F 1F     STA.W $1F1F,X                   ; / [$00] and [$1F1F,X] = tile column
$04:91FA BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; A = player Y position
$04:91FD 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:91FE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:91FF 4A           LSR                             ; } A = Y position / 16
$04:9200 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:9201 85 02        STA $02                         ; \
$04:9203 9D 21 1F     STA.W $1F21,X                   ; / [$02] and [$1F21,X] = tile row
$04:9206 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:9207 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9208 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player number
$04:9209 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:920A 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Compute the tile offset into [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:920D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:920F AE D5 0D     LDX.W $0DD5                     ; \
$04:9212 F0 46        BEQ OWPU_NotAutoWalk            ; / If no auto-walk ([$0DD5] = 0), go to OWPU_NotAutoWalk
$04:9214 CA           DEX                             ; X = exit type - 1
$04:9215 BD 60 90     LDA.W $9060,X                   ; A = shift count for this exit type ($9060)
$04:9218 85 08        STA $08                         ; [$08] = shift count
$04:921A 64 09        STZ $09                         ; [$09] = 0
$04:921C C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:921E A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = [$04] (tile offset)
$04:9220 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:9224 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = level number of this tile ($7E:D000)
$04:9227 A0 0A 00     LDY.W #$000A                    ; Y = $0A: last word of $906C
$04:922A D9 6C 90     CMP.W $906C,Y                   ; Compare with the level numbers where auto-walk ends
$04:922D D0 0C        BNE $923B                       ; No match: try next
$04:922F A9 05 00     LDA.W #$0005                    ; A = 5
$04:9232 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; [$13D9] = 5: next overworld event
$04:9235 20 37 90     JSR.W $9037                     ; Copy the level flags to the save buffer ($9037)
$04:9238 82 D6 01     BRL $9411                       ; Leave through $049411
$04:923B 88           DEY                             ; Y -= 2
$04:923C 88           DEY                             ; (second DEY)
$04:923D 10 EB        BPL $922A                       ; Loop over the 6 level numbers
$04:923F BF 00 D8 7E  LDA.L $7ED800,X                 ; \
$04:9243 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = path-direction byte of this tile ($7E:D800)
$04:9246 A6 08        LDX $08                         ; \
$04:9248 F0 04        BEQ $924E                       ; / X = [$08]; if 0, skip the shifting
$04:924A 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:924B CA           DEX                             ; } Shift the byte right by [$08] + 1 bits
$04:924C 10 FC        BPL $924A                       ; /
$04:924E 29 03 00     AND.W #$0003                    ; \
$04:9251 0A           ASL                             ; / A = (2-bit field) * 2: direction index
$04:9252 AA           TAX                             ; X = direction index
$04:9253 BD 64 90     LDA.W $9064,X                   ; A = direction (0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right) from $9064
$04:9256 A8           TAY                             ; Y = direction
$04:9257 4C BC 92     JMP.W $92BC                     ; Continue as if that direction was pressed ($0492BC)
; |
; V This routine was commented by Nicol Bolas. The spacing is weird, but you get the idea.
; Parameters:
; $00: 16-bit Overworld X position.
; $02: 16-bit Overworld Y position.
; $04: 16-bit offset to the current tile we are standing on.

; Workspace (temporary memory that is overwritten)
; $06. Cleared, for no apparent reason. May mean something to later code.
; $08. Used to store $04 temporarily, as it calls a routine that bashes $04.

}

;;; $925A: Overworld: start walking from a level tile (OWPU_NotAutoWalk) ;;;
{
;; Reads the d-pad. No direction: after [$144E] frames makes the player face down. Direction: allowed only if
;;     the level's flags
;; ([$1EA2]) enable it (tile $82 always allows). Checks the neighboring tile: tiles $01-$86 are walked onto,
;;     otherwise tries the
;; hardcoded paths ($9078). Sets target position [$0DC7], facing, [$144E] = $0F, advances [$13D9] (state
;;     4) and exits to $049831.
;; Comments in the source describe this routine in detail (Nicol Bolas). Corner tiles ($A03C) use custom
;;     offsets instead of 8 pixels.
$04:925A E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:925C 9C D5 0D     STZ.W $0DD5                     ; Exit type [$0DD5] = 0
$04:925F A5 16        LDA $16                         ; A = [$16] (buttons newly pressed)
$04:9261 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; Isolate the d-pad
$04:9263 F0 09        BEQ $926E                       ; None pressed: go to the idle facing code
$04:9265 AE C1 13     LDX.W $13C1                     ; X = [$13C1] (tile under player)
$04:9268 E0 82        CPX.B #$82                      ; Pipe tile $82?
$04:926A F0 41        BEQ $92AD                       ; Yes: all directions allowed, skip the flag check
$04:926C 80 1E        BRA $928C                       ; Check this level's exit flags

; Logic: If the player stands on a tile motionless for long enough,
; change the character's facing to "down".
$04:926E CE 4E 14     DEC.W $144E                     ; Idle timer [$144E]--
$04:9271 10 14        BPL $9287                       ; Still positive: leave
$04:9273 9C 4E 14     STZ.W $144E                     ; [$144E] = 0
$04:9276 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:9279 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:927A 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } X = player number * 2
$04:927C AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:927D BD 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13,X                   ; A = animation of this player
$04:9280 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; Keep the swimming bit
$04:9282 09 02        ORA.B #$02                      ; Add facing 2 (down)
$04:9284 9D 13 1F     STA.W $1F13,X                   ; Store: character faces down
$04:9287 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:9289 4C 31 98     JMP.W $9831                     ; Exit through $049831 (next phase of overworld processing)

; Logic: The user is on a level tile and has pressed a direction.
; We must now determine whether to move in that direction. We can only do so if
; the level has been passed. This code detects that.
; The directional input is in register A.
$04:928C C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:928E 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; A = d-pad bits only
$04:9291 EA           NOP                             ; \
$04:9292 EA           NOP                             ; } Padding NOPs (room for a removed JMP $92AF debug skip)
$04:9293 EA           NOP                             ; /
$04:9294 48           PHA                             ; Save the d-pad bits
$04:9295 64 06        STZ $06                         ; [$06] = 0
$04:9297 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = [$04] (tile offset of the level)
$04:9299 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:929D 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = level number of this tile
$04:92A0 AA           TAX                             ; X = level number
$04:92A1 68           PLA                             ; Restore the d-pad bits
$04:92A2 3D A2 1E     AND.W $1EA2,X                   ; \
$04:92A5 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; / A = d-pad bits that are enabled in this level's flags [$1EA2,X]
$04:92A8 D0 03        BNE $92AD                       ; At least one allowed: move
$04:92AA 4C 11 94     JMP.W $9411                     ; Blocked: leave through $049411

; Logic: If we're here, then the level does not prevent movement in that direction.
; Now we must check the tile in that direction to see if it is an appropriate path.
; The direction to travel in is still in register A.
; Note: Level tile 0x82 (a Pipe tile) always allows movement in any direction,
; so it jumps directly here.
$04:92AD C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:92AF 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; A = d-pad bits only
$04:92B2 A0 06 00     LDY.W #$0006                    ; \
$04:92B5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:92B6 B0 04        BCS $92BC                       ; |
$04:92B8 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:92B9 88           DEY                             ; } Y = direction of the pressed d-pad bit: 0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right
$04:92BA 10 F9        BPL $92B5                       ; /
$04:92BC 98           TYA                             ; A = direction
$04:92BD 8D D3 0D     STA.W $0DD3                     ; [$0DD3] = direction
$04:92C0 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; \
$04:92C3 C0 04 00     CPY.W #$0004                    ; |
$04:92C6 B0 03        BCS $92CB                       ; } X = 0 if moving horizontally ($00 = X), 2 if vertically ($02 = Y)
$04:92C8 A2 02 00     LDX.W #$0002                    ; /
$04:92CB A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:92CD 85 08        STA $08                         ; / [$08] = current tile offset (saved, [$04] will change)
$04:92CF B5 00        LDA $00,X                       ; \
$04:92D1 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:92D2 79 58 90     ADC.W $9058,Y                   ; } Move [$00] or [$02] one tile in the pressed direction
$04:92D5 95 00        STA $00,X                       ; /
$04:92D7 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:92DA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:92DB 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player number
$04:92DC AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:92DD 20 85 98     JSR.W $9885                     ; Compute the neighboring tile offset into [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:92E0 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = [$04]; negative: no tile there
$04:92E2 30 1D        BMI $9301                       ; Negative offset: check the hardcoded paths
$04:92E4 C9 00 08     CMP.W #$0800                    ; Offset >= $0800?
$04:92E7 B0 18        BCS $9301                       ; Yes: off the map, check the hardcoded paths
$04:92E9 BF 00 C8 7E  LDA.L $7EC800,X                 ; \
$04:92ED 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = tile number of the neighboring tile
$04:92F0 F0 0F        BEQ $9301                       ; Empty tile (0): check the hardcoded paths
$04:92F2 C9 56 00     CMP.W #$0056                    ; Tile < $56 (path tile)?
$04:92F5 90 07        BCC $92FE                       ; Yes: walk onto it
$04:92F7 C9 87 00     CMP.W #$0087                    ; Tile < $87 (level tile)?
$04:92FA 90 02        BCC $92FE                       ; Yes: walk onto it
$04:92FC 80 03        BRA $9301                       ; Anything else: check the hardcoded paths
$04:92FE 82 83 00     BRL $9384                       ; Walk to the new tile ($049384)

; Logic: There is no tile in the direction the user pressed. Even so, this level may have a
; hardcoded path. Check for this. If it does, get the first tile for that path and make sure
; that it matches with the direction we pressed.
; This section is one big loop over the array at $9078. That is a byte array of level
; numbers that have hardcoded paths.
$04:9301 9C 78 1B     STZ.W $1B78                     ; [$1B78] = 0 (not on a hardcoded path)
$04:9304 9C 7A 1B     STZ.W $1B7A                     ; [$1B7A] = 0
$04:9307 A6 08        LDX $08                         ; X = [$08] (the level's tile offset)
$04:9309 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:930D 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = level number of the tile we stand on
$04:9310 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = level number
$04:9312 A2 09 00     LDX.W #$0009                    ; X = 9: loop over 10 paths
$04:9315 BD 78 90     LDA.W $9078,X                   ; \
$04:9318 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = level number of path X ($9078)
$04:931B C9 FF 00     CMP.W #$00FF                    ; \
$04:931E D0 29        BNE $9349                       ; / Not $FF: compare with our level at $049349
$04:9320 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$04:9321 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]
$04:9324 BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; A = player Y position
$04:9327 CD 82 90     CMP.W $9082                     ; \
$04:932A D0 1A        BNE $9346                       ; / Not the pipe's Y position: next path
$04:932C BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; A = player X position
$04:932F CD 84 90     CMP.W $9084                     ; \
$04:9332 D0 12        BNE $9346                       ; / Not the pipe's X position: next path
$04:9334 AD B3 0D     LDA.W $0DB3                     ; \
$04:9337 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } X = [$0DB3] (current player)
$04:933A AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:933B BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:933E 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Not on the main map (submap [$1F11,X] != 0): next path
$04:9341 D0 03        BNE $9346                       ; /
$04:9343 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$04:9344 80 07        BRA $934D                       ; Pipe matched: use this path
$04:9346 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$04:9347 80 2B        BRA $9374                       ; Next path

$04:9349 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; \
$04:934B D0 27        BNE $9374                       ; / Level number matches [$00]? Otherwise next path

; We have a match for a hardcoded path, either through level number or through character position.
; Now we have to see if the first tile of this path is appropriate for us to move though.
$04:934D 86 00        STX $00                         ; [$00] = path index
$04:934F BD 0E 91     LDA.W $910E,X                   ; \
$04:9352 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } X = offset of this path in the tile lists ($910E)
$04:9355 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:9356 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$04:9357 8D 7A 1B     STA.W $1B7A                     ; / [$1B7A] = offset - 1 (index of the last tile walked)
$04:935A 84 02        STY $02                         ; [$02] = pressed direction (Y)
$04:935C BD CA 90     LDA.W $90CA,X                   ; \
$04:935F 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } A = direction of the path's first tile ($90CA)
$04:9362 C5 02        CMP $02                         ; /
$04:9364 D0 14        BNE $937A                       ; Differs from the pressed direction: no path, give up
$04:9366 A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; \
$04:9369 8D 78 1B     STA.W $1B78                     ; / [$1B78] = 1: committed to a hardcoded path
$04:936C BD 86 90     LDA.W $9086,X                   ; \
$04:936F 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = first tile of the path ($9086)
$04:9372 80 10        BRA $9384                       ; Walk to that tile

$04:9374 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:9375 30 03        BMI $937A                       ; / Next path: X--, stop below 0
$04:9377 82 9B FF     BRL $9315                       ; Loop
$04:937A E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; \
$04:937C 9C D5 0D     STZ.W $0DD5                     ; } No path found: exit type [$0DD5] = 0
$04:937F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; /
$04:9381 4C 11 94     JMP.W $9411                     ; Leave through $049411

; Logic: Register A has the actual next tile in it, whether it came from a hardcoded path or
; from the overwrold.
; This section computes the offset values for the character to move. This matters because 
; the current tile is a level tile; it doesn't have intrinsic path data. So we have to generate
; some. in $00 and $02, but which dimension is X and Y is determined by the contents of Register X.
$04:9384 8D C1 13     STA.W $13C1                     ; [$13C1] = tile number we walk onto
$04:9387 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = tile number
$04:9389 64 02        STZ $02                         ; [$02] = 0
$04:938B A2 17 00     LDX.W #$0017                    ; X = $17: loop over 24 corner tiles
$04:938E BD 3C A0     LDA.W $A03C,X                   ; \
$04:9391 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = corner tile number ($A03C)
$04:9394 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; Compare with the destination tile
$04:9396 D0 1D        BNE $93B5                       ; No match: next corner tile
$04:9398 BD E4 A0     LDA.W $A0E4,X                   ; \
$04:939B 18           CLC                             ; } A = flags for this corner ($A0E4) + [$0DD6] (bit 2 = Luigi)
$04:939C 6D D6 0D     ADC.W $0DD6                     ; /
$04:939F 48           PHA                             ; Save the flags
$04:93A0 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:93A1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:93A2 0A           ASL                             ; } X = X * 4: index into the 4-byte offset table
$04:93A3 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:93A4 BD 84 A0     LDA.W $A084,X                   ; A = first offset ($A084)
$04:93A7 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = first offset
$04:93A9 BD 86 A0     LDA.W $A086,X                   ; A = second offset ($A086)
$04:93AC 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = second offset
$04:93AE 68           PLA                             ; Restore the flags
$04:93AF 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; Keep the low byte
$04:93B2 AA           TAX                             ; X = flags
$04:93B3 80 25        BRA $93DA                       ; Go store the offsets
$04:93B5 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:93B6 10 D6        BPL $938E                       ; / Next corner tile

$04:93B8 A2 08 00     LDX.W #$0008                    ; X = 8: plain step of 8 pixels
$04:93BB 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:93BC 29 02 00     AND.W #$0002                    ; } Down and right keep +8
$04:93BF D0 06        BNE $93C7                       ; /
$04:93C1 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:93C2 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; |
$04:93C5 1A           INC A                           ; } Up and left: X = -8
$04:93C6 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:93C7 86 00        STX $00                         ; [$00] = +8 or -8
$04:93C9 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0 if moving horizontally
$04:93CC C0 04 00     CPY.W #$0004                    ; Y >= 4 (left/right)?
$04:93CF B0 03        BCS $93D4                       ; Yes: X = 0
$04:93D1 A2 02 00     LDX.W #$0002                    ; No: X = 2 (vertical)
$04:93D4 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:93D5 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:93D6 6D D6 0D     ADC.W $0DD6                     ; } X = X + [$0DD6]: index into this player's X/Y position
$04:93D9 AA           TAX                             ; /

; Logic: The offsets have been computed, and in Register X is the switch that tells us
; which offset is horizontal and which is vertical, as well as which character to use.
; Apply those offsets now, set the character's sprite appropriately.
; Remember: Y still has the direction the user pressed.
$04:93DA A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:93DC 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:93DD 7D 17 1F     ADC.W $1F17,X                   ; } Target position (first axis) = position + [$00]; stored in [$0DC7,X]
$04:93E0 9D C7 0D     STA.W $0DC7,X                   ; /
$04:93E3 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:93E4 49 02 00     EOR.W #$0002                    ; } X = X xor 2: the other axis
$04:93E7 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:93E8 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:93EA 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:93EB 7D 17 1F     ADC.W $1F17,X                   ; } Target position (second axis) = position + [$02]
$04:93EE 9D C7 0D     STA.W $0DC7,X                   ; /
$04:93F1 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:93F2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:93F3 29 02 00     AND.W #$0002                    ; } X = player number * 2
$04:93F6 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:93F7 98           TYA                             ; A = direction
$04:93F8 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = direction
$04:93FA BD 13 1F     LDA.W $1F13,X                   ; A = player animation
$04:93FD 29 08 00     AND.W #$0008                    ; Keep the swimming bit
$04:9400 05 00        ORA $00                         ; Add the facing direction
$04:9402 9D 13 1F     STA.W $1F13,X                   ; Player now faces the way he walks
$04:9405 A9 0F 00     LDA.W #$000F                    ; \
$04:9408 8D 4E 14     STA.W $144E                     ; / [$144E] = $0F (idle timer)
$04:940B EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; Next overworld state: [$13D9]++ (player moves)
$04:940E 9C 44 14     STZ.W $1444                     ; [$1444] = 0
$04:9411 4C 31 98     JMP.W $9831                     ; Go to the next phase of overworld processing ($049831)

}

;;; $9414..942E: Data: overworld movement tables ;;;
{
;; Tables used by the movement code after this chunk. Meaning only partly known: scale bytes, word offsets and
;;     the d-pad direction bits.
$04:9414              .db $0D,$08                     ; Bytes $0D, $08 (indexed by [$1B80], used for scaling in the move code)

$04:9416              .db $EF,$FF,$D7,$FF             ; Words $FFEF, $FFD7 (-17, -41)

$04:941A              .db $11,$01,$31,$01             ; Words $0111, $0131

$04:941E              .db $08,$00,$04,$00,$02,$00,$01,$00 ; Words 8, 4, 2, 1: d-pad direction bits (up, down, left, right) as level flags
$04:9426              .db $44,$43,$45,$46,$47,$48,$25,$40 ; Tile numbers: $44,$43,$45,$46,$47,$48,$25,$40
$04:942E              .db $42,$4D                     ; Tile numbers: $42,$4D

}
