$04:9430              .db $0C                         ; (Tile or value, direction) pairs, 15 entries; first value $0C

$04:9431              .db $00,$0E,$00,$10,$06,$12,$00,$18 ; Pairs: (00),$0E,00,$10,06,$12,00,$18
$04:9439              .db $04,$1A,$02,$20,$06,$42,$06,$4E ; Pairs: 04,$1A,02,$20,06,$42,06,$4E
$04:9441              .db $04,$50,$02,$58,$06,$5A,$00,$70 ; Pairs: 04,$50,02,$58,06,$5A,00,$70
$04:9449              .db $06,$90,$00,$A0,$06         ; Pairs: 06,$90,00,$A0,06

}

;;; $944E..9456: Data: flags per tile/direction pair ;;;
{
$04:944E              .db $01,$01,$00,$01,$01,$00,$00,$00 ; Flags per pair above (0 or 1), indexed by pair number
$04:9456              .db $01,$00,$00,$01,$00,$01,$00 ; Flags per pair above (cont.)

}

;;; $945D: OW process 4: Mario walks along the path ;;;
{
;; Overworld process [$13D9] = 4 (entry 4 of PtrsLong04857D). Moves the current player ([$0DD6] = 0 Mario, 4
;;     Luigi) from tile to tile.
;; Destination [$0DC7]/[$0DC9] is the corner of the next path piece. The speed is split between the axes so
;;     the walk is straight: major axis
;; speed from $9414 (set [$1B80]), minor = major * minor distance / major distance; 8.8 fixed point,
;;     fraction kept in [$13D5]/[$13D7].
;; On arrival it picks the next direction (0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right, never reversing) from the tile map
;;     $7EC800 or the hardcoded path
;; ([$1B78]), rejects empty and non-walkable (>= $87) tiles, sets the sound, the exit flags in [$1EA2] and the
;;     walking animation [$1F13].
;; Level tile reached (tile step already begun, [$1444] set): writes the level name and advances to process 5.
;;     Special tiles start a submap
;; transition (process $0A).
;; $049831: shared tail, centers the BG1/BG2 scroll on the player (main map only), clamped to
;;     $9416/$941A. $04983F: entry for the camera only.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:97FE: OW process 4: Mario walks along the path
$04:945D AD D8 0D     LDA.W $0DD8                     ; [$0DD8] (probably a submap/transition pending flag) non-zero?
$04:9460 F0 06        BEQ $9468                       ; Zero: walk normally
$04:9462 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$04:9464 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / OW process [$13D9] = 8
$04:9467 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9468 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:946A AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:946D 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:946E 69 02 00     ADC.W #$0002                    ; } Y = [$0DD6] + 2: Y-axis entry of the current player (Mario 0, Luigi 4)
$04:9471 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:9472 A2 02 00     LDX.W #$0002                    ; X = 2: axis index (2 = Y, 0 = X)
$04:9475 B9 C7 0D     LDA.W $0DC7,Y                   ; \
$04:9478 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:9479 F9 17 1F     SBC.W $1F17,Y                   ; } [$00+X] = destination [$0DC7+Y] - current position [$1F17+Y] (signed distance left)
$04:947C 95 00        STA $00,X                       ; /
$04:947E 10 04        BPL $9484                       ; Positive: keep it
$04:9480 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$04:9483 1A           INC A                           ; / Negative: A = -A
$04:9484 95 04        STA $04,X                       ; [$04+X] = |distance| on this axis ([$04] = X, [$06] = Y)
$04:9486 88           DEY                             ; \
$04:9487 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:9488 CA           DEX                             ; } Y -= 2, X -= 2
$04:9489 CA           DEX                             ; /
$04:948A 10 E9        BPL $9475                       ; Loop for the X axis, then done
$04:948C A0 FF FF     LDY.W #$FFFF                    ; Y = -1: assume X is the major (longer) axis
$04:948F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:9491 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; |
$04:9493 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; } [$0A] = |dX| (major), [$0C] = |dY| (minor)
$04:9495 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; /
$04:9497 C5 04        CMP $04                         ; Compare |dY| with |dX|
$04:9499 90 09        BCC $94A4                       ; |dY| < |dX|: X is the major axis
$04:949B 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; \
$04:949D A5 04        LDA $04                         ; } Otherwise swap: [$0A] = |dY| (major), [$0C] = |dX| (minor)
$04:949F 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; /
$04:94A1 A0 01 00     LDY.W #$0001                    ; Y = 1: Y is the major axis
$04:94A4 84 08        STY $08                         ; [$08] = -1 (X major) or 1 (Y major)
$04:94A6 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:94A8 AE 80 1B     LDX.W $1B80                     ; X = [$1B80]: speed set (1 on tiles with property $14, else 0)
$04:94AB BD 14 94     LDA.W $9414,X                   ; \
$04:94AE 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:94AF 0A           ASL                             ; } A = $9414[X] * 16 (speed 13 or 8, scaled by 16)
$04:94B0 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:94B1 0A           ASL                             ; /
$04:94B2 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; Hardware multiplicand = speed * 16
$04:94B5 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; A = minor axis distance
$04:94B7 F0 21        BEQ $94DA                       ; Zero: minor axis speed is 0
$04:94B9 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; Hardware multiplier = minor distance
$04:94BC EA           NOP                             ; \
$04:94BD EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:94BE EA           NOP                             ; } Wait for the multiplier
$04:94BF EA           NOP                             ; /
$04:94C0 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:94C2 AD 16 42     LDA.W $4216                     ; \
$04:94C5 8D 04 42     STA.W $4204                     ; / Hardware dividend = speed * 16 * minor distance
$04:94C8 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:94CA A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$04:94CC 8D 06 42     STA.W $4206                     ; / Hardware divisor = major distance
$04:94CF EA           NOP                             ; \
$04:94D0 EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:94D1 EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:94D2 EA           NOP                             ; } Wait for the divider
$04:94D3 EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:94D4 EA           NOP                             ; /
$04:94D5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:94D7 AD 14 42     LDA.W $4214                     ; A = minor axis speed = major speed * minor / major (8.8 fixed point)
$04:94DA C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:94DC 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; [$0E] = minor axis speed
$04:94DE AE 80 1B     LDX.W $1B80                     ; X = [$1B80]
$04:94E1 BD 14 94     LDA.W $9414,X                   ; \
$04:94E4 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:94E7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:94E8 0A           ASL                             ; } A = $9414[X] * 16 (major axis speed, 8.8 fixed point)
$04:94E9 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:94EA 0A           ASL                             ; /
$04:94EB 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; [$0A] = major axis speed
$04:94ED A2 02 00     LDX.W #$0002                    ; X = 2: start with the Y axis
$04:94F0 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$04:94F2 30 04        BMI $94F8                       ; / A = [$08]; negative means X is the major axis
$04:94F4 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$04:94F6 80 02        BRA $94FA                       ; / Y is major: this axis gets the major speed

$04:94F8 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; X is major: the Y axis gets the minor speed
$04:94FA 34 00        BIT $00,X                       ; Test the sign of the distance on this axis
$04:94FC 10 04        BPL $9502                       ; Distance positive: keep the speed
$04:94FE 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$04:9501 1A           INC A                           ; / Distance negative: A = -A
$04:9502 9D CF 0D     STA.W $0DCF,X                   ; [$0DCF+X] = signed speed on this axis (X = 0: X speed, X = 2: Y speed)
$04:9505 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$04:9507 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; |
$04:950A 1A           INC A                           ; } [$08] = -[$08]: swap the roles for the other axis
$04:950B 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$04:950D CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:950E CA           DEX                             ; / X -= 2
$04:950F 10 DF        BPL $94F0                       ; Loop for the X axis too
$04:9511 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0
$04:9514 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$04:9516 30 03        BMI $951B                       ; / [$08] < 0 (X major): keep X = 0
$04:9518 A2 02 00     LDX.W #$0002                    ; Y major: X = 2
$04:951B B5 00        LDA $00,X                       ; A = remaining distance on the major axis
$04:951D F0 03        BEQ $9522                       ; Zero: reached the destination, handle arrival
$04:951F 4C 01 98     JMP.W $9801                     ; Not there yet: move this frame

$04:9522 AD 44 14     LDA.W $1444                     ; [$1444] (a tile step has been started) non-zero?
$04:9525 F0 35        BEQ $955C                       ; Zero: choose the next step
$04:9527 9C 78 1B     STZ.W $1B78                     ; Arrived: [$1B78] = 0 (no longer on the hardcoded path)
$04:952A AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]: current player * 4
$04:952D BD 1F 1F     LDA.W $1F1F,X                   ; \
$04:9530 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = player tile X ([$1F1F+X])
$04:9532 BD 21 1F     LDA.W $1F21,X                   ; \
$04:9535 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = player tile Y ([$1F21+X])
$04:9537 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:9538 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9539 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player index (0 Mario, 1 Luigi)
$04:953A AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:953B 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Calculate map tile position into [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:953E 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0
$04:9540 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile position
$04:9542 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:9546 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = level number of this tile ($7ED000)
$04:9549 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:954A AA           TAX                             ; / X = level number * 2
$04:954B BD FC A0     LDA.W LevelNames,X              ; A = LevelNames[level number]: level name string index
$04:954E 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = name index
$04:9550 20 07 9D     JSR.W $9D07                     ; Write the level name to the stripe image buffer ($9D07)
$04:9553 EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; OW process [$13D9]++ (next: level name display)
$04:9556 20 37 90     JSR.W $9037                     ; Save the level flags copy if [$13CA] is set ($9037)
$04:9559 4C 31 98     JMP.W $9831                     ; Go to the camera update

$04:955C AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; Not arrived at a tile yet: A = current OW tile [$13C1]
$04:955F 8D 7E 1B     STA.W $1B7E                     ; [$1B7E] = previous OW tile
$04:9562 A9 08 00     LDA.W #$0008                    ; \
$04:9565 85 08        STA $08                         ; / [$08] = 8: direction candidate counter
$04:9567 AC D3 0D     LDY.W $0DD3                     ; Y = [$0DD3]: current direction (0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right)
$04:956A 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:956B 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:956E 49 02 00     EOR.W #$0002                    ; } [$0A] = Y XOR 2: the reverse direction
$04:9571 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; /
$04:9573 80 0D        BRA $9582                       ; Try the current direction first

$04:9575 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$04:9577 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:9578 E9 02 00     SBC.W #$0002                    ; } [$08] -= 2: next candidate direction (6, 4, 2, 0)
$04:957B 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$04:957D C5 0A        CMP $0A                         ; \
$04:957F F0 F4        BEQ $9575                       ; / Skip the reverse direction
$04:9581 A8           TAY                             ; Y = candidate direction
$04:9582 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]
$04:9585 BD 1F 1F     LDA.W $1F1F,X                   ; \
$04:9588 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$04:958A BD 21 1F     LDA.W $1F21,X                   ; } [$00] = player tile X, [$02] = player tile Y
$04:958D 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$04:958F A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0: change tile X
$04:9592 C0 04 00     CPY.W #$0004                    ; \
$04:9595 B0 03        BCS $959A                       ; / Direction left or right (Y >= 4): keep X = 0
$04:9597 A2 02 00     LDX.W #$0002                    ; Direction up or down: X = 2 (change tile Y)
$04:959A B5 00        LDA $00,X                       ; \
$04:959C 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:959D 79 58 90     ADC.W $9058,Y                   ; } Tile coordinate += $9058[Y] (-1 or +1): the neighbour tile in that direction
$04:95A0 95 00        STA $00,X                       ; /
$04:95A2 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:95A5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:95A6 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player index
$04:95A7 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:95A8 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Calculate tile position of that neighbour into [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:95AB AD 78 1B     LDA.W $1B78                     ; Following the hardcoded path ([$1B78] non-zero)?
$04:95AE F0 1E        BEQ $95CE                       ; No: read the tile from the map
$04:95B0 84 06        STY $06                         ; [$06] = direction
$04:95B2 AE 7A 1B     LDX.W $1B7A                     ; \
$04:95B5 E8           INX                             ; / X = [$1B7A] + 1: next step of the hardcoded path
$04:95B6 BD CA 90     LDA.W $90CA,X                   ; \
$04:95B9 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Does the path step's direction ($90CA) equal the candidate direction?
$04:95BC C5 06        CMP $06                         ; /
$04:95BE D0 B5        BNE $9575                       ; No: try the next direction
$04:95C0 8E 7A 1B     STX.W $1B7A                     ; [$1B7A] = path step
$04:95C3 BD 86 90     LDA.W $9086,X                   ; \
$04:95C6 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = tile number of the path step ($9086)
$04:95C9 C9 58 00     CMP.W #$0058                    ; \
$04:95CC D0 10        BNE $95DE                       ; / Tile $58 (path end): read the real tile from the map, else use A
$04:95CE A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile position
$04:95D0 30 A3        BMI $9575                       ; Off the map: try the next direction
$04:95D2 C9 00 08     CMP.W #$0800                    ; \
$04:95D5 B0 9E        BCS $9575                       ; / Position out of range: try the next direction
$04:95D7 BF 00 C8 7E  LDA.L $7EC800,X                 ; \
$04:95DB 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / Load OW tile number from the map ($7EC800)
$04:95DE 8D C1 13     STA.W $13C1                     ; Set "Current OW tile"
$04:95E1 F0 92        BEQ $9575                       ; No tile: try the next direction
$04:95E3 C9 87 00     CMP.W #$0087                    ; \
$04:95E6 B0 8D        BCS $9575                       ; / Tile >= $87: not walkable, try the next direction
$04:95E8 48           PHA                             ; Save tile number
$04:95E9 5A           PHY                             ; Save direction
$04:95EA AA           TAX                             ; \
$04:95EB CA           DEX                             ; / X = tile number - 1
$04:95EC A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0
$04:95EF BD EB 9F     LDA.W $9FEB,X                   ; A = tile property byte ($9FEB)
$04:95F2 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; [$0E] = tile property (used for the walking animation)
$04:95F4 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; \
$04:95F7 C9 14 00     CMP.W #$0014                    ; / Property low byte = $14?
$04:95FA D0 03        BNE $95FF                       ; No: speed set 0
$04:95FC A0 01 00     LDY.W #$0001                    ; Yes: speed set 1 (slower walking speed, $9414)
$04:95FF 8C 80 1B     STY.W $1B80                     ; [$1B80] = speed set
$04:9602 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]
$04:9605 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:9607 9D 1F 1F     STA.W $1F1F,X                   ; / Player tile X = new tile X
$04:960A A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:960C 9D 21 1F     STA.W $1F21,X                   ; / Player tile Y = new tile Y
$04:960F 7A           PLY                             ; Restore direction
$04:9610 68           PLA                             ; \
$04:9611 48           PHA                             ; / Restore tile number (kept on the stack)
$04:9612 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:9614 A2 09        LDX.B #$09                      ; X = 9: 10 submap transition tiles
$04:9616 DD 26 94     CMP.W $9426,X                   ; \
$04:9619 D0 2A        BNE $9645                       ; / Is the tile $9426[X]? No: next entry
$04:961B 5A           PHY                             ; Match: save direction
$04:961C 20 24 9A     JSR.W $9A24                     ; Look up the submap transition for the current position ($9A24)
$04:961F 7A           PLY                             ; Restore direction
$04:9620 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$04:9622 8D 9E 1B     STA.W $1B9E                     ; / [$1B9E] = 1
$04:9625 20 07 F4     JSR.W $F407                     ; Clear window mirrors [$41]-[$43] and HDMA enable ($F407)
$04:9628 9C 8C 1B     STZ.W $1B8C                     ; [$1B8C] = 0
$04:962B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:962D 9C 01 07     STZ.W $0701                     ; [$0701] = 0 (backdrop color)
$04:9630 A9 00 70     LDA.W #$7000                    ; \
$04:9633 8D 8D 1B     STA.W $1B8D                     ; / [$1B8D] = $7000

$04:9695 C9 5B 00     CMP.W #$005B                    ; \

$04:96A7 EA           NOP                             ; /

$04:97B4 9D C7 0D     STA.W $0DC7,X                   ; /

$04:9884 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $9885: Calculate OW tile position; process $0C (OW_TilePos_Calc) ;;;
{
;; OW_TilePos_Calc: converts tile coordinates to an offset into the 32x32 tile map arrays ($7EC800 tiles,
;;     $7ED000 level numbers).
;; The map is 2 screens wide and 2 high: offset = (X & $F) + ((X & $10) << 4) + ((Y << 4) & $FF) + (Y & $10 ?
;;     $200 : 0) + (submap ? $400 : 0).
;; Parameters: [$00] = tile X, [$02] = tile Y (16-bit), X = player index (0 Mario, 1 Luigi). Returns: [$04] =
;;     offset.
;; $0498C6 (separate routine): overworld process $0C. Mario rises 1 pixel every second frame until [$1F19] low
;;     = $78, then process 0 and the
;; game is saved ($9BC9). Probably the end-of-game or cutscene finish.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:8E0B: Overworld load: reset poses, set music
;;     $04:8E73: Overworld setup and process 0 (level exit)
;;     $04:8F2E: Overworld setup and process 0 (level exit)
;;     $04:9020: Overworld state 2: after level, save data
;;     $04:920A: Overworld: enter level, then walk (OWPU_EnterLevel)
;;     $04:92DD: Overworld: start walking from a level tile (OWPU_NotAutoWalk)
;;     $04:953B: OW process 4: Mario walks along the path
;;     $04:95A8: OW process 4: Mario walks along the path
;;     $04:9933: Set level exit flag from tile exit data
$04:9885 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:9887 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$04:988A 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$04:988C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$04:988E 29 10 00     AND.W #$0010                    ; |
$04:9891 0A           ASL                             ; } [$04] = (X & $F) + ((X & $10) << 4): tile X part of the offset
$04:9892 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:9893 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:9894 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:9895 65 04        ADC $04                         ; |
$04:9897 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$04:9899 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:989B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:989C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:989D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:989E 0A           ASL                             ; } [$04] += (Y << 4) & $FF
$04:989F 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:98A2 65 04        ADC $04                         ; |
$04:98A4 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$04:98A6 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:98A8 29 10 00     AND.W #$0010                    ; } Bit 4 of Y clear: skip
$04:98AB F0 08        BEQ $98B5                       ; /
$04:98AD A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:98AF 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:98B0 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; } [$04] += $200 (lower screen of the map)
$04:98B3 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$04:98B5 BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:98B8 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } X = player index; A = [$1F11+X] (submap); main map (0): done
$04:98BB F0 08        BEQ $98C5                       ; /
$04:98BD A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:98BF 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:98C0 69 00 04     ADC.W #$0400                    ; } On a submap: [$04] += $400
$04:98C3 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$04:98C5 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:98C6 9C 13 1F     STZ.W $1F13                     ; [$1F13] = 0 (Mario animation: standing)
$04:98C9 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$04:98CB 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:98CC 6D D7 13     ADC.W $13D7                     ; } Sub-pixel accumulator [$13D7] += $80
$04:98CF 8D D7 13     STA.W $13D7                     ; /
$04:98D2 08           PHP                             ; Save carry
$04:98D3 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$04:98D5 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; / A = $0F; compare with 8 (carry set)
$04:98D7 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$04:98D9 90 03        BCC $98DE                       ; Carry clear: skip
$04:98DB 09 F0        ORA.B #$F0                      ; A = $FF (-1)
$04:98DD 88           DEY                             ; Y = $FF (high byte of -1)
$04:98DE 28           PLP                             ; Restore the carry from the sub-pixel add
$04:98DF 6D 19 1F     ADC.W $1F19                     ; \
$04:98E2 8D 19 1F     STA.W $1F19                     ; / Mario Y position low [$1F19] += -1 + carry
$04:98E5 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:98E6 6D 1A 1F     ADC.W $1F1A                     ; } Mario Y position high [$1F1A] += $FF + carry (so Mario moves up 1 pixel every second frame)
$04:98E9 8D 1A 1F     STA.W $1F1A                     ; /
$04:98EC AD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19                     ; \
$04:98EF C9 78        CMP.B #$78                      ; / Mario Y low = $78?
$04:98F1 D0 07        BNE $98FA                       ; No: keep moving
$04:98F3 9C D9 13     STZ.W $13D9                     ; OW process [$13D9] = 0
$04:98F6 22 C9 9B 00  JSL.L $9BC9                     ; Save the game ($9BC9)
$04:98FA 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $98FB..98FB: Unused: exit direction bit table ;;;
{
$04:98FB              .db $08,$00,$04,$00,$02,$00,$01,$00 ; $08, $04, $02, $01 as words (copy of $941E, unused)

}

;;; $9903: Set level exit flag from tile exit data ;;;
{
;; Called by overworld process 2 ($8F87). If [$0DD5] is a positive step count, takes the player's tile
;;     and reads a 2-bit field of the
;; byte at $7ED800 (shift count from $9060), then sets the matching direction bit ($941E: 8 up, 4
;;     down, 2 left, 1 right)
;; in the level flags [$1EA2 + level number of the tile]. Also stores the player's tile coordinates in
;;     [$1F1F]/[$1F21].
;; Called by:
;;     $04:8F87: Overworld state 2: after level, save data
$04:9903 AE D5 0D     LDX.W $0DD5                     ; X = [$0DD5] (auto-walk / event direction)
$04:9906 F0 BD        BEQ $98C5                       ; Zero: return
$04:9908 30 BB        BMI $98C5                       ; Negative: return
$04:990A CA           DEX                             ; X--
$04:990B BD 60 90     LDA.W $9060,X                   ; A = $9060[X]: bit shift count (5, 3, 1, 0)
$04:990E 85 08        STA $08                         ; [$08] = shift count
$04:9910 64 09        STZ $09                         ; [$09] = 0
$04:9912 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9914 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]
$04:9917 BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; \
$04:991A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:991B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:991C 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = player X position / 16 (tile X)
$04:991D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:991E 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:9920 9D 1F 1F     STA.W $1F1F,X                   ; [$1F1F+X] = tile X
$04:9923 BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:9926 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9927 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9928 4A           LSR                             ; } [$02] = player Y position / 16 (tile Y)
$04:9929 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:992A 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$04:992C 9D 21 1F     STA.W $1F21,X                   ; [$1F21+X] = tile Y
$04:992F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:9930 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9931 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player index
$04:9932 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:9933 20 85 98     JSR.W OW_TilePos_Calc           ; Calculate map tile position into [$04] (OW_TilePos_Calc)
$04:9936 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$04:9938 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile position
$04:993A BF 00 D8 7E  LDA.L $7ED800,X                 ; \
$04:993E 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = [$7ED800+X]: packed 2-bit fields per tile (exit info)
$04:9941 A6 08        LDX $08                         ; X = shift count
$04:9943 F0 04        BEQ $9949                       ; Zero: no shift
$04:9945 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:9946 CA           DEX                             ; } A >>= [$08]
$04:9947 10 FC        BPL $9945                       ; /
$04:9949 29 03 00     AND.W #$0003                    ; \
$04:994C 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = (A & 3) * 2: selects an exit direction bit
$04:994D A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:994E A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile position
$04:9950 BF 00 D0 7E  LDA.L $7ED000,X                 ; \
$04:9954 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / A = level number of this tile ($7ED000)
$04:9957 AA           TAX                             ; X = level number
$04:9958 B9 1E 94     LDA.W $941E,Y                   ; \
$04:995B 1D A2 1E     ORA.W $1EA2,X                   ; } Set the exit bit in [$1EA2+X] (bits from $941E)
$04:995E 9D A2 1E     STA.W $1EA2,X                   ; /
$04:9961 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:9963 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9964..99A8: Table: submap transition trigger positions ;;;
{
;; 14 entries of 5 bytes: Y position (word), X position (word), submap number. Read by $9A24 with the
;;     matching entries of
;; $99AA (destination) and $99F0 (destination tile).
$04:9964              .db $40,$01                     ; e0: Y=$0140 X=$0028 submap 0

$04:9966              .db $28,$00                     ; (continuation of the previous entry)

$04:9968              .db $00,$50,$01,$58,$00,$00,$10,$00 ; e1: Y=$0150 X=$0058 submap 0; e2: Y=$0010 X=$0048 submap 1
$04:9970              .db $48,$00,$01,$10,$00,$98,$00,$01 ; e3: Y=$0010 X=$0098 submap 1
$04:9978              .db $A0,$00,$D8,$00,$00,$40,$01,$58 ; e4: Y=$00A0 X=$00D8 submap 0; e5: Y=$0140 X=$0058 submap 2
$04:9980              .db $00,$02,$90,$00,$E8,$01,$04,$60 ; e6: Y=$0090 X=$01E8 submap 4; e7: Y=$0160 X=$00E8 submap 0
$04:9988              .db $01,$E8,$00,$00,$A0,$00,$C8,$01 ; e8: Y=$00A0 X=$01C8 submap 0
$04:9990              .db $00,$60,$01,$88,$00,$03,$08,$01 ; e9: Y=$0160 X=$0088 submap 3; e10: Y=$0108 X=$0190 submap 0
$04:9998              .db $90,$01,$00,$E8,$01,$10,$00,$03 ; e11: Y=$01E8 X=$0010 submap 3
$04:99A0              .db $10,$01,$C8,$01,$00,$F0,$01,$88 ; e12: Y=$0110 X=$01C8 submap 0; e13: Y=$01F0 X=$0088 submap 3
$04:99A8              .db $00,$03                     ; (continuation of the previous entry)

}

;;; $99AA..99EE: Table: submap transition destinations ;;;
{
;; 14 entries of 5 bytes: new Y position (word), new X position (word), new submap number.
$04:99AA              .db $00,$00                     ; e0: Y=$0000 X=$0048 submap 1

$04:99AC              .db $48,$00                     ; (continuation of the previous entry)

$04:99AE              .db $01,$00,$00,$98,$00,$01,$50,$01 ; e1: Y=$0000 X=$0098 submap 1; e2: Y=$0150 X=$0028 submap 0
$04:99B6              .db $28,$00,$00,$60,$01,$58,$00,$00 ; e3: Y=$0160 X=$0058 submap 0
$04:99BE              .db $50,$01,$58,$00,$02,$90,$00,$D8 ; e4: Y=$0150 X=$0058 submap 2; e5: Y=$0090 X=$00D8 submap 0
$04:99C6              .db $00,$00,$50,$01,$E8,$00,$00,$A0 ; e6: Y=$0150 X=$00E8 submap 0; e7: Y=$00A0 X=$01E8 submap 4
$04:99CE              .db $00,$E8,$01,$04,$50,$01,$88,$00 ; e8: Y=$0150 X=$0088 submap 3
$04:99D6              .db $03,$B0,$00,$C8,$01,$00,$E8,$01 ; e9: Y=$00B0 X=$01C8 submap 0; e10: Y=$01E8 X=$0000 submap 3
$04:99DE              .db $00,$00,$03,$08,$01,$A0,$01,$00 ; e11: Y=$0108 X=$01A0 submap 0
$04:99E6              .db $00,$02,$88,$00,$03,$00,$01,$C8 ; e12: Y=$0200 X=$0088 submap 3; e13: Y=$0100 X=$01C8 submap 0
$04:99EE              .db $01,$00                     ; (continuation of the previous entry)

}

;;; $99F0..9A09: Table: submap transition destination tiles ;;;
{
;; 14 entries of 2 bytes: tile Y, tile X of the destination, stored in [$1F21] and [$1F1F].
$04:99F0              .db $00                         ; e0: tile Y=$00 X=$04

$04:99F1              .db $04,$00,$09,$14,$02,$15,$05,$14 ; e1: tile Y=$00 X=$09; e2: tile Y=$14 X=$02; e3: tile Y=$15 X=$05; e4: tile Y=$14 X=$05
$04:99F9              .db $05,$09,$0D,$15,$0E,$09,$1E,$15 ; e5: tile Y=$09 X=$0D; e6: tile Y=$15 X=$0E; e7: tile Y=$09 X=$1E; e8: tile Y=$15 X=$08
$04:9A01              .db $08,$0A,$1C,$1E,$00,$10,$19,$1F ; e9: tile Y=$0A X=$1C; e10: tile Y=$1E X=$00; e11: tile Y=$10 X=$19; e12: tile Y=$1F X=$08
$04:9A09              .db $08,$10,$1C                 ; e13: tile Y=$10 X=$1C

}

;;; $9A0C..9A1E: Table: submap scroll boundaries ;;;
{
;; Six entries of 4 bytes, for submaps 1 to 6: BG1/BG2 X scroll (word), Y scroll (word). Indexed by (submap -
;;     1) * 4 in $9A93.
$04:9A0C              .db $EF,$FF                     ; submap 1 X=$FFEF

$04:9A0E              .db $D8,$FF,$EF,$FF,$80,$00,$EF,$FF ; submap 1 Y=$FFD8; submap 2 X=$FFEF; submap 2 Y=$0080; submap 3 X=$FFEF
$04:9A16              .db $28,$01,$F0,$00,$D8,$FF,$F0,$00 ; submap 3 Y=$0128; submap 4 X=$00F0; submap 4 Y=$FFD8; submap 5 X=$00F0
$04:9A1E              .db $80,$00,$F0,$00,$28,$01     ; submap 5 Y=$0080; submap 6 X=$00F0; submap 6 Y=$0128

}

;;; $9A24: Submap transition: warp and set scroll ;;;
{
;; $9A24: looks the player's Y position, X position and submap up in the 14 entries of $9964. On a
;;     match it moves the player to
;; the destination position, tile coordinates and submap [$13C3] from $99AA/AC/AE and $99F0/F1.
;; $049A93: stores [$13C3] as the player's submap [$1F11] and loads the BG1/BG2 scroll from $9A0C
;;     (submap 0: updates the
;; camera from the player position via $04983F instead). Called from $856F and $DB5C.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:961C: OW process 4: Mario walks along the path
$04:9A24 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9A26 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:9A29 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9A2A 4A           LSR                             ; } X = player index
$04:9A2B AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:9A2C BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:9A2F 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$13C3] = player's current submap
$04:9A32 8D C3 13     STA.W $13C3                     ; /
$04:9A35 A9 1A 00     LDA.W #$001A                    ; \
$04:9A38 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $1A: index of the last entry in the tile table ($99F0)
$04:9A3A A0 41        LDY.B #$41                      ; Y = $41: index of the last entry in the five-byte tables (14 entries)
$04:9A3C AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]
$04:9A3F BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:9A42 D9 64 99     CMP.W $9964,Y                   ; / Player Y position = entry Y position ($9964)?
$04:9A45 D0 3E        BNE $9A85                       ; No: next entry
$04:9A47 BD 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,X                   ; \
$04:9A4A D9 66 99     CMP.W $9966,Y                   ; / Player X position = entry X position ($9966)?
$04:9A4D D0 36        BNE $9A85                       ; No: next entry
$04:9A4F B9 68 99     LDA.W $9968,Y                   ; \
$04:9A52 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Entry's submap ($9968) = current submap?
$04:9A55 CD C3 13     CMP.W $13C3                     ; /
$04:9A58 D0 2B        BNE $9A85                       ; No: next entry
$04:9A5A B9 AA 99     LDA.W $99AA,Y                   ; \
$04:9A5D 9D 19 1F     STA.W $1F19,X                   ; / Player Y position = destination Y ($99AA)
$04:9A60 B9 AC 99     LDA.W $99AC,Y                   ; \
$04:9A63 9D 17 1F     STA.W $1F17,X                   ; / Player X position = destination X ($99AC)
$04:9A66 B9 AE 99     LDA.W $99AE,Y                   ; \
$04:9A69 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$13C3] = destination submap ($99AE)
$04:9A6C 8D C3 13     STA.W $13C3                     ; /
$04:9A6F A4 02        LDY $02                         ; Y = [$02]: index into the tile table
$04:9A71 B9 F0 99     LDA.W $99F0,Y                   ; \
$04:9A74 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Player tile Y [$1F21+X] = $99F0[Y]
$04:9A77 9D 21 1F     STA.W $1F21,X                   ; /
$04:9A7A B9 F1 99     LDA.W $99F1,Y                   ; \
$04:9A7D 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Player tile X [$1F1F+X] = $99F1[Y]
$04:9A80 9D 1F 1F     STA.W $1F1F,X                   ; /
$04:9A83 80 0B        BRA $9A90                       ; Done

$04:9A85 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$04:9A87 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; / [$02] -= 2
$04:9A89 88           DEY                             ; \
$04:9A8A 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:9A8B 88           DEY                             ; } Y -= 5: previous entry
$04:9A8C 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:9A8D 88           DEY                             ; /
$04:9A8E 10 AF        BPL $9A3F                       ; Loop over all 14 entries
$04:9A90 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:9A92 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9A93 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:9A96 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:9A99 4A           LSR                             ; } A = player index; X = index of the player's submap byte
$04:9A9A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9A9B AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:9A9C BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:9A9F 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; |
$04:9AA2 0D C3 13     ORA.W $13C3                     ; } [$1F11+X] low byte (submap) = [$13C3]
$04:9AA5 9D 11 1F     STA.W $1F11,X                   ; /
$04:9AA8 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; \
$04:9AAB D0 03        BNE $9AB0                       ; / Submap non-zero?
$04:9AAD 4C 3F 98     JMP.W $983F                     ; Main map: update the camera ($983F)

$04:9AB0 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$04:9AB1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:9AB2 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = (submap - 1) * 4: index into the scroll boundary table
$04:9AB3 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:9AB4 B9 0C 9A     LDA.W $9A0C,Y                   ; \
$04:9AB7 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } BG1/BG2 X scroll [$1A], [$1E] = $9A0C[Y]
$04:9AB9 85 1E        STA $1E                         ; /
$04:9ABB B9 0E 9A     LDA.W $9A0E,Y                   ; \
$04:9ABE 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } BG1/BG2 Y scroll [$1C], [$20] = $9A0E[Y]
$04:9AC0 85 20        STA $20                         ; /
$04:9AC2 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:9AC4 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$04:9D07 AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; A = stripe image buffer write index [$7F:837B]
$04:9D0B AA           TAX                             ; X = write index
$04:9D0C 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:9D0D 69 26 00     ADC.W #$0026                    ; } [$02] = [X] + $26: end limit of the 19-tile name field
$04:9D10 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$04:9D12 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:9D13 69 04 00     ADC.W #$0004                    ; } Buffer write index [$7F:837B] = [X] + $2A (4 header bytes + $26 data)
$04:9D16 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; /
$04:9D1A A9 00 25     LDA.W #$2500                    ; \
$04:9D1D 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; / Record length word = $0025: $26 bytes of tile data
$04:9D21 A9 50 8B     LDA.W #$8B50                    ; \
$04:9D24 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Record VRAM address = $508B (BG3 tilemap, level name line)
$04:9D28 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$04:9D2A 29 7F 00     AND.W #$007F                    ; |
$04:9D2D 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = ([$01] & $7F) * 2: index of the first word
$04:9D2E A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:9D2F B9 91 9C     LDA.W $9C91,Y                   ; \
$04:9D32 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = string offset of word 1 ($9C91)
$04:9D33 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:9D35 B9 C5 9A     LDA.W LevelNameStrings,Y        ; \
$04:9D38 30 03        BMI $9D3D                       ; / Word 1 starts with an end marker (bit 7 set): empty, skip it
$04:9D3A 20 7F 9D     JSR.W $9D7F                     ; Copy word 1 to the buffer
$04:9D3D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9D3F A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:9D41 29 F0 00     AND.W #$00F0                    ; |
$04:9D44 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9D45 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:9D46 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = ([$00] & $F0) >> 3: 2 * high nibble of [$00], index of word 2
$04:9D47 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:9D48 B9 CF 9C     LDA.W $9CCF,Y                   ; \
$04:9D4B A8           TAY                             ; / Y = string offset of word 2 ($9CCF)
$04:9D4C E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:9D4E B9 C5 9A     LDA.W LevelNameStrings,Y        ; \
$04:9D51 C9 9F        CMP.B #$9F                      ; } Word 2 is just a blank ($9F): skip it
$04:9D53 F0 03        BEQ $9D58                       ; /
$04:9D55 20 7F 9D     JSR.W $9D7F                     ; Copy word 2 to the buffer
$04:9D58 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9D5A A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:9D5C 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$04:9D5F 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = ([$00] & $0F) * 2: index of word 3
$04:9D60 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:9D61 B9 ED 9C     LDA.W $9CED,Y                   ; \
$04:9D64 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = string offset of word 3 ($9CED)
$04:9D65 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:9D67 20 7F 9D     JSR.W $9D7F                     ; Copy word 3 to the buffer
$04:9D6A E4 02        CPX $02                         ; \
$04:9D6C B0 08        BCS $9D76                       ; / Name field full ([X] >= [$02])? Then finish
$04:9D6E A0 CB 01     LDY.W #$01CB                    ; Y = $01CB: offset of the blank word
$04:9D71 20 7F 9D     JSR.W $9D7F                     ; Pad the field with a blank tile
$04:9D74 80 F4        BRA $9D6A                       ; Repeat until the field is full

$04:9D76 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$04:9D78 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; / Stripe image end marker $FF after the name
$04:9D7C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9D7E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9D7F B9 C5 9A     LDA.W LevelNameStrings,Y        ; A = next character of the word (bit 7 = last character)
$04:9D82 08           PHP                             ; Save its end bit (N flag)
$04:9D83 E4 02        CPX $02                         ; \
$04:9D85 B0 0E        BCS $9D95                       ; / Field full: skip the store, keep reading to the end of the word
$04:9D87 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; \
$04:9D89 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; / Store the tile number (end bit cleared)
$04:9D8D A9 39        LDA.B #$39                      ; \
$04:9D8F 9F 82 83 7F  STA.L $7F8382,X                 ; / Store the tile attributes $39 (palette 6, high priority)
$04:9D93 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:9D94 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2: next tile slot
$04:9D95 C8           INY                             ; Next character
$04:9D96 28           PLP                             ; Restore the end bit
$04:9D97 10 E6        BPL $9D7F                       ; More characters in this word: loop
$04:9D99 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9D9A AD B2 0D     LDA.W $0DB2                     ; A = [$0DB2] (2 player game flag)
$04:9D9D F0 10        BEQ $9DAF                       ; One player: nothing to switch, go to $049DAF
$04:9D9F AD B3 0D     LDA.W $0DB3                     ; \
$04:9DA2 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } X = the other player (current player [$0DB3] EOR 1)
$04:9DA4 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:9DA5 BD B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; \
$04:9DA8 30 05        BMI $9DAF                       ; / Other player's lives negative (game over): no switch
$04:9DAA AD D5 0D     LDA.W $0DD5                     ; \
$04:9DAD D0 0D        BNE $9DBC                       ; / [$0DD5] non-zero (probably a player switch is requested): go to $049DBC
$04:9DAF A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$04:9DB1 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / Overworld process [$13D9] = 3 (probably normal overworld control)
$04:9DB4 9C D5 0D     STZ.W $0DD5                     ; Clear [$0DD5]
$04:9DB7 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:9DB9 4C 31 98     JMP.W $9831                     ; Continue the overworld process ($049831)

$04:9DBC CE B1 0D     DEC.W $0DB1                     ; \
$04:9DBF 10 0B        BPL $9DCC                       ; / Timer [$0DB1]--; still >= 0: skip to $049DCC
$04:9DC1 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:9DC3 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; / Timer [$0DB1] = 2
$04:9DC6 9C D5 0D     STZ.W $0DD5                     ; Clear [$0DD5]
$04:9DC9 EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; Next overworld process (fade out)
$04:9DCC C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:9DCE 4C 31 98     JMP.W $9831                     ; Continue the overworld process ($049831)

$04:9DD1 AD B3 0D     LDA.W $0DB3                     ; \
$04:9DD4 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Toggle current player [$0DB3] (0 = Mario, 1 = Luigi)
$04:9DD6 8D B3 0D     STA.W $0DB3                     ; /
$04:9DD9 AA           TAX                             ; X = new current player
$04:9DDA BD B6 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerCoins,X         ; \
$04:9DDD 8D BF 0D     STA.W RAM_StatusCoins           ; / Status bar coins = this player's coins
$04:9DE0 BD B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; \
$04:9DE3 8D BE 0D     STA.W RAM_StatusLives           ; / Status bar lives = this player's lives
$04:9DE6 BD B8 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerPowerUp,X       ; \
$04:9DE9 85 19        STA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; / Mario power-up [$19] = this player's power-up
$04:9DEB BD BA 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlyrYoshiColor,X      ; \
$04:9DEE 8D C1 0D     STA.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; |
$04:9DF1 8D C7 13     STA.W RAM_YoshiColor            ; } Yoshi color -> overworld has-Yoshi flag, Yoshi color and on-Yoshi flag
$04:9DF4 8D 7A 18     STA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; /
$04:9DF7 BD BC 0D     LDA.W $0DBC,X                   ; \
$04:9DFA 8D C2 0D     STA.W $0DC2                     ; / Reserve item [$0DC2] = this player's reserve item [$0DBC]
$04:9DFD 22 F2 DB 05  JSL.L $DBF2                     ; Queue a stripe image at $7F:837D ($DBF2, probably the player name text)
$04:9E01 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9E03 20 55 8E     JSR.W $8E55                     ; Set [$0DD6] = player * 4 and load that player's map position ($8E55)
$04:9E06 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:9E08 AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; \
$04:9E0B BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; |
$04:9E0E 8D C3 13     STA.W $13C3                     ; / [$13C3] = new player's submap [$1F11+X]
$04:9E11 9C C4 13     STZ.W $13C4                     ; Clear [$13C4]
$04:9E14 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:9E16 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; / Timer [$0DB1] = 2
$04:9E19 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$04:9E1B 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / Overworld process [$13D9] = $0A
$04:9E1E EE D8 0D     INC.W $0DD8                     ; [$0DD8]++ (probably counts player switches)
$04:9E21 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9E22 CE B1 0D     DEC.W $0DB1                     ; \
$04:9E25 10 24        BPL $9E4B                       ; / Timer [$0DB1]--; return until it goes negative
$04:9E27 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:9E29 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; / Timer [$0DB1] = 2 (step every 3 frames)
$04:9E2C AE AF 0D     LDX.W $0DAF                     ; X = [$0DAF]: fade direction (0 = in, 1 = out)
$04:9E2F AD AE 0D     LDA.W $0DAE                     ; \
$04:9E32 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:9E33 7F 2F 9F 00  ADC.L $9F2F,X                   ; } Brightness [$0DAE] += step (+1 / -1, $9F2F)
$04:9E37 8D AE 0D     STA.W $0DAE                     ; /
$04:9E3A DF 33 9F 00  CMP.L $9F33,X                   ; \
$04:9E3E D0 0B        BNE $9E4B                       ; / Not at the target yet ($0F in, $00 out, $9F33): return
$04:9E40 EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; Fade done: next overworld process
$04:9E43 AD AF 0D     LDA.W $0DAF                     ; \
$04:9E46 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Toggle fade direction [$0DAF]
$04:9E48 8D AF 0D     STA.W $0DAF                     ; /
$04:9E4B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9E4C A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$04:9E4E 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / Overworld process [$13D9] = 3 (probably normal overworld control)
$04:9E51 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9E52 AD F7 1D     LDA.W $1DF7                     ; A = [$1DF7]: star warp fly speed
$04:9E55 D0 0C        BNE $9E63                       ; Already flying: go to $049E63
$04:9E57 EE F8 1D     INC.W $1DF8                     ; \
$04:9E5A AD F8 1D     LDA.W $1DF8                     ; |
$04:9E5D C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; } Ground timer [$1DF8]++ ($31 = take off)
$04:9E5F D0 32        BNE $9E93                       ; /
$04:9E61 80 06        BRA $9E69                       ; Timer expired: start flying ($049E69)

$04:9E63 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:9E65 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Speed up only every 8th frame, else go to $049E78
$04:9E67 D0 0F        BNE $9E78                       ; /
$04:9E69 EE F7 1D     INC.W $1DF7                     ; \
$04:9E6C AD F7 1D     LDA.W $1DF7                     ; |
$04:9E6F C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; |
$04:9E71 D0 05        BNE $9E78                       ; |
$04:9E73 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; } Fly speed [$1DF7]++, wrapped back to 4 when it reaches 5
$04:9E75 8D F7 1D     STA.W $1DF7                     ; /
$04:9E78 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:9E7A AD F7 1D     LDA.W $1DF7                     ; \
$04:9E7D 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$00] = fly speed [$1DF7]
$04:9E80 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:9E82 AE D6 0D     LDX.W $0DD6                     ; X = [$0DD6]: player * 4
$04:9E85 BD 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,X                   ; \
$04:9E88 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:9E89 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Player's map Y position [$1F19+X] -= fly speed (moves up)
$04:9E8B 9D 19 1F     STA.W $1F19,X                   ; /
$04:9E8E 38           SEC                             ; \
$04:9E8F E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Position - screen top [$1C]; negative: flew off the screen
$04:9E91 30 03        BMI $9E96                       ; /
$04:9E93 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:9E95 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:9E96 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:9E98 4C 8D 91     JMP.W $918D                     ; Finish the star warp ($918D)

$04:9E9B A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Unused. Y = 0
$04:9E9D C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; \
$04:9E9F 90 05        BCC $9EA6                       ; |
$04:9EA1 E9 0A        SBC.B #$0A                      ; } While A >= $0A: A -= $0A, Y++ (A = A mod 10, Y = A / 10)
$04:9EA3 C8           INY                             ; |
$04:9EA4 80 F7        BRA $9E9D                       ; /

$04:9EA6 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $A0FC: Level names, OW border, OW map setup (LevelNames) ;;;
{
;; Overworld data followed by the routines that use it. Parts, in order:
;; $04A0FC: level name codes, one 16-bit word per level number ($7E:D000 map value, $00-$5C, then $FFFF
;;     padding up to $04A3FF).
;; Probably: high byte (bits 0-6) = index into $9C91 for the first name word, low byte high/low nibbles
;;     = $9CCF / $9CED entries.
;; $04A400: stripe image #6 (overworld border; see ImagePointers) in LoadScrnImage record format, ends with
;;     $FF at $04A532.
;; $04A533: RLE-compressed overworld tilemaps: tile number bytes ($04A533-$04C02A) then tile property bytes
;;     ($04C02B-$04D677), each
;; decoded by $DABA to every other byte of $7F:4000 (header bit 7 clear: n+1 literal bytes, set: one
;;     byte repeated n+1 times).
;; $04D678: per-level byte table copied to $7E:D800 by $D7F2 (index = level number, entry 0 unused).
;; $04D6E9 (long call, from $00:A165 during overworld load): renders the overworld layer 1 tilemap row by row
;;     with the level renderer,
;; then DMAs the decompressed map from $7F:4000 (submap: $7F:6000) to VRAM $3000. Quirk: the submap flag is
;;     [$1F11 + player].
;; $04D770: stores A at index X in 31 tables of $1B0 bytes each starting at $7F:C800 (strides of $1B0), then
;;     X++.
;; $04D7F2: builds the level number map $7E:D000 (each tile $56-$80 of $7E:C800 gets the next number, from 1)
;;     and the byte table $7E:D800,
;; then calls $DA49 for every level $00-$6E so beaten levels show their cleared tiles.

$04:D96D              .db $28,$94,$23,$98,$28,$18,$28,$58 ; Events $18-$1B
$04:D975              .db $29,$14,$00,$00,$23,$80,$20,$DC ; Events $1C-$1F
$04:D97D              .db $24,$C0,$24,$C8,$24,$CC,$24,$D4 ; Events $20-$23
$04:D985              .db $00,$00,$25,$4E,$26,$08,$24,$D4 ; Events $24-$27
$04:D98D              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$2A,$94,$29,$CC ; Events $28-$2B
$04:D995              .db $2B,$10,$2A,$98,$29,$CC,$00,$00 ; Events $2C-$2F
$04:D99D              .db $00,$00,$2A,$88,$2A,$94,$2B,$08 ; Events $30-$33
$04:D9A5              .db $00,$00,$2C,$08,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Events $34-$37
$04:D9AD              .db $25,$D2,$25,$CE,$25,$52,$25,$C8 ; Events $38-$3B
$04:D9B5              .db $00,$00,$25,$48,$00,$00,$24,$C8 ; Events $3C-$3F
$04:D9BD              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Events $40-$43
$04:D9C5              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$2E,$C6,$00,$00 ; Events $44-$47
$04:D9CD              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$2B,$5E,$2B,$58 ; Events $48-$4B
$04:D9D5              .db $00,$00,$29,$DC,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Events $4C-$4F
$04:D9DD              .db $00,$00,$23,$80,$23,$80,$00,$00 ; Events $50-$53
$04:D9E5              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Events $54-$57
$04:D9ED              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$24,$C8,$24,$C8 ; Events $58-$5B
$04:D9F5              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$2E,$0E,$00,$00 ; Events $5C-$5F
$04:D9FD              .db $27,$C0,$2D,$90,$2D,$8A,$2E,$CA ; Events $60-$63
$04:DA05              .db $00,$00,$2C,$CC,$2C,$D2,$2C,$D8 ; Events $64-$67

$04:DA43              .db $79,$63,$7C,$7E,$80,$23     ; New tiles, entries $10-$15
