;;; $DA49: Apply completed event to layer 1 map ;;;
{
;; If event [$0F] is flagged complete in [$1F02+], swaps the tile at its layer 1 map offset ($D85D) for
;;     the matching $DA33 tile.
;; If the match was table entry $15 the next tile is replaced as well. Then runs $E677 and $E9F1
;;     for the event (path/tile setup), with [$1B86] = 0.
;; Parameters: [$0F]: event number. $04DAAD: long wrapper (PHP/PLP) around $DC6A, called from bank $00.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:D851: Level names, OW border, OW map setup (LevelNames)
$04:DA49 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; \
$04:DA4B A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; |
$04:DA4D 29 F8 00     AND.W #$00F8                    ; |
$04:DA50 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DA51 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DA52 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DA53 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = [$0F] / 8: byte index into the event flags
$04:DA54 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:DA56 29 07 00     AND.W #$0007                    ; |
$04:DA59 AA           TAX                             ; / X = [$0F] AND 7: bit number
$04:DA5A E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DA5C B9 02 1F     LDA.W $1F02,Y                   ; \
$04:DA5F 3F 4B E4 04  AND.L $E44B,X                   ; } Test the event's flag in [$1F02+Y]
$04:DA63 F0 47        BEQ $DAAC                       ; Event not complete: return
$04:DA65 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:DA67 A9 00 C8     LDA.W #$C800                    ; \
$04:DA6A 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04]/[$05] = $C800, pointer to layer 1 map at $7E:C800
$04:DA6C A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:DA6E 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:DA71 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:DA72 AA           TAX                             ; } X = [$0F] * 2
$04:DA73 BF 5D D8 04  LDA.L $D85D,X                   ; \
$04:DA77 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = offset of the event's tile in the layer 1 map
$04:DA78 A2 15 00     LDX.W #$0015                    ; X = $15: search the replace table from the end
$04:DA7B E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DA7D A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$04:DA7F 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = $7E: bank of the map pointer
$04:DA81 B7 04        LDA [$04],Y                     ; Load the tile
$04:DA83 DF 1D DA 04  CMP.L $DA1D,X                   ; Is it in DATA_04DA1D?
$04:DA87 F0 06        BEQ $DA8F                       ; Yes: replace it
$04:DA89 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:DA8A 10 F7        BPL $DA83                       ; / Try the next table entry
$04:DA8C 4C 9D DA     JMP.W $DA9D                     ; Not found: skip replacing

$04:DA8F BF 33 DA 04  LDA.L $DA33,X                   ; Replacement tile for table entry X
$04:DA93 97 04        STA [$04],Y                     ; Store it in the layer 1 map
$04:DA95 E0 15 00     CPX.W #$0015                    ; \
$04:DA98 D0 03        BNE $DA9D                       ; / Entry $15 only: also replace the next tile
$04:DA9A C8           INY                             ; \
$04:DA9B 97 04        STA [$04],Y                     ; / Store the same tile in the next map position
$04:DA9D A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:DA9F 20 77 E6     JSR.W $E677                     ; / Set up the event's path tiles ($E677)
$04:DAA2 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; A 8-bit, X and Y 8-bit
$04:DAA4 9C 86 1B     STZ.W $1B86                     ; [$1B86] = 0
$04:DAA7 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:DAA9 20 F1 E9     JSR.W $E9F1                     ; / Finish setting up the event ($E9F1)
$04:DAAC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:DAAD 08           PHP                             ; Save flags
$04:DAAE 20 6A DC     JSR.W $DC6A                     ; Load layer 2 map and apply completed events
$04:DAB1 28           PLP                             ; Restore flags
$04:DAB2 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $DAB3..DAB3: Table: DMA setup for layer 2 tilemap ;;;
{
;; 7 bytes copied to $4310-$4316: DMAP $01, B-bus $18, source $7F:4000, size $2000 (source high byte becomes
;;     $60 for submaps other than 0).
$04:DAB3              .db $01,$18,$00,$40,$7F,$00,$20 ; DMAP $01, B-bus $18, source $7F:4000, size $2000

}

;;; $DABA: Decompress interleaved map; submap switch entry ;;;
{
;; $04DABA: RLE decompressor writing every other byte of $7F:4000+X. Header byte: bit 7 clear = copy (n+1)
;;     literal bytes, set = repeat next byte (n AND $7F)+1 times.
;; Parameters: [$00]-[$02]: source pointer, Y: source offset, X: first dest offset, [$0E]: stop when X >=
;;     this.
;; $04DAEF: overworld submap switch state machine entry, dispatches on [$1DE8].
;; Called by:
;;     $04:DC87: Load all layers of overworld map
;;     $04:DC99: Load all layers of overworld map
$04:DABA E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; \
$04:DABC C2 10        REP #$10                        ; / A 8-bit, X and Y 16-bit
$04:DABE B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; \
$04:DAC0 85 03        STA $03                         ; |
$04:DAC2 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; |
$04:DAC4 D0 10        BNE $DAD6                       ; } [$03] = header byte; bit 7 set means repeat
$04:DAC6 C8           INY                             ; Y++ (skip header)
$04:DAC7 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; \
$04:DAC9 9F 00 40 7F  STA.L $7F4000,X                 ; / Copy literal byte to $7F:4000+X
$04:DACD E8           INX                             ; \
$04:DACE E8           INX                             ; / X += 2 (every other byte)
$04:DACF C6 03        DEC $03                         ; \
$04:DAD1 10 F3        BPL $DAC6                       ; / Repeat (count + 1) times
$04:DAD3 4C E9 DA     JMP.W $DAE9                     ; Done with this run

$04:DAD6 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$04:DAD8 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; |
$04:DADA 85 03        STA $03                         ; } [$03] = repeat count - 1
$04:DADC C8           INY                             ; Y++ (skip header)
$04:DADD B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; Fetch the byte to repeat
$04:DADF 9F 00 40 7F  STA.L $7F4000,X                 ; Store it at $7F:4000+X
$04:DAE3 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:DAE4 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$04:DAE5 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; \
$04:DAE7 10 F6        BPL $DADF                       ; / Repeat until the count underflows
$04:DAE9 C8           INY                             ; Y++ (next header or data)
$04:DAEA E4 0E        CPX $0E                         ; \
$04:DAEC 90 CC        BCC $DABA                       ; / Continue until X >= [$0E]
$04:DAEE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:DAEF E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:DAF1 AD E8 1D     LDA.W $1DE8                     ; \
$04:DAF4 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; } Run the state for [$1DE8]

}

;;; $DAF8: Submap switch states and iris effect (Ptrs04DAF8) ;;;
{
;; Pointers by [$1DE8]: 0 and 6 = iris window close/open ($DB18), 1-4 = redraw layer 1 pages
;;     ($DCB6), 5 = load tileset ($DB9D), 7 = finish ($DBCF).
;; DB18: moves a box-shaped window ([$1B8D]/[$1B8F] steps, limits from the tables at DB08-DB14), fills the
;;     HDMA table at $0598/$04EE with its left/right edges, sets window masks [$41]/[$43], enables HDMA ch 7.
;; When the close finishes, $9A93 switches the player's submap. DB9D: sets Mario Start tileset [$1931]
;;     for the new submap and reloads graphics.
$04:DAF8 18 DB        .dw $DB18                       ; 0 - Iris closes
$04:DAFA B6 DC        .dw $DCB6                       ; 1 - Draw layer 1 page 0
$04:DAFC B6 DC        .dw $DCB6                       ; 2 - Draw layer 1 page 1
$04:DAFE B6 DC        .dw $DCB6                       ; 3 - Draw layer 1 page 2
$04:DB00 B6 DC        .dw $DCB6                       ; 4 - Draw layer 1 page 3
$04:DB02 9D DB        .dw $DB9D                       ; 5 - Load tileset and graphics
$04:DB04 18 DB        .dw $DB18                       ; 6 - Iris opens
$04:DB06 CF DB        .dw $DBCF                       ; 7 - Finish, change music

$04:DB08              .db $00,$F9,$00,$07             ; Window box width step per frame (X = 0: close, X = 2: open)

$04:DB0C              .db $00,$00,$00,$70             ; Window box width limit

$04:DB10              .db $C0,$FA,$40,$05             ; Window box height step per frame

$04:DB14              .db $00,$00,$00,$54             ; Window box height limit

$04:DB18 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:DB1A AE 8C 1B     LDX.W $1B8C                     ; X = [$1B8C]: 0 closing, 2 opening
$04:DB1D AD 8D 1B     LDA.W $1B8D                     ; \
$04:DB20 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:DB21 7D 08 DB     ADC.W $DB08,X                   ; |
$04:DB24 8D 8D 1B     STA.W $1B8D                     ; } [$1B8D] += width step
$04:DB27 38           SEC                             ; \
$04:DB28 FD 0C DB     SBC.W $DB0C,X                   ; |
$04:DB2B 5D 08 DB     EOR.W $DB08,X                   ; } Has [$1B8D] reached its limit?
$04:DB2E 10 13        BPL $DB43                       ; Not yet: leave the height alone
$04:DB30 AD 8F 1B     LDA.W $1B8F                     ; \
$04:DB33 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:DB34 7D 10 DB     ADC.W $DB10,X                   ; |
$04:DB37 8D 8F 1B     STA.W $1B8F                     ; } [$1B8F] += height step
$04:DB3A 38           SEC                             ; \
$04:DB3B FD 14 DB     SBC.W $DB14,X                   ; |
$04:DB3E 5D 10 DB     EOR.W $DB10,X                   ; } Has [$1B8F] reached its limit?
$04:DB41 30 1C        BMI $DB5F                       ; Not yet: draw the window
$04:DB43 BD 0C DB     LDA.W $DB0C,X                   ; \
$04:DB46 8D 8D 1B     STA.W $1B8D                     ; / Clamp [$1B8D] to its limit
$04:DB49 BD 14 DB     LDA.W $DB14,X                   ; \
$04:DB4C 8D 8F 1B     STA.W $1B8F                     ; / Clamp [$1B8F] to its limit
$04:DB4F EE E8 1D     INC.W $1DE8                     ; Next submap switch state
$04:DB52 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:DB53 49 02 00     EOR.W #$0002                    ; |
$04:DB56 AA           TAX                             ; } Toggle [$1B8C] between 0 and 2
$04:DB57 8E 8C 1B     STX.W $1B8C                     ; Save it
$04:DB5A F0 03        BEQ $DB5F                       ; Now 0: nothing more to do
$04:DB5C 20 93 9A     JSR.W $9A93                     ; Closed: switch the player's submap ($9A93)
$04:DB5F E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DB61 AD 90 1B     LDA.W $1B90                     ; \
$04:DB64 0A           ASL                             ; / [$00] = [$1B90] * 2: box half-height in table bytes
$04:DB65 85 00        STA $00                         ; Store it
$04:DB67 AD 8E 1B     LDA.W $1B8E                     ; \
$04:DB6A 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:DB6B 69 80        ADC.B #$80                      ; } Right edge = $80 + [$1B8E], into the high byte
$04:DB6D EB           XBA                             ; Swap
$04:DB6E A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$04:DB70 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:DB71 ED 8E 1B     SBC.W $1B8E                     ; } Left edge = $80 - [$1B8E]
$04:DB74 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit: A = right edge, left edge
$04:DB76 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: line offset from the top
$04:DB78 A0 A8        LDY.B #$A8                      ; Y = $A8: line offset from the bottom
$04:DB7A E4 00        CPX $00                         ; \
$04:DB7C 90 03        BCC $DB81                       ; / Beyond the box height?
$04:DB7E A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; Yes: empty window (left $FF, right $00)
$04:DB81 99 EE 04     STA.W $04EE,Y                   ; \
$04:DB84 9D 98 05     STA.W $0598,X                   ; } Write edges to the bottom table ($04EE+Y) and the top table ($0598+X)
$04:DB87 E8           INX                             ; \
$04:DB88 E8           INX                             ; |
$04:DB89 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:DB8A 88           DEY                             ; / X += 2, Y -= 2
$04:DB8B D0 ED        BNE $DB7A                       ; Loop over all lines
$04:DB8D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DB8F A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; \
$04:DB91 85 41        STA $41                         ; / Window 1 enabled on BG1 and BG2 [$41] = $33
$04:DB93 A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; \
$04:DB95 85 43        STA $43                         ; / Window mask for OBJ and color [$43] = $33
$04:DB97 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$04:DB99 8D 9F 0D     STA.W $0D9F                     ; / Enable HDMA channel 7 (window table)
$04:DB9C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:DB9D AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:DBA0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DBA1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DBA2 AA           TAX                             ; } X = current player
$04:DBA3 BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:DBA6 AA           TAX                             ; / X = current player's submap
$04:DBA7 BF 02 DC 04  LDA.L $DC02,X                   ; \
$04:DBAB 8D 31 19     STA.W $1931                     ; / Mario Start tileset for the submap
$04:DBAE 22 94 A5 00  JSL.L $A594                     ; Reload graphics ($A594)
$04:DBB2 A9 FE        LDA.B #$FE                      ; \
$04:DBB4 8D 03 07     STA.W $0703                     ; / [$0703] = $FE
$04:DBB7 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$04:DBB9 8D 04 07     STA.W $0704                     ; / [$0704] = $01 (probably background color mirror $01FE)
$04:DBBC 9C 03 08     STZ.W $0803                     ; [$0803] = 0
$04:DBBF A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$04:DBC1 8D 80 06     STA.W $0680                     ; / [$0680] = 6
$04:DBC4 EE E8 1D     INC.W $1DE8                     ; Next submap switch state
$04:DBC7 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DBC8..DBC8: Table: music per submap ;;;
{
;; One music number per submap, written to [$1DFB].
$04:DBC8              .db $02,$03,$04,$06,$07,$09,$05 ; Music per submap

}

;;; $DBCF: Submap switch: finish and change music ;;;
{
;; Resets [$1DE8] to 0, sets overworld process [$13D9] = 4. Starts the new submap's music unless two players
;;     share the same submap and the music is already playing.
$04:DBCF 9C E8 1D     STZ.W $1DE8                     ; Reset submap switch state
$04:DBD2 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:DBD4 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; / Overworld process [$13D9] = 4 (normal)
$04:DBD7 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:DBDA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DBDB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DBDC A8           TAY                             ; } Y = current player
$04:DBDD AD B2 0D     LDA.W $0DB2                     ; \
$04:DBE0 F0 11        BEQ $DBF3                       ; / Single player: change music
$04:DBE2 AD 9E 1B     LDA.W $1B9E                     ; \
$04:DBE5 D0 0C        BNE $DBF3                       ; / [$1B9E] non-zero: change music
$04:DBE7 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:DBE8 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$04:DBEA AA           TAX                             ; } X = other player
$04:DBEB B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; \
$04:DBEE DD 11 1F     CMP.W $1F11,X                   ; |
$04:DBF1 F0 0E        BEQ $DC01                       ; } Same submap as the other player: keep the music
$04:DBF3 B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; \
$04:DBF6 AA           TAX                             ; / X = this player's submap
$04:DBF7 BF C8 DB 04  LDA.L $DBC8,X                   ; \
$04:DBFB 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Request the submap's music
$04:DBFE 9C 9E 1B     STZ.W $1B9E                     ; [$1B9E] = 0
$04:DC01 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DC02..DC02: Table: Mario Start tileset per submap ;;;
{
;; Value stored in [$1931] for each submap (tileset $11-$17).
$04:DC02              .db $11,$12,$13,$14,$15,$16,$17 ; Mario Start tileset per submap

}

;;; $DC09: Load all layers of overworld map ;;;
{
;; Long routine (JSL) used when the overworld or Mario Start is loaded. Selects the tileset for the current
;;     player's submap, clears the $7F:C800 attribute tables, builds the pointer table at $0FBE, copies the layer
;;     1 map from $0C:F7DF to $7E:C800, indexes event tiles ($D7F2).
;; $04DC6A: loads layer 2: decompresses the layer 2 tile data and then applies every completed event to it.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:96E5: Game mode 11: Mario Start, level music (MarioStartGameMode)
;;     $00:A126: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode)
$04:DC09 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:DC0B AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:DC0E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DC0F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DC10 AA           TAX                             ; } X = current player
$04:DC11 BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:DC14 AA           TAX                             ; / X = current submap
$04:DC15 BF 02 DC 04  LDA.L $DC02,X                   ; \
$04:DC19 8D 31 19     STA.W $1931                     ; / Set the tileset for this submap
$04:DC1C A9 11        LDA.B #$11                      ; \
$04:DC1E 8D 2B 19     STA.W $192B                     ; / Sprite graphics set [$192B] = $11
$04:DC21 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$04:DC23 8D 25 19     STA.W $1925                     ; / [$1925] = 7 (overworld level mode)
$04:DC26 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$04:DC28 85 5B        STA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; / Level mode flag = 3
$04:DC2A C2 10        REP #$10                        ; X and Y 16-bit
$04:DC2C A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0
$04:DC2F 8A           TXA                             ; A = 0
$04:DC30 20 70 D7     JSR.W $D770                     ; Clear byte X of the 32 tables at $7F:C800+n*$1B0 ($D770)
$04:DC33 E0 B0 01     CPX.W #$01B0                    ; \
$04:DC36 D0 F8        BNE $DC30                       ; / Loop for $1B0 bytes
$04:DC38 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:DC3A A9 00 D0     LDA.W #$D000                    ; \
$04:DC3D 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $D000
$04:DC3F A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0
$04:DC42 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:DC44 9D BE 0F     STA.W $0FBE,X                   ; / Pointer to tile definition at $0FBE+X
$04:DC47 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:DC49 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:DC4A 69 08 00     ADC.W #$0008                    ; |
$04:DC4D 85 00        STA $00                         ; } Next tile definition: [$00] += 8
$04:DC4F E8           INX                             ; \
$04:DC50 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$04:DC51 E0 00 04     CPX.W #$0400                    ; \
$04:DC54 D0 EC        BNE $DC42                       ; / Repeat for 512 tiles
$04:DC56 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$04:DC57 A9 FF 07     LDA.W #$07FF                    ; \
$04:DC5A A2 DF F7     LDX.W #$F7DF                    ; |
$04:DC5D A0 00 C8     LDY.W #$C800                    ; |
$04:DC60 54 7E 0C     MVN $7E,$0C                     ; } Copy $0800 bytes from $0C:F7DF to $7E:C800 (layer 1 map)
$04:DC63 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$04:DC64 20 F2 D7     JSR.W $D7F2                     ; Index event tiles ($D7F2)
$04:DC67 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:DC69 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$04:DC6A E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; \
$04:DC6C 20 40 DD     JSR.W $DD40                     ; / Decompress layer 2 attributes to $7F:0000 ($DD40)
$04:DC6F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:DC71 A9 33 A5     LDA.W #$A533                    ; \
$04:DC74 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $A533
$04:DC76 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:DC78 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:DC7A 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $04: source is $04:A533 (layer 2 tile numbers)
$04:DC7C C2 10        REP #$10                        ; X and Y 16-bit
$04:DC7E A0 00 40     LDY.W #$4000                    ; \
$04:DC81 84 0E        STY $0E                         ; / [$0E] = $4000: stop here
$04:DC83 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; \
$04:DC86 BB           TYX                             ; / Y = X = 0
$04:DC87 20 BA DA     JSR.W $DABA                     ; Decompress to the even bytes of $7F:4000
$04:DC8A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:DC8C A9 2B C0     LDA.W #$C02B                    ; \
$04:DC8F 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $C02B: source $04:C02B (layer 2 properties)
$04:DC91 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DC93 A2 01 00     LDX.W #$0001                    ; X = 1: odd bytes
$04:DC96 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0
$04:DC99 20 BA DA     JSR.W $DABA                     ; Decompress to the odd bytes of $7F:4000
$04:DC9C E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:DC9E A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$04:DCA0 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / Start with event 0
$04:DCA2 20 53 E4     JSR.W $E453                     ; Apply this event to layer 2 if complete ($E453)
$04:DCA5 E6 0F        INC $0F                         ; Next event
$04:DCA7 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:DCA9 C9 6F        CMP.B #$6F                      ; |
$04:DCAB D0 F5        BNE $DCA2                       ; } Loop for events 0 to $6E
$04:DCAD 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DCAE..DCAE: Table: bit masks 80 to 01 ;;;
{
;; Bit masks for event flags. Probably an unused duplicate of $E44B.
$04:DCAE              .db $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01 ; Bit masks

}

;;; $DCB6: Draw layer 1 map page to tilemap buffer ;;;
{
;; Submap switch states 1-4. Expands 256 map16 tiles of the layer 1 map into 8x8 tiles in the tilemap buffer
;;     $7E:E400. Page = [$1DE8] - 1 (plus 4 if the player's submap is not 0).
;; $04DD40/$04DD57: RLE decompressor used to unpack the layer 2 attribute data from $0C:8D00 to $7F:0000
;;     (header bit 7 set = repeat; ends at a $FFFF word).
$04:DCB6 08           PHP                             ; Save flags
$04:DCB7 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; \
$04:DCB9 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / X and Y 16-bit, A 8-bit
$04:DCBB A2 00 D0     LDX.W #$D000                    ; \
$04:DCBE 86 65        STX $65                         ; / [$65] = $D000
$04:DCC0 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$04:DCC2 85 67        STA $67                         ; / [$67] = $05 (placeholder bank)
$04:DCC4 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; \
$04:DCC7 86 00        STX $00                         ; / [$00] = 0: tile counter
$04:DCC9 AD E8 1D     LDA.W $1DE8                     ; \
$04:DCCC 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$04:DCCD 85 01        STA $01                         ; } [$01] = [$1DE8] - 1: map page
$04:DCCF C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:DCD1 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:DCD4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DCD5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:DCD6 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:DCD9 AA           TAX                             ; } X = current player
$04:DCDA E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DCDC BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; \
$04:DCDF F0 07        BEQ $DCE8                       ; / Submap 0: keep the page
$04:DCE1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$04:DCE3 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:DCE4 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$04:DCE6 85 01        STA $01                         ; } Other submap: page += 4
$04:DCE8 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = map index (page * 256 + counter)
$04:DCEA BF 00 C8 7E  LDA.L $7EC800,X                 ; \
$04:DCEE 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = tile number from $7E:C800
$04:DCF0 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:DCF2 BF 00 C8 7F  LDA.L $7FC800,X                 ; \
$04:DCF6 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = tile high bit from $7F:C800
$04:DCF8 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:DCFA 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:DCFB 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:DCFC 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:DCFD A8           TAY                             ; } Y = tile * 8: offset of its four 8x8 tiles
$04:DCFE A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:DD00 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:DD03 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:DD04 0A           ASL                             ; } A = (counter AND $FF) * 4
$04:DD05 48           PHA                             ; \
$04:DD06 29 3F 00     AND.W #$003F                    ; |
$04:DD09 85 02        STA $02                         ; } [$02] = column byte offset
$04:DD0B 68           PLA                             ; \
$04:DD0C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:DD0D 29 80 0F     AND.W #$0F80                    ; |
$04:DD10 05 02        ORA $02                         ; } Add row offset
$04:DD12 AA           TAX                             ; X = tilemap byte offset in $7E:E400
$04:DD13 B7 65        LDA [$65],Y                     ; \
$04:DD15 9F 00 E4 7E  STA.L $7EE400,X                 ; / Top left 8x8 tile
$04:DD19 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:DD1A C8           INY                             ; |
$04:DD1B B7 65        LDA [$65],Y                     ; |
$04:DD1D 9F 40 E4 7E  STA.L $7EE440,X                 ; } Bottom left tile (next tile row, +$40)
$04:DD21 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:DD22 C8           INY                             ; |
$04:DD23 B7 65        LDA [$65],Y                     ; |
$04:DD25 9F 02 E4 7E  STA.L $7EE402,X                 ; } Top right tile (+2)
$04:DD29 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:DD2A C8           INY                             ; |
$04:DD2B B7 65        LDA [$65],Y                     ; |
$04:DD2D 9F 42 E4 7E  STA.L $7EE442,X                 ; } Bottom right tile (+$42)
$04:DD31 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DD33 E6 00        INC $00                         ; Next tile
$04:DD35 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:DD37 29 FF        AND.B #$FF                      ; |
$04:DD39 D0 AD        BNE $DCE8                       ; } Loop for 256 tiles
$04:DD3B EE E8 1D     INC.W $1DE8                     ; Next submap switch state
$04:DD3E 28           PLP                             ; Restore flags
$04:DD3F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:DD40 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; \
$04:DD42 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / X and Y 16-bit, A 8-bit
$04:DD44 A0 00 8D     LDY.W #$8D00                    ; \
$04:DD47 84 02        STY $02                         ; / [$02] = $8D00
$04:DD49 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$04:DD4B 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = $0C: source is $0C:8D00
$04:DD4D A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; \
$04:DD50 9B           TXY                             ; / X = Y = 0
$04:DD51 20 57 DD     JSR.W $DD57                     ; Decompress to $7F:0000
$04:DD54 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:DD56 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:DD57 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:DD59 B7 02        LDA [$02],Y                     ; \
$04:DD5B C8           INY                             ; |
$04:DD5C 85 05        STA $05                         ; |
$04:DD5E 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; } [$05] = header byte
$04:DD60 D0 0F        BNE $DD71                       ; Bit 7 set: repeat
$04:DD62 B7 02        LDA [$02],Y                     ; \
$04:DD64 9F 00 00 7F  STA.L $7F0000,X                 ; / Copy a literal byte
$04:DD68 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:DD69 E8           INX                             ; / Y++, X++
$04:DD6A C6 05        DEC $05                         ; \
$04:DD6C 10 F4        BPL $DD62                       ; / Repeat (count + 1) times
$04:DD6E 4C 83 DD     JMP.W $DD83                     ; Run done

$04:DD71 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$04:DD73 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; |
$04:DD75 85 05        STA $05                         ; } [$05] = repeat count - 1
$04:DD77 B7 02        LDA [$02],Y                     ; Fetch the byte to repeat
$04:DD79 9F 00 00 7F  STA.L $7F0000,X                 ; Store it at $7F:0000+X
$04:DD7D E8           INX                             ; X++
$04:DD7E C6 05        DEC $05                         ; \
$04:DD80 10 F7        BPL $DD79                       ; / Repeat until the count underflows
$04:DD82 C8           INY                             ; Skip the repeated byte
$04:DD83 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:DD85 B7 02        LDA [$02],Y                     ; \
$04:DD87 C9 FF FF     CMP.W #$FFFF                    ; |
$04:DD8A D0 CB        BNE $DD57                       ; } Loop until the next word is $FFFF
$04:DD8C 60           RTS                             ; Return
; Ending early  because the next part is a big table

}

;;; $E453: Apply completed event to layer 2 map ;;;
{
;; If event [$0F] is complete, runs every block copy record for it ($DD8D) via $E496.
;; E496: reads one record and copies the block with E4D0 (2x2) or E520 (6x6), alternating tile byte from
;;     $0C:8000+Y and attribute byte from $7F:0000+Y into $7F:4000+X. The 32-tile row wrap is handled by AND #$3F
;;     tests.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:DCA2: Load all layers of overworld map
$04:E453 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:E455 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:E457 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$04:E459 AA           TAX                             ; } X = [$0F] AND 7: bit number
$04:E45A A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:E45C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:E45D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:E45E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:E45F A8           TAY                             ; } Y = [$0F] / 8: flag byte
$04:E460 B9 02 1F     LDA.W $1F02,Y                   ; \
$04:E463 3F 4B E4 04  AND.L $E44B,X                   ; } Test the event's flag in [$1F02+Y]
$04:E467 D0 01        BNE $E46A                       ; Complete: apply it
$04:E469 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:E46A A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:E46C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:E46D AA           TAX                             ; } X = [$0F] * 2
$04:E46E C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:E470 BF 59 E3 04  LDA.L $E359,X                   ; \
$04:E474 8D EB 1D     STA.W $1DEB                     ; / [$1DEB] = first record index for this event
$04:E477 BF 5B E3 04  LDA.L $E35B,X                   ; \
$04:E47B 8D ED 1D     STA.W $1DED                     ; / [$1DED] = end index (next event's first)
$04:E47E CD EB 1D     CMP.W $1DEB                     ; \
$04:E481 F0 10        BEQ $E493                       ; / No records: done
$04:E483 20 96 E4     JSR.W $E496                     ; Copy block for record [$1DEB] ($E496)
$04:E486 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:E488 EE EB 1D     INC.W $1DEB                     ; Next record
$04:E48B AD EB 1D     LDA.W $1DEB                     ; \
$04:E48E CD ED 1D     CMP.W $1DED                     ; |
$04:E491 D0 F0        BNE $E483                       ; } Loop until [$1DEB] = [$1DED]
$04:E493 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:E495 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:E496 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:E498 AD EB 1D     LDA.W $1DEB                     ; \
$04:E49B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:E49C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:E49D AA           TAX                             ; } X = record * 4
$04:E49E BF 8D DD 04  LDA.L $DD8D,X                   ; \
$04:E4A2 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = source offset
$04:E4A3 BF 8F DD 04  LDA.L $DD8F,X                   ; \
$04:E4A7 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = destination offset in $7F:4000
$04:E4A9 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:E4AB A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$04:E4AD 85 08        STA $08                         ; / [$08] = $7F
$04:E4AF A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$04:E4B1 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; / [$0B] = $0C
$04:E4B3 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:E4B5 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; \
$04:E4B8 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = $0000: pointer to $7F:0000 (attributes)
$04:E4BA A9 00 80     LDA.W #$8000                    ; \
$04:E4BD 85 09        STA $09                         ; / [$09] = $8000: pointer to $0C:8000 (tile numbers)
$04:E4BF C0 00 09     CPY.W #$0900                    ; \
$04:E4C2 90 06        BCC $E4CA                       ; / Source offset < $0900: 6x6 block
$04:E4C4 20 D0 E4     JSR.W $E4D0                     ; Copy a 2x2 block
$04:E4C7 4C CD E4     JMP.W $E4CD                     ; Done

$04:E4CA 20 20 E5     JSR.W $E520                     ; Copy a 6x6 block
$04:E4CD E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:E4CF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:E4D0 A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; \
$04:E4D3 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = 1: 2 rows
$04:E4D5 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = destination offset
$04:E4D7 A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; \
$04:E4DA 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = 1: 2 tiles per row
$04:E4DC E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:E4DE B7 09        LDA [$09],Y                     ; \
$04:E4E0 9F 00 40 7F  STA.L $7F4000,X                 ; / Copy tile number to the layer 2 tilemap
$04:E4E4 E8           INX                             ; X++
$04:E4E5 B7 06        LDA [$06],Y                     ; \
$04:E4E7 9F 00 40 7F  STA.L $7F4000,X                 ; / Copy tile attributes
$04:E4EB C8           INY                             ; \
$04:E4EC E8           INX                             ; / Y++, X++
$04:E4ED C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:E4EF 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:E4F0 29 3F 00     AND.W #$003F                    ; |
$04:E4F3 D0 0A        BNE $E4FF                       ; } At the right edge of a 32-tile row?
$04:E4F5 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:E4F6 8A           TXA                             ; |
$04:E4F7 29 C0 FF     AND.W #$FFC0                    ; |
$04:E4FA 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:E4FB 69 00 08     ADC.W #$0800                    ; |
$04:E4FE AA           TAX                             ; } Wrap into the next $800-byte screen page
$04:E4FF C6 0C        DEC $0C                         ; \
$04:E501 10 D9        BPL $E4DC                       ; / Next tile in the row
$04:E503 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:E505 AA           TAX                             ; |
$04:E506 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:E507 69 40 00     ADC.W #$0040                    ; |
$04:E50A 85 04        STA $04                         ; } Next row: [$04] += $40
$04:E50C 29 C0 07     AND.W #$07C0                    ; \
$04:E50F D0 0A        BNE $E51B                       ; / Crossed a page boundary?
$04:E511 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:E512 29 3F F8     AND.W #$F83F                    ; |
$04:E515 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:E516 69 00 10     ADC.W #$1000                    ; |
$04:E519 85 04        STA $04                         ; } Next page: [$04] += $1000
$04:E51B C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$04:E51D 10 B6        BPL $E4D5                       ; / Next row
$04:E51F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:E520 A9 05 00     LDA.W #$0005                    ; \
$04:E523 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = 5: 6 rows
$04:E525 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = destination offset
$04:E527 A9 05 00     LDA.W #$0005                    ; \
$04:E52A 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = 5: 6 tiles per row
$04:E52C E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:E52E B7 09        LDA [$09],Y                     ; \
$04:E530 9F 00 40 7F  STA.L $7F4000,X                 ; / Copy tile number to the layer 2 tilemap
$04:E534 E8           INX                             ; X++
$04:E535 B7 06        LDA [$06],Y                     ; \
$04:E537 9F 00 40 7F  STA.L $7F4000,X                 ; / Copy tile attributes
$04:E53B C8           INY                             ; \
$04:E53C E8           INX                             ; / Y++, X++
$04:E53D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:E53F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:E540 29 3F 00     AND.W #$003F                    ; |
$04:E543 D0 0A        BNE $E54F                       ; } At the right edge of a 32-tile row?
$04:E545 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:E546 8A           TXA                             ; |
$04:E547 29 C0 FF     AND.W #$FFC0                    ; |
$04:E54A 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:E54B 69 00 08     ADC.W #$0800                    ; |
$04:E54E AA           TAX                             ; } Wrap into the next $800-byte screen page
$04:E54F C6 0C        DEC $0C                         ; \
$04:E551 10 D9        BPL $E52C                       ; / Next tile in the row
$04:E553 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:E555 AA           TAX                             ; |
$04:E556 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:E557 69 40 00     ADC.W #$0040                    ; |
$04:E55A 85 04        STA $04                         ; } Next row: [$04] += $40
$04:E55C 29 C0 07     AND.W #$07C0                    ; \
$04:E55F D0 0A        BNE $E56B                       ; / Crossed a page boundary?
$04:E561 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:E562 29 3F F8     AND.W #$F83F                    ; |
$04:E565 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:E566 69 00 10     ADC.W #$1000                    ; |
$04:E569 85 04        STA $04                         ; } Next page: [$04] += $1000
$04:E56B C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$04:E56D 10 B6        BPL $E525                       ; / Next row
$04:E56F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:E570 AD 86 1B     LDA.W $1B86
$04:E573 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr

}

;;; $E577: Overworld event: state machine and tiles (Ptrs04E577) ;;;
{
;; Second half of the overworld event handler that $E570 enters through ExecutePtr with state [$1B86] (8
;;     states).
;; Runs when the player beats a level that triggers an overworld event ([$1DE9] set, event number [$1DEA]):
;;     smoke puff, new level tile,
;; event path tiles in the layer 2 map, then a final step that applies direct map edits and records the event
;;     in [$1F02].
;; Contains the pointer table, small tables, state 0-4 code and the stripe image builders for 2x2 and 6x6 tile
;;     blocks.
$04:E577 EE E5        .dw $E5EE                       ; State 0: check event, start it ($04E5EE)
$04:E579 EB EB        .dw $EBEB                       ; State 1: smoke puff before level tile appears ($04EBEB)
$04:E57B D3 E6        .dw $E6D3                       ; State 2: find event tile range ($04E6D3)
$04:E57D F9 E6        .dw $E6F9                       ; State 3: lay down event tiles ($04E6F9)
$04:E57F A4 EA        .dw $EAA4                       ; State 4: fade in, next tile or continue ($04EAA4)
$04:E581 78 EC        .dw $EC78                       ; State 5: check level tile to reveal ($04EC78)
$04:E583 EB EB        .dw $EBEB                       ; State 6: smoke puff at level tile ($04EBEB)
$04:E585 EC E9        .dw $E9EC                       ; State 7: finish event, apply map edits ($04E9EC)

$04:E587              .db $20,$52,$22,$DA,$28,$58,$24,$C0 ; Table of 16 words indexed by [$13D1] * 2 (read by $EEAA)
$04:E58F              .db $24,$94,$23,$42,$28,$94,$2A,$98 ; (continued)
$04:E597              .db $25,$0E,$25,$52,$25,$C4,$2A,$DE ; (continued)
$04:E59F              .db $2A,$98,$28,$44,$2C,$50,$2C,$0C ; (continued)
$04:E5A7              .db $77,$79,$58,$4C,$A6         ; Layer 1 tile numbers that may sit at the position being replaced

$04:E5AC              .db $85,$86,$00,$10,$00         ; Replacement tile written at the position (index >= 3 only): $10, $00

$04:E5B1              .db $85,$86,$81,$81,$81         ; Replacement tile written below it / for index 0-2: $85,$86,$81...

$04:E5B6              .db $19,$04,$BD,$00,$1C,$06,$30,$01 ; Word offsets into the layer 1 map ($7E:C800), 16 entries x 2 bytes
$04:E5BE              .db $2A,$01,$D1,$00,$2A,$06,$AC,$06 ; (continued)
$04:E5C6              .db $47,$05,$59,$05,$72,$05,$BF,$02 ; (continued)
$04:E5CE              .db $AC,$02,$12,$02,$18,$03,$06,$03 ; (continued)
$04:E5D6              .db $06,$0F,$1C,$21,$24,$28,$29,$37 ; Event numbers whose level tile is replaced (entries 0-15)
$04:E5DE              .db $40,$41,$43,$4A,$4D,$02,$61,$35 ; (continued)
$04:E5E6              .db $58,$59,$5D,$63,$77,$79,$7E,$80 ; Event numbers (entries 16-23); also OW tile numbers checked against [$13C1]

$04:E5EE AD D5 0D     LDA.W $0DD5                     ; \
$04:E5F1 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$04:E5F3 D0 03        BNE $E5F8                       ; } Secret exit ([$0DD5] = 2): next event number [$1DEA]++
$04:E5F5 EE EA 1D     INC.W $1DEA                     ; /
$04:E5F8 AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; A = [$1DE9] (event pending flag)
$04:E5FB F0 1D        BEQ $E61A                       ; No event pending: skip to the tile check at $04E61A
$04:E5FD AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number [$1DEA]
$04:E600 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; \
$04:E602 F0 16        BEQ $E61A                       ; / [$1DEA] = $FF (no event): skip to $04E61A
$04:E604 AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; \
$04:E607 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } X = [$1DEA] AND 7 (bit within the byte)
$04:E609 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:E60A AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; \
$04:E60D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:E60E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:E60F 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = [$1DEA] / 8 (byte in the event-passed flags)
$04:E610 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:E611 B9 02 1F     LDA.W $1F02,Y                   ; A = event-passed flags [$1F02+Y]
$04:E614 3F 4B E4 04  AND.L $E44B,X                   ; Isolate this event's bit ($E44B: $80,$40,...)
$04:E618 F0 26        BEQ $E640                       ; Bit clear (event not seen yet): go start it ($04E640)
$04:E61A A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: loop over the 8 OW tile numbers in $E5E6
$04:E61C BD E6 E5     LDA.W $E5E6,X                   ; A = tile number to compare
$04:E61F CD C1 13     CMP.W $13C1                     ; Compare with [$13C1] (probably OW tile Mario stands on)
$04:E622 D0 0E        BNE $E632                       ; No match: try the next one
$04:E624 EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; Match: advance the OW process [$13D9]++
$04:E627 A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; A = $E0
$04:E629 8D D5 0D     STA.W $0DD5                     ; [$0DD5] = $E0
$04:E62C A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; A = $0F
$04:E62E 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; [$0DB1] = $0F (probably keeps the OW game mode active)
$04:E631 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:E632 CA           DEX                             ; Next table entry
$04:E633 10 E7        BPL $E61C                       ; Loop for X = 7..0
$04:E635 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; A = 5
$04:E637 8D D9 13     STA.W $13D9                     ; [$13D9] = 5: back to normal OW processing (Mario idle)
$04:E63A A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80
$04:E63C 8D D5 0D     STA.W $0DD5                     ; [$0DD5] = $80
$04:E63F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:E640 EE 86 1B     INC.W $1B86                     ; Go to state 1: [$1B86]++
$04:E643 AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number [$1DEA]
$04:E646 20 77 E6     JSR.W $E677                     ; Find its level tile ($E677); returns Y = map position
$04:E649 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:E64A 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:E64B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:E64C 0A           ASL                             ; } A = Y << 4
$04:E64D 0A           ASL                             ; /
$04:E64E 8D 82 1B     STA.W $1B82                     ; [$1B82] = effect X position (low nibble of map position * 16)
$04:E651 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:E652 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } A = Y AND $F0
$04:E654 8D 83 1B     STA.W $1B83                     ; [$1B83] = effect Y position
$04:E657 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; A = $28
$04:E659 8D 84 1B     STA.W $1B84                     ; [$1B84] = $28 (smoke puff timer)
$04:E65C AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; A = [$13BF] (level number just beaten)
$04:E65F C9 18        CMP.B #$18                      ; Level $18 (Sunken Ghost Ship) triggers the earthquake?
$04:E661 D0 05        BNE $E668                       ; No: skip
$04:E663 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF
$04:E665 8D A0 1B     STA.W $1BA0                     ; [$1BA0] = $FF (overworld earthquake timer, per the original note)
$04:E668 AD 86 1B     LDA.W $1B86                     ; A = [$1B86]
$04:E66B C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; State 2 (no level tile to reveal)?
$04:E66D F0 05        BEQ $E674                       ; Yes: skip the sound
$04:E66F A9 16        LDA.B #$16                      ; A = $16
$04:E671 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; Play sound effect $16
$04:E674 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit

$04:E677 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:E679 A2 17        LDX.B #$17                      ; X = $17: search 24 entries
$04:E67B DF D6 E5 04  CMP.L $E5D6,X                   ; Compare A (event number) with the list entry
$04:E67F F0 09        BEQ $E68A                       ; Found: go to $04E68A

$04:E684 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2

$04:E68D 8A           TXA                             ; A = X

$04:E690 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; A = $7E

$04:E6B3 8A           TXA                             ; A = X (tile kind)

$04:E6C9 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:E6CA E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:E6CC BF B1 E5 04  LDA.L $E5B1,X                   ; A = $E5B1[X]

$04:E6D3 EE 86 1B     INC.W $1B86                     ; Go to state 3: [$1B86]++
$04:E6D6 AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number
$04:E6D9 0A           ASL                             ; A *= 2
$04:E6DA AA           TAX                             ; X = word offset
$04:E6DB C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:E6DD BF 59 E3 04  LDA.L $E359,X                   ; A = first event tile index for this event ($E359)
$04:E6E1 8D EB 1D     STA.W $1DEB                     ; [$1DEB] = current event tile index
$04:E6E4 BF 5B E3 04  LDA.L $E35B,X                   ; A = first tile index of the next event ($E35B)
$04:E6E8 8D ED 1D     STA.W $1DED                     ; [$1DED] = end index

$04:E6F9 20 62 EA     JSR.W $EA62                     ; Set up the palette upload buffer ($EA62)
$04:E6FC A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; A = $7F
$04:E6FE 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; [$0E] = $7F (bank for the [$0C] pointer)
$04:E700 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:E702 AD EB 1D     LDA.W $1DEB                     ; A = current event tile index
$04:E705 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:E706 0A           ASL                             ; } X = index * 4 (4 bytes per tile entry)
$04:E707 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:E708 BF 8D DD 04  LDA.L $DD8D,X                   ; A = $DD8D[X]: tile source index
$04:E70C 8D 84 1B     STA.W $1B84                     ; [$1B84] = source index (also selects 2x2 or 6x6 below)
$04:E70F BF 8F DD 04  LDA.L $DD8F,X                   ; A = $DD8F[X]: tile position in the layer 2 map
$04:E713 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = map offset
$04:E715 29 FF 1F     AND.W #$1FFF                    ; Keep 13 bits

$04:E71E 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = VRAM address

$04:E722 4A           LSR                             ; \

$04:E76C A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; A = 1

$04:E771 AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; A = current write index into the stripe buffer
$04:E775 AA           TAX                             ; X = index
$04:E776 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = VRAM address
$04:E778 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Stripe record: VRAM address
$04:E77C E8           INX                             ; \
$04:E77D E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$04:E77E A0 00 03     LDY.W #$0300                    ; Y = $0300: record length-1 = 3 (4 bytes, 2 tiles), big-endian
$04:E781 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; A = VRAM address low byte (column)
$04:E783 29 1F 00     AND.W #$001F                    ; Keep column 0-31

$04:E795 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \

$04:E7A2 A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; A = 1

$04:E7AB 25 0A        AND $0A                         ; Mask with [$0A]

$04:E7CB EB           XBA                             ; Swap bytes

;;; $E9EC: Overworld event: apply edits, fade tiles ;;;
{
;; State 7 ($E9EC): applies every matching map edit from the four tables, then ends the event: [$1B86] =
;;     0, [$13D9]++, marks
;; the event in [$1F02] and clears [$1DE9].
;; $04EA62: builds the palette upload buffer at $0907. $04EAA4: state 4, fades the event tile in as 36 OAM
;;     sprites until timer [$1495] reaches $40,
;; then draws the layer 2 tile and moves to the next one.
$04:E9EC AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number [$1DEA]
$04:E9EF 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; [$0F] = event number
$04:E9F1 A2 2B        LDX.B #$2B                      ; X = $2B: search the 44 entries
$04:E9F3 DF E4 E8 04  CMP.L $E8E4,X                   ; Entry belongs to this event?
$04:E9F7 F0 2C        BEQ $EA25                       ; Yes: apply it ($04EA25)
$04:E9F9 CA           DEX                             ; Next entry
$04:E9FA 10 F7        BPL $E9F3                       ; Loop for X = $2B..0
$04:E9FC AD 86 1B     LDA.W $1B86                     ; A = [$1B86]
$04:E9FF F0 23        BEQ $EA24                       ; Already 0: nothing more to do
$04:EA01 9C 86 1B     STZ.W $1B86                     ; [$1B86] = 0: event state machine finished
$04:EA04 EE D9 13     INC.W $13D9                     ; Advance the OW process [$13D9]++
$04:EA07 AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number
$04:EA0A 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; Bit within the byte
$04:EA0C AA           TAX                             ; X = bit index
$04:EA0D AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number
$04:EA10 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:EA11 4A           LSR                             ; } A /= 8
$04:EA12 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:EA13 A8           TAY                             ; Y = byte index
$04:EA14 B9 02 1F     LDA.W $1F02,Y                   ; A = event-passed flags [$1F02+Y]
$04:EA17 1F 4B E4 04  ORA.L $E44B,X                   ; Set this event's bit
$04:EA1B 99 02 1F     STA.W $1F02,Y                   ; Save: event is now done
$04:EA1E EE 2E 1F     INC.W $1F2E                     ; [$1F2E]++ (count of events triggered, probably)
$04:EA21 9C E9 1D     STZ.W $1DE9                     ; [$1DE9] = 0: no event pending
$04:EA24 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:EA25 DA           PHX                             ; Save the entry index
$04:EA26 BF 10 E9 04  LDA.L $E910,X                   ; A = entry type flag
$04:EA2A 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = flag
$04:EA2C 8A           TXA                             ; A = X
$04:EA2D 0A           ASL                             ; A *= 2
$04:EA2E AA           TAX                             ; X = word offset
$04:EA2F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:EA31 BF 94 E9 04  LDA.L $E994,X                   ; A = entry value
$04:EA35 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = value
$04:EA37 BF 3C E9 04  LDA.L $E93C,X                   ; A = entry destination offset
$04:EA3B 85 04        STA $04                         ; [$04] = destination
$04:EA3D A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = flag
$04:EA3F 29 01 00     AND.W #$0001                    ; Bit 0
$04:EA42 F0 0A        BEQ $EA4E                       ; Clear: write a layer 1 tile ($04EA4E)
$04:EA44 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$04:EA46 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = [$00] (source index)
$04:EA48 20 A9 E4     JSR.W $E4A9                     ; Copy the tile into the layer 2 map ($E4A9)
$04:EA4B 4C 5A EA     JMP.W $EA5A                     ; Continue at $04EA5A

$04:EA4E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:EA50 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$04:EA52 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = destination offset
$04:EA54 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = tile number
$04:EA56 9F 00 C8 7E  STA.L $7EC800,X                 ; Write it into the OW layer 1 map ($7E:C800)
$04:EA5A E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:EA5C FA           PLX                             ; Restore the entry index
$04:EA5D A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; A = event number
$04:EA5F 4C F9 E9     JMP.W $E9F9                     ; Continue searching

$04:EA62 9C 95 14     STZ.W $1495                     ; [$1495] = 0 (event timer)
$04:EA65 9C 94 14     STZ.W $1494                     ; [$1494] = 0
$04:EA68 A2 6F        LDX.B #$6F                      ; X = $6F
$04:EA6A BD 03 07     LDA.W $0703,X                   ; A = palette mirror byte [$0703+X]
$04:EA6D 9D 07 09     STA.W $0907,X                   ; Copy it to the upload buffer [$0907+X]
$04:EA70 9E 79 09     STZ.W $0979,X                   ; Clear [$0979+X]
$04:EA73 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$04:EA74 10 F4        BPL $EA6A                       ; Loop for $70 bytes
$04:EA76 A2 6F        LDX.B #$6F                      ; X = $6F
$04:EA78 A0 10        LDY.B #$10                      ; Y = $10: 16 bytes per row
$04:EA7A BD 83 07     LDA.W $0783,X                   ; A = palette byte [$0783+X]
$04:EA7D 9D 07 09     STA.W $0907,X                   ; Copy it to [$0907+X] (overwrites with the second palette half)
$04:EA80 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$04:EA81 88           DEY                             ; Y--
$04:EA82 D0 F6        BNE $EA7A                       ; Loop for 16 bytes
$04:EA84 8A           TXA                             ; A = X
$04:EA85 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$04:EA86 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; A -= $10
$04:EA88 AA           TAX                             ; X = A
$04:EA89 10 ED        BPL $EA78                       ; Loop while X >= 0
$04:EA8B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:EA8D A9 70 00     LDA.W #$0070                    ; A = $0070
$04:EA90 8D 05 09     STA.W $0905                     ; [$0905] = $0070 (upload record: size)
$04:EA93 A9 70 C0     LDA.W #$C070                    ; A = $C070
$04:EA96 8D 77 09     STA.W $0977                     ; [$0977] = $C070 (upload record: CGRAM address / flags)
$04:EA99 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:EA9B 9C E9 09     STZ.W $09E9                     ; [$09E9] = 0 (end of upload records)
$04:EA9E A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3
$04:EAA0 8D 80 06     STA.W $0680                     ; [$0680] = 3: request palette upload (probably)
$04:EAA3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:EAA4 AD 95 14     LDA.W $1495                     ; \
$04:EAA7 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; } Timer [$1495] < $40: not time for the next tile yet ($04EAC9)
$04:EAA9 90 1E        BCC $EAC9                       ; /
$04:EAAB EE 86 1B     INC.W $1B86                     ; Go to state 5: [$1B86]++
$04:EAAE 20 30 EE     JSR.W $EE30                     ; Draw the layer 2 tile into the map ($EE30)
$04:EAB1 20 96 E4     JSR.W $E496                     ; Update the layer 2 map from the event tile ($E496)
$04:EAB4 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:EAB6 EE EB 1D     INC.W $1DEB                     ; [$1DEB]++: next event tile
$04:EAB9 AD EB 1D     LDA.W $1DEB                     ; A = [$1DEB]
$04:EABC CD ED 1D     CMP.W $1DED                     ; \
$04:EABF E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / Reached the end index [$1DED]? A 8-bit
$04:EAC1 B0 05        BCS $EAC8                       ; Yes: return, stay in state 5
$04:EAC3 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3
$04:EAC5 8D 86 1B     STA.W $1B86                     ; [$1B86] = 3: lay the next event tile
$04:EAC8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:EAC9 20 67 EC     JSR.W $EC67                     ; Compute screen position of the effect ($EC67)
$04:EACC C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:EACE A0 8C 00     LDY.W #$008C                    ; Y = $008C: OAM offset for the 6x6 tile sprite set
$04:EAD1 A2 06 00     LDX.W #$0006                    ; X = 6: columns
$04:EAD4 AD 84 1B     LDA.W $1B84                     ; A = [$1B84] (tile source index)
$04:EAD7 C9 00 09     CMP.W #$0900                    ; Compare with $0900
$04:EADA 90 06        BCC $EAE2                       ; Below: 6x6
$04:EADC A0 0C 00     LDY.W #$000C                    ; Y = $000C: OAM offset for 2x2
$04:EADF A2 02 00     LDX.W #$0002                    ; X = 2: columns
$04:EAE2 86 05        STX $05                         ; [$05] = columns
$04:EAE4 AA           TAX                             ; X = tile source index
$04:EAE5 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:EAE7 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; A = columns
$04:EAE9 85 03        STA $03                         ; [$03] = column counter
$04:EAEB A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = X position
$04:EAED 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = X position of this tile
$04:EAEF A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = Y position
$04:EAF1 99 51 03     STA.W $0351,Y                   ; OAM Y of the tile ($0351+Y)
$04:EAF4 BF 00 80 0C  LDA.L $8000,X                   ; A = tile number from $8000[X]
$04:EAF8 99 52 03     STA.W $0352,Y                   ; OAM tile number
$04:EAFB BF 00 00 7F  LDA.L $7F0000,X                 ; A = attribute byte from $7F:0000[X]
$04:EAFF 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; Keep flip bits (6-7)
$04:EB01 85 04        STA $04                         ; [$04] = flips
$04:EB03 BF 00 00 7F  LDA.L $7F0000,X                 ; A = attribute byte
$04:EB07 29 1C        AND.B #$1C                      ; Keep palette bits (2-4)
$04:EB09 4A           LSR                             ; Palette to bits 1-3
$04:EB0A 05 04        ORA $04                         ; Add flips
$04:EB0C 09 11        ORA.B #$11                      ; Priority 1 and sprite page 1
$04:EB0E 99 53 03     STA.W $0353,Y                   ; OAM properties
$04:EB11 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = X position
$04:EB13 99 50 03     STA.W $0350,Y                   ; OAM X of the tile ($0350+Y)
$04:EB16 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:EB17 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; X position += 8
$04:EB19 E8           INX                             ; Next tile in the source
$04:EB1A 88           DEY                             ; \
$04:EB1B 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:EB1C 88           DEY                             ; } Y -= 4: previous OAM slot
$04:EB1D 88           DEY                             ; /
$04:EB1E C6 03        DEC $03                         ; Next column
$04:EB20 D0 CB        BNE $EAED                       ; Loop for the columns
$04:EB22 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = Y position
$04:EB24 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:EB25 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; Next row: += 8
$04:EB27 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = Y position
$04:EB29 C0 FC FF     CPY.W #$FFFC                    ; All OAM slots done (Y wrapped to $FFFC)?
$04:EB2C D0 B9        BNE $EAE7                       ; No: next row
$04:EB2E E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index 8-bit
$04:EB30 A2 23        LDX.B #$23                      ; X = $23
$04:EB32 9E 74 04     STZ.W $0474,X                   ; OAM size bits [$0474+X] = 0 (small)
$04:EB35 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$04:EB36 10 FA        BPL $EB32                       ; Loop for 36 sprites
$04:EB38 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; Y = 8
$04:EB3A AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; X = [$0DB3] (current player)
$04:EB3D BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; A = OW submap [$1F11+X]
$04:EB40 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; Submap 3?
$04:EB42 D0 02        BNE $EB46                       ; No: keep Y = 8
$04:EB44 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1 (one pass on this submap)
$04:EB46 84 8A        STY $8A                         ; [$8A] = pass counter
$04:EB48 AD 95 14     LDA.W $1495                     ; A = timer [$1495]
$04:EB4B 22 06 B0 00  JSL.L $B006                     ; Run the palette fade step ($B006)
$04:EB4F C6 8A        DEC $8A                         ; Next pass
$04:EB51 D0 F5        BNE $EB48                       ; Loop
$04:EB53 4C 8B EA     JMP.W $EA8B                     ; Finish through the palette upload setup ($04EA8B)


}

;;; $EBEB: Overworld event: smoke puff, level tile ;;;
{
;; States 1 and 6: animate a four-sprite smoke puff at ([$1B82],[$1B83]) while timer [$1B84] counts down.
;;     State 1 uses $EBE1 tiles,
;; state 6 uses $EBDA. At timer $10 (state 6) the level tile is replaced; at $18 (state 1) $EEAA
;;     runs.
;; $04EC67: converts effect position to screen position ([$00],[$01]). $04EC78: state 5, checks the level tile
;;     at the event position and starts the reveal.
$04:EBEB CE 84 1B     DEC.W $1B84                     ; Timer [$1B84]--
$04:EBEE 10 04        BPL $EBF4                       ; Still >= 0: animate ($04EBF4)
$04:EBF0 EE 86 1B     INC.W $1B86                     ; Timer expired: next state [$1B86]++
$04:EBF3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:EBF4 AD 84 1B     LDA.W $1B84                     ; A = timer
$04:EBF7 AC 86 1B     LDY.W $1B86                     ; Y = state [$1B86]
$04:EBFA C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; State 1?
$04:EBFC F0 19        BEQ $EC17                       ; Yes: go to $04EC17
$04:EBFE C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; Timer = $10?
$04:EC00 D0 05        BNE $EC07                       ; No
$04:EC02 48           PHA                             ; Save timer
$04:EC03 20 83 ED     JSR.W $ED83                     ; Replace the level tile on the map ($ED83)
$04:EC06 68           PLA                             ; Restore timer
$04:EC07 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:EC08 4A           LSR                             ; / A = timer / 4
$04:EC09 AA           TAX                             ; X = frame
$04:EC0A BD DA EB     LDA.W $EBDA,X                   ; A = puff tile number
$04:EC0D 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = tile
$04:EC0F 20 67 EC     JSR.W $EC67                     ; Compute the on-screen position ($EC67)
$04:EC12 A2 28        LDX.B #$28                      ; X = $28: sprite data offset for this puff
$04:EC14 4C 2E EC     JMP.W $EC2E                     ; Draw it ($04EC2E)

$04:EC17 C9 18        CMP.B #$18                      ; Timer = $18?
$04:EC19 D0 05        BNE $EC20                       ; No
$04:EC1B 48           PHA                             ; Save timer
$04:EC1C 20 AA EE     JSR.W $EEAA                     ; Update the tile for the level to reveal ($EEAA)
$04:EC1F 68           PLA                             ; Restore timer
$04:EC20 29 FC        AND.B #$FC                      ; A = timer AND $FC
$04:EC22 AA           TAX                             ; X = sprite data offset (4 bytes per frame)
$04:EC23 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:EC24 4A           LSR                             ; / A = timer / 4
$04:EC25 A8           TAY                             ; Y = frame
$04:EC26 B9 E1 EB     LDA.W $EBE1,Y                   ; A = puff tile number
$04:EC29 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = tile
$04:EC2B 20 67 EC     JSR.W $EC67                     ; Compute the on-screen position ($EC67)
$04:EC2E A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3
$04:EC30 85 03        STA $03                         ; [$03] = 3: four sprites
$04:EC32 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: OAM offset (slots $0280..)
$04:EC34 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = effect X
$04:EC36 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:EC37 7D 56 EB     ADC.W $EB56,X                   ; Add the sprite X offset
$04:EC3A 99 80 02     STA.W $0280,Y                   ; OAM X
$04:EC3D A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = effect Y
$04:EC3F 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:EC40 7D 82 EB     ADC.W $EB82,X                   ; Add the sprite Y offset
$04:EC43 99 81 02     STA.W $0281,Y                   ; OAM Y
$04:EC46 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = tile number
$04:EC48 99 82 02     STA.W $0282,Y                   ; OAM tile
$04:EC4B BD AE EB     LDA.W $EBAE,X                   ; A = properties
$04:EC4E 99 83 02     STA.W $0283,Y                   ; OAM properties
$04:EC51 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:EC52 C8           INY                             ; |
$04:EC53 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$04:EC54 C8           INY                             ; /
$04:EC55 E8           INX                             ; X++
$04:EC56 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; Next sprite
$04:EC58 10 DA        BPL $EC34                       ; Loop for 4 sprites
$04:EC5A 9C 40 04     STZ.W $0440                     ; OAM size bit [$0440] = 0 (small)
$04:EC5D 9C 41 04     STZ.W $0441                     ; [$0441] = 0
$04:EC60 9C 42 04     STZ.W $0442                     ; [$0442] = 0
$04:EC63 9C 43 04     STZ.W $0443                     ; [$0443] = 0
$04:EC66 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:EC67 AD 82 1B     LDA.W $1B82                     ; A = effect X [$1B82]
$04:EC6A 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$04:EC6B E5 1E        SBC $1E                         ; Minus layer 1 X scroll [$1E]
$04:EC6D 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = screen X
$04:EC6F AD 83 1B     LDA.W $1B83                     ; A = effect Y [$1B83]
$04:EC72 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry (subtract one more)
$04:EC73 E5 20        SBC $20                         ; Minus layer 1 Y scroll [$20] and 1
$04:EC75 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = screen Y
$04:EC77 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:EC78 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; A = $7E
$04:EC7A 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; [$0F] = $7E
$04:EC7C C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:EC7E A9 00 C8     LDA.W #$C800                    ; A = $C800
$04:EC81 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; [$0D] = $7EC800 (OW layer 1 map)
$04:EC83 AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number
$04:EC86 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; Keep 8 bits
$04:EC89 0A           ASL                             ; A *= 2
$04:EC8A AA           TAX                             ; X = word offset
$04:EC8B BF 5D D8 04  LDA.L $D85D,X                   ; A = map position of this event's level tile ($D85D)
$04:EC8F A8           TAY                             ; Y = map position
$04:EC90 A2 15 00     LDX.W #$0015                    ; X = $15: search 22 tile numbers
$04:EC93 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:EC95 B7 0D        LDA [$0D],Y                     ; A = tile currently on the map
$04:EC97 DF 1D DA 04  CMP.L $DA1D,X                   ; Compare with the table ($DA1D)
$04:EC9B F0 0B        BEQ $ECA8                       ; Match: reveal it
$04:EC9D CA           DEX                             ; Next entry
$04:EC9E 10 F7        BPL $EC97                       ; Loop for X = $15..0
$04:ECA0 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index 8-bit
$04:ECA2 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; A = 7
$04:ECA4 8D 86 1B     STA.W $1B86                     ; [$1B86] = 7: no level tile, finish
$04:ECA7 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:ECA8 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:ECAA A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$04:ECAC 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; Play sound effect 1 (level tile appears)
$04:ECAF EE 86 1B     INC.W $1B86                     ; Go to state 6: [$1B86]++
$04:ECB2 AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; A = event number
$04:ECB5 29 FF        AND.B #$FF                      ; Keep 8 bits
$04:ECB7 0A           ASL                             ; A *= 2
$04:ECB8 AA           TAX                             ; X = word offset
$04:ECB9 BF 5D D8 04  LDA.L $D85D,X                   ; A = map position (low byte)
$04:ECBD 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:ECBE 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:ECBF 0A           ASL                             ; } A <<= 4
$04:ECC0 0A           ASL                             ; /
$04:ECC1 8D 82 1B     STA.W $1B82                     ; [$1B82] = effect X
$04:ECC4 BF 5D D8 04  LDA.L $D85D,X                   ; A = map position (low byte)
$04:ECC8 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; Keep high nibble
$04:ECCA 8D 83 1B     STA.W $1B83                     ; [$1B83] = effect Y
$04:ECCD A9 1C        LDA.B #$1C                      ; A = $1C
$04:ECCF 8D 84 1B     STA.W $1B84                     ; [$1B84] = $1C (puff timer)
$04:ECD2 60           RTS                             ; Return


}
