;;; $ED83: Replace event tile and draw 2x2 stripe ;;;
{
;; Overworld event: finds the layer 1 tile at the current event position in $DA1D, writes the matching
;;     replacement tile ($DA33) into the map at $7E:C800 and queues two stripe records (2x2 tiles) for the
;;     new graphic.
;; Second routine at $04EE30: draws a layer 2 event tile run and terminates the stripe buffer. Details of the
;;     $1DEA/$1DEB tables are inferred.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:EC03: Overworld event: smoke puff, level tile
$04:ED83 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$04:ED85 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / $0F = $7E: bank of the pointer at [$0D] (layer 1 map $7E:C800)
$04:ED87 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; \
$04:ED89 A9 00 C8     LDA.W #$C800                    ; } [$0D] = $7EC800: 24-bit pointer to the overworld layer 1 tile map
$04:ED8C 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; /
$04:ED8E AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; \
$04:ED91 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:ED94 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:ED95 AA           TAX                             ; |
$04:ED96 BF 5D D8 04  LDA.L $D85D,X                   ; } Y = $D85D[[$1DEA] * 2]: map offset of the current submap tile row
$04:ED9A A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:ED9B A2 15 00     LDX.W #$0015                    ; X = $15: search index into $DA1D (22 tile numbers)
$04:ED9E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:EDA0 B7 0D        LDA [$0D],Y                     ; A = layer 1 tile currently at this map position
$04:EDA2 DF 1D DA 04  CMP.L $DA1D,X                   ; Compare with $DA1D[X]
$04:EDA6 F0 03        BEQ $EDAB                       ; Match found: stop searching
$04:EDA8 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:EDA9 D0 F7        BNE $EDA2                       ; / X--; loop until X = 0 (no match leaves X = 0)
$04:EDAB C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:EDAD 86 0E        STX $0E                         ; [$0E] = X: index of the tile found (event tile type)
$04:EDAF AD EA 1D     LDA.W $1DEA                     ; \
$04:EDB2 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:EDB5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:EDB6 AA           TAX                             ; |
$04:EDB7 BF 3D D9 04  LDA.L $D93D,X                   ; } [$00] = $D93D[[$1DEA] * 2]: VRAM address of this submap tile
$04:EDBB 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$04:EDBD BF 5D D8 04  LDA.L $D85D,X                   ; \
$04:EDC1 AA           TAX                             ; } Save X = $D85D[[$1DEA] * 2] (map offset)
$04:EDC2 DA           PHX                             ; /
$04:EDC3 A6 0E        LDX $0E                         ; X = [$0E]
$04:EDC5 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:EDC7 BF 33 DA 04  LDA.L $DA33,X                   ; A = $DA33[X]: replacement tile number for this tile type
$04:EDCB FA           PLX                             ; Restore the map offset
$04:EDCC 9F 00 C8 7E  STA.L $7EC800,X                 ; Write the new tile into the layer 1 map at $7E:C800 + offset
$04:EDD0 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:EDD2 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = 4: bank of the pointer at [$0A]
$04:EDD4 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:EDD6 A9 D3 EC     LDA.W #$ECD3                    ; \
$04:EDD9 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / [$0A] = $04ECD3: table of 4 tile words per tile type
$04:EDDB A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$04:EDDD 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:EDDE 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:EDDF 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = [$0E] * 8: byte offset into that table
$04:EDE0 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:EDE1 AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; \
$04:EDE5 AA           TAX                             ; / X = stripe image write index [$7F:837B]
$04:EDE6 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = VRAM address (first tile row)
$04:EDE8 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Stripe record 1: VRAM address
$04:EDEC 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear for the add
$04:EDED 69 00 20     ADC.W #$2000                    ; VRAM address + $2000 (high byte + $20 = next tile row)
$04:EDF0 9F 85 83 7F  STA.L $7F8385,X                 ; Stripe record 2: VRAM address of the second row
$04:EDF4 A9 00 03     LDA.W #$0300                    ; A = $0300: record header, 4 data bytes (2 tiles) per row
$04:EDF7 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; Record 1: length word
$04:EDFB 9F 87 83 7F  STA.L $7F8387,X                 ; Record 2: length word
$04:EDFF B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; \
$04:EE01 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; / Record 1 data: top-left tile and attributes (word 0 of the entry)
$04:EE05 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:EE06 C8           INY                             ; |
$04:EE07 B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; } Record 2 data: bottom-left tile and attributes (word 1 of the entry)
$04:EE09 9F 89 83 7F  STA.L $7F8389,X                 ; /
$04:EE0D C8           INY                             ; \
$04:EE0E C8           INY                             ; |
$04:EE0F B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; } Record 1 data: top-right tile and attributes (word 2 of the entry)
$04:EE11 9F 83 83 7F  STA.L $7F8383,X                 ; /
$04:EE15 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:EE16 C8           INY                             ; |
$04:EE17 B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; } Record 2 data: bottom-right tile and attributes (word 3 of the entry)
$04:EE19 9F 8B 83 7F  STA.L $7F838B,X                 ; /
$04:EE1D A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; A = $00FF
$04:EE20 9F 8D 83 7F  STA.L $7F838D,X                 ; Stripe end marker $FF after the two records
$04:EE24 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:EE25 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:EE26 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; } Stripe write index += $10 (two 8-byte records)
$04:EE29 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; /
$04:EE2D E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:EE2F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:EE30 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:EE32 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$04:EE34 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / [$0E] = $7F: bank of the pointer at [$0C]/[$0A]
$04:EE36 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:EE38 AD EB 1D     LDA.W $1DEB                     ; \
$04:EE3B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:EE3C 0A           ASL                             ; } X = [$1DEB] * 4: index into the layer 2 event table
$04:EE3D AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:EE3E BF 8F DD 04  LDA.L $DD8F,X                   ; A = $DD8F[X]: layer 2 position/flags word
$04:EE42 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = that word
$04:EE44 29 FF 1F     AND.W #$1FFF                    ; \
$04:EE47 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:EE48 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:EE49 69 00 30     ADC.W #$3000                    ; } [$02] = $3000 + ((word & $1FFF) / 2) with bytes swapped: VRAM-style address
$04:EE4C EB           XBA                             ; /
$04:EE4D 85 02        STA $02
$04:EE4F A9 00 40     LDA.W #$4000                    ; A = $4000
$04:EE52 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; [$0C] = $4000
$04:EE54 A9 FF FF     LDA.W #$FFFF                    ; A = $FFFF
$04:EE57 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; [$0A] = $FFFF
$04:EE59 BF 8D DD 04  LDA.L $DD8D,X                   ; A = $DD8D[X]: event layer 2 tile/size word
$04:EE5D C9 00 09     CMP.W #$0900                    ; Compare with $0900
$04:EE60 90 06        BCC $EE68                       ; Below $0900: use the other tile writer at $04EE68
$04:EE62 20 6C E7     JSR.W $E76C                     ; Draw the layer 2 tile run ($E76C)
$04:EE65 4C 6B EE     JMP.W $EE6B                     ; Skip the other writer

$04:EE68 20 24 E8     JSR.W $E824                     ; Draw the layer 2 tile run ($E824)
$04:EE6B A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; A = $00FF
$04:EE6E 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Stripe end marker $FF after the new records
$04:EE72 8A           TXA                             ; A = X: new stripe write index
$04:EE73 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; Update the stripe write index [$7F:837B]
$04:EE77 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:EE79 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$04:EE7A              .db $22,$01,$82,$1C,$22,$01,$83,$1C ; Block 0 (TL, BL, TR, BR): tiles $22 $82 $22 $83
$04:EE82              .db $22,$01,$82,$14,$22,$01,$83,$14 ; Block 1: tiles $22 $82 $22 $83, palette variant

;;; $EEAA: Draw event tile blocks into stripe image ;;;
{
;; Queues 2x2 tile blocks from the table at $04EE7A as stripe records, one block per row, depending on the
;;     event step [$13D0] and event [$13D1]. Jumps back into $ED83 at $04EDE6 to write the last block.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:EC1C: Overworld event: smoke puff, level tile
$04:EEAA E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$04:EEAC A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$04:EEAE 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / $0F = $7E: bank of the pointer at [$0D]
$04:EEB0 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:EEB2 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = 4: bank of the pointer at [$0A]
$04:EEB4 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$04:EEB6 A9 00 C8     LDA.W #$C800                    ; \
$04:EEB9 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; / [$0D] = $C800 (layer 1 map $7E:C800)
$04:EEBB A9 7A EE     LDA.W #$EE7A                    ; \
$04:EEBE 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / [$0A] = $04EE7A: table of 2x2 tile blocks
$04:EEC0 AD D1 13     LDA.W $13D1                     ; \
$04:EEC3 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$04:EEC6 0A           ASL                             ; } X = [$13D1] * 2: index into $E587
$04:EEC7 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:EEC8 BF 87 E5 04  LDA.L $E587,X                   ; \
$04:EECC 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $E587[X]: VRAM address of the first block row
$04:EECE AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; \
$04:EED2 AA           TAX                             ; / X = stripe image write index [$7F:837B]
$04:EED3 AD D0 13     LDA.W $13D0                     ; \
$04:EED6 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Compare [$13D0] (event step) with 3
$04:EED9 C9 03 00     CMP.W #$0003                    ; /
$04:EEDC 30 49        BMI $EF27                       ; Below 3: skip the first row of blocks
$04:EEDE 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:EEDF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:EEE0 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = [$13D0] * 8: byte offset into the tile block table
$04:EEE1 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:EEE2 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = VRAM address
$04:EEE4 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Stripe record 1: VRAM address
$04:EEE8 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear for the add
$04:EEE9 69 00 20     ADC.W #$2000                    ; VRAM address + $2000 (next tile row)
$04:EEEC 9F 85 83 7F  STA.L $7F8385,X                 ; Stripe record 2: VRAM address of the second row
$04:EEF0 EB           XBA                             ; \
$04:EEF1 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:EEF2 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; } [$00] += $20 in the high byte (VRAM address of the next block position)
$04:EEF5 EB           XBA                             ; /
$04:EEF6 85 00        STA $00
$04:EEF8 A9 00 03     LDA.W #$0300                    ; A = $0300: record header, 4 data bytes per row
$04:EEFB 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; Record 1: length word
$04:EEFF 9F 87 83 7F  STA.L $7F8387,X                 ; Record 2: length word
$04:EF03 B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; \
$04:EF05 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; / Record 1 data: top-left tile
$04:EF09 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:EF0A C8           INY                             ; |
$04:EF0B B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; } Record 2 data: bottom-left tile
$04:EF0D 9F 89 83 7F  STA.L $7F8389,X                 ; /
$04:EF11 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:EF12 C8           INY                             ; |
$04:EF13 B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; } Record 1 data: top-right tile
$04:EF15 9F 83 83 7F  STA.L $7F8383,X                 ; /
$04:EF19 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:EF1A C8           INY                             ; |
$04:EF1B B7 0A        LDA [$0A],Y                     ; } Record 2 data: bottom-right tile
$04:EF1D 9F 8B 83 7F  STA.L $7F838B,X                 ; /
$04:EF21 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:EF22 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:EF23 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; } Stripe write index += $10
$04:EF26 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:EF27 AD D0 13     LDA.W $13D0                     ; \
$04:EF2A 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Compare [$13D0] with 2
$04:EF2D C9 02 00     CMP.W #$0002                    ; /
$04:EF30 10 06        BPL $EF38                       ; [$13D0] >= 2: use fixed block offset $28
$04:EF32 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:EF33 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:EF34 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = [$13D0] * 8: block table offset
$04:EF35 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:EF36 80 03        BRA $EF3B                       ; Go write the final block

$04:EF38 A0 28 00     LDY.W #$0028                    ; Y = $28: block table offset for steps 2 and above
$04:EF3B 4C E6 ED     JMP.W $EDE6                     ; Write the last block (jump into the middle of $ED83 at $04EDE6)
; Ending early for table of FF's up ahread

}

;;; $F280..F288: Table: ! block particle X speeds ;;;
{

$04:F288              .db $D0,$D8,$D8,$00,$00,$28,$28,$30

;;; $F290: Switch palace ! block particles ;;;
{
;; Overworld effect after a switch palace is completed ([$13D2] non-zero): spawns batches of eight ! block
;;     particles around the player, moves them (X, Y, height with gravity) and draws them as OAM tile $E6.
;; $04F397: advance one position axis of one particle and convert it to a screen coordinate.
;; $04F3E5: state dispatcher for the overworld two-player lives exchange screen ([$1B87]).
;; Parameters: [$1439] phase, [$1437] timer, [RAM_KeyHolePos1/2] reused as particle count and OAM offset.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:826F: Game mode 0E: overworld (GameMode_0E_Prim)
$04:F290 AC 39 14     LDY.W $1439                     ; Y = [$1439]: switch palace block effect phase
$04:F293 C0 0C        CPY.B #$0C                      ; Compare with $0C
$04:F295 90 04        BCC $F29B                       ; Below $0C: effect still running
$04:F297 9C D2 13     STZ.W $13D2                     ; Effect finished: [$13D2] = 0
$04:F29A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:F29B AD 37 14     LDA.W $1437                     ; A = [$1437] (spawn timer)
$04:F29E D0 74        BNE $F314                       ; Timer not expired: skip spawning
$04:F2A0 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Compare phase with 8
$04:F2A2 B0 68        BCS $F30C                       ; Phase >= 8: no more batches, just reset the timer
$04:F2A4 A9 1C        LDA.B #$1C                      ; \
$04:F2A6 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $1C
$04:F2A9 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$04:F2AB 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = 7: eight particles per batch
$04:F2AD AE 36 14     LDX.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; X = [RAM_KeyHolePos1]: next free particle slot (reused as spawn counter)
$04:F2B0 AC D6 0D     LDY.W $0DD6                     ; Y = [$0DD6]: index of the current player on the overworld
$04:F2B3 B9 17 1F     LDA.W $1F17,Y                   ; \
$04:F2B6 9F 78 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB978,X                 ; / Particle X position low = player X on the overworld ([$1F17+Y])
$04:F2BA B9 18 1F     LDA.W $1F18,Y                   ; \
$04:F2BD 9F 00 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB900,X                 ; / Particle X position high ([$1F18+Y])
$04:F2C1 B9 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,Y                   ; \
$04:F2C4 9F A0 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB9A0,X                 ; / Particle Y position low ([$1F19+Y])
$04:F2C8 B9 1A 1F     LDA.W $1F1A,Y                   ; \
$04:F2CB 9F 28 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB928,X                 ; / Particle Y position high ([$1F1A+Y])
$04:F2CF A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$04:F2D1 9F C8 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB9C8,X                 ; Particle height (low) = 0
$04:F2D5 9F 50 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB950,X                 ; Particle height (high) = 0
$04:F2D9 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = [$00]: direction index 0-7
$04:F2DB B9 80 F2     LDA.W $F280,Y                   ; \
$04:F2DE 9F F0 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB9F0,X                 ; / Particle X speed = $F280[Y]
$04:F2E2 B9 88 F2     LDA.W $F288,Y                   ; \
$04:F2E5 9F 18 BA 7E  STA.L $7EBA18,X                 ; / Particle Y speed = $F288[Y]
$04:F2E9 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$04:F2EB 9F 40 BA 7E  STA.L $7EBA40,X                 ; / Particle height speed = $D0 (launched upward)
$04:F2EF E8           INX                             ; Next particle slot
$04:F2F0 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; Next direction
$04:F2F2 10 BC        BPL $F2B0                       ; Loop for 8 directions
$04:F2F4 E0 28        CPX.B #$28                      ; Compare slot with $28 (40 particles max)
$04:F2F6 90 11        BCC $F309                       ; Not full: just save the slot counter
$04:F2F8 AD 38 14     LDA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; \
$04:F2FB 18           CLC                             ; / OAM offset [RAM_KeyHolePos2] += $20
$04:F2FC 69 20        ADC.B #$20
$04:F2FE C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; \
$04:F300 90 02        BCC $F304                       ; / Wrap to 0 when it reaches $A0
$04:F302 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Wrap to 0
$04:F304 8D 38 14     STA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; Save the OAM offset
$04:F307 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; Slot counter wraps to 0
$04:F309 8E 36 14     STX.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; Save [RAM_KeyHolePos1] = slot counter
$04:F30C A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$04:F30E 8D 37 14     STA.W $1437                     ; / Spawn timer [$1437] = $10 frames until next batch
$04:F311 EE 39 14     INC.W $1439                     ; Phase [$1439]++
$04:F314 CE 37 14     DEC.W $1437                     ; Spawn timer--
$04:F317 AD 38 14     LDA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; \
$04:F31A 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = OAM offset [RAM_KeyHolePos2]: where the first sprite goes
$04:F31C A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: first particle
$04:F31E DA           PHX                             ; Save particle index
$04:F31F A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: offset into direct page positions ([$00] X, [$02] Y, [$04] height)
$04:F321 20 9C F3     JSR.W $F39C                     ; Update the X position ($F39C)
$04:F324 20 97 F3     JSR.W $F397                     ; Update the Y position (X += $28)
$04:F327 20 97 F3     JSR.W $F397                     ; Update the height (X += $28)
$04:F32A FA           PLX                             ; Restore particle index
$04:F32B BF 40 BA 7E  LDA.L $7EBA40,X                 ; \
$04:F32F 18           CLC                             ; } Height speed + 1 (gravity)
$04:F330 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; /
$04:F332 30 06        BMI $F33A                       ; Negative (still rising): keep it
$04:F334 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; Compare with terminal speed $40
$04:F336 90 02        BCC $F33A                       ; Below: keep it
$04:F338 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; Clamp height speed to $40
$04:F33A 9F 40 BA 7E  STA.L $7EBA40,X                 ; Store the height speed
$04:F33E BF 50 B9 7E  LDA.L $7EB950,X                 ; \
$04:F342 EB           XBA                             ; } A = height ($7EB950/$7EB9C8) as a 16-bit value
$04:F343 BF C8 B9 7E  LDA.L $7EB9C8,X                 ; /
$04:F347 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:F349 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F34A 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } [$02] += height: screen Y adjusted for how high the particle is
$04:F34C 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$04:F34E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:F350 EB           XBA                             ; \
$04:F351 05 01        ORA $01                         ; / A = high byte of screen Y | high byte of [$02]: non-zero means off screen
$04:F353 D0 23        BNE $F378                       ; Off screen: skip drawing this particle
$04:F355 A4 0F        LDY $0F                         ; Y = [$0F]: OAM offset
$04:F357 EB           XBA                             ; \
$04:F358 99 41 03     STA.W $0341,Y                   ; / OAM Y = screen Y low byte
$04:F35B A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:F35D 99 40 03     STA.W $0340,Y                   ; / OAM X = screen X low byte
$04:F360 A9 E6        LDA.B #$E6                      ; \
$04:F362 99 42 03     STA.W $0342,Y                   ; / OAM tile = $E6 (! block)
$04:F365 AD D2 13     LDA.W $13D2                     ; \
$04:F368 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$04:F369 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:F36A 09 30        ORA.B #$30                      ; } OAM properties: palette from switch colour [$13D2], priority 3
$04:F36C 99 43 03     STA.W $0343,Y                   ; /
$04:F36F 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:F370 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:F371 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM offset / 4: index into the OAM size table
$04:F372 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:F373 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:F375 99 70 04     STA.W $0470,Y                   ; / OAM size bit: 16x16 sprite
$04:F378 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$04:F37A 18           CLC                             ; } [$0F] += 4: next OAM slot
$04:F37B 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; /
$04:F37D C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; \
$04:F37F 90 02        BCC $F383                       ; / Wrap to 0 at $A0
$04:F381 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Wrap to 0
$04:F383 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; Save OAM offset
$04:F385 E8           INX                             ; Next particle
$04:F386 EC 36 14     CPX.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; Compare with slot counter
$04:F389 90 93        BCC $F31E                       ; Loop for all spawned particles
$04:F38B AD 39 14     LDA.W $1439                     ; \
$04:F38E C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; } [$1439] < 5: stop here
$04:F390 90 04        BCC $F396                       ; /
$04:F392 E0 28        CPX.B #$28                      ; Compare index with $28
$04:F394 90 88        BCC $F31E                       ; Keep drawing until all 40 slots are done
$04:F396 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:F397 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:F398 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F399 69 28        ADC.B #$28                      ; } Move to the next array: X += $28 (X, Y, then height)
$04:F39B AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:F39C 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y (direct page offset)
$04:F39D BF F0 B9 7E  LDA.L $7EB9F0,X                 ; \
$04:F3A1 0A           ASL                             ; / Speed * 16: speed low nibble becomes the fractional part
$04:F3A2 0A           ASL 
$04:F3A3 0A           ASL 
$04:F3A4 0A           ASL 
$04:F3A5 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:F3A6 7F 68 BA 7E  ADC.L $7EBA68,X                 ; } Add to the fractional position ($7EBA68+X)
$04:F3AA 9F 68 BA 7E  STA.L $7EBA68,X                 ; /
$04:F3AE BF F0 B9 7E  LDA.L $7EB9F0,X                 ; A = speed
$04:F3B2 08           PHP                             ; Save the sign of the speed
$04:F3B3 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:F3B4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:F3B5 4A           LSR                             ; } Speed / 16: integer part
$04:F3B6 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:F3B7 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte of the delta
$04:F3B9 28           PLP                             ; Restore flags: speed sign
$04:F3BA 10 03        BPL $F3BF                       ; Positive: skip sign extension
$04:F3BC 09 F0        ORA.B #$F0                      ; Negative: set the upper nibble
$04:F3BE 88           DEY                             ; High byte of the delta = $FF
$04:F3BF 7F 78 B9 7E  ADC.L $7EB978,X                 ; \
$04:F3C3 9F 78 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB978,X                 ; / Position low += delta (+ carry from fraction)
$04:F3C7 EB           XBA                             ; Save low byte
$04:F3C8 98           TYA                             ; A = delta high byte
$04:F3C9 7F 00 B9 7E  ADC.L $7EB900,X                 ; \
$04:F3CD 9F 00 B9 7E  STA.L $7EB900,X                 ; / Position high += delta high byte (+ carry)
$04:F3D1 EB           XBA                             ; A = position as 16-bit (low in A)
$04:F3D2 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$04:F3D3 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:F3D5 38           SEC                             ; \
$04:F3D6 F9 1A 00     SBC.W RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,Y      ; |
$04:F3D9 38           SEC                             ; } Screen position = position - [RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,Y] (camera X/Y) - 8
$04:F3DA E9 08 00     SBC.W #$0008                    ; /
$04:F3DD 99 00 00     STA.W $0000,Y                   ; Store in [$00,$02,$04] by Y
$04:F3E0 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:F3E2 C8           INY                             ; \
$04:F3E3 C8           INY                             ; / Y += 2
$04:F3E4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:F3E5 3A           DEC A                           ; A = [$1B87] - 1: lives exchange state 0-7
$04:F3E6 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the pointer table

}

;;; $F3EA: Pointer table: lives exchange states (Ptrs04F3EA) ;;;
{
;; Eight state routines for the lives exchange screen, indexed by [$1B87] - 1.
$04:F3EA FF F3        .dw $F3FF                       ; 0: start (play sound, reset windows)
$04:F3EC 15 F4        .dw $F415                       ; 1: iris window closes/opens
$04:F3EE 13 F5        .dw $F513                       ; 2: lives exchange input
$04:F3F0 15 F4        .dw $F415                       ; 3: iris window
$04:F3F2 FF F3        .dw $F3FF                       ; 4: start
$04:F3F4 15 F4        .dw $F415                       ; 5: iris window
$04:F3F6 FA F3        .dw $F3FA                       ; 6: finish ($F3FA)
$04:F3F8 15 F4        .dw $F415                       ; 7: iris window

$04:F3FA 22 A8 9B 00  JSL.L $9BA8                     ; Run $9BA8 (probably returns to the overworld after the exchange)
$04:F3FE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:F3FF A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$04:F401 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $22
$04:F404 EE 87 1B     INC.W $1B87                     ; Lives exchange state [$1B87]++
$04:F407 64 41        STZ $41                         ; \
$04:F409 64 42        STZ $42                         ; / Clear window mask mirrors [$41]/[$42]/[$43]
$04:F40B 64 43        STZ $43                         ; [$43] = 0 (color window)
$04:F40D 9C 9F 0D     STZ.W $0D9F                     ; HDMA enable mirror = 0
$04:F410 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F411..F413: Table: iris window step and target ;;;
{
;; Two bytes each: step per frame (+4/-4) and target radius ($68/$00).
$04:F411              .db $04,$FC                     ; Radius step per frame: +4 (growing), -4 (shrinking)

$04:F413              .db $68,$00                     ; Target radius: $68 (closed) or $00 (open)

}

;;; $F415: Lives exchange: iris window effect ;;;
{
;; Closes/opens a circular window on the overworld around the screen centre, one step per frame, and advances
;;     [$1B87] when the target radius is reached.
;; State 7 shows the CONTINUE AND SAVE stripe image. Also selects the player with more lives.
$04:F415 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0
$04:F417 AD B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives           ; \
$04:F41A CD B5 0D     CMP.W $0DB5                     ; / Compare Mario lives with Luigi lives
$04:F41D 10 01        BPL $F420                       ; Mario >= Luigi: select Mario
$04:F41F E8           INX                             ; Luigi has more lives: X = 1
$04:F420 8E 8A 1B     STX.W $1B8A                     ; [$1B8A] = selected player (the one with more lives)
$04:F423 AE 88 1B     LDX.W $1B88                     ; X = [$1B88]: iris direction
$04:F426 AD 89 1B     LDA.W $1B89                     ; A = [$1B89]: current iris radius
$04:F429 DF 13 F4 04  CMP.L $F413,X                   ; Reached the target radius?
$04:F42D D0 1C        BNE $F44B                       ; No: keep moving it
$04:F42F EE 87 1B     INC.W $1B87                     ; Radius reached: state [$1B87]++
$04:F432 AD 87 1B     LDA.W $1B87                     ; A = new state
$04:F435 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; State 7?
$04:F437 D0 04        BNE $F43D                       ; No: skip
$04:F439 A0 1E        LDY.B #$1E                      ; \
$04:F43B 84 12        STY $12                         ; / State 7: [$12] = $1E, stripe image CONTINUE AND SAVE
$04:F43D 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$04:F43E 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / (state - 1) & 3
$04:F440 D0 08        BNE $F44A                       ; Not a multiple of 4: return
$04:F442 9C 87 1B     STZ.W $1B87                     ; Sequence over: state [$1B87] = 0
$04:F445 9C 88 1B     STZ.W $1B88                     ; Iris direction [$1B88] = 0
$04:F448 80 BD        BRA $F407                       ; Go reset the window registers ($F407)

$04:F44A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:F44B 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:F44C 7F 11 F4 04  ADC.L $F411,X                   ; / A = radius + step
$04:F450 8D 89 1B     STA.W $1B89                     ; Store the new radius [$1B89]
$04:F453 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:F454 69 80        ADC.B #$80                      ; } Window half-width + $80 into the high byte (swap bytes)
$04:F456 EB           XBA                             ; /
$04:F457 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$04:F459 A2 6E 01     LDX.W #$016E                    ; X = $016E: clear the window HDMA table at $04F0
$04:F45C A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF
$04:F45E 9D F0 04     STA.W $04F0,X                   ; Left edge = $FF (empty window)
$04:F461 9E F1 04     STZ.W $04F1,X                   ; Right edge = 0
$04:F464 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:F465 CA           DEX                             ; / X -= 2
$04:F466 10 F6        BPL $F45E                       ; Loop for the whole table
$04:F468 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index 8-bit
$04:F46A AD 89 1B     LDA.W $1B89                     ; \
$04:F46D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:F46E 6D 89 1B     ADC.W $1B89                     ; |
$04:F471 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:F472 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; } X = radius * 3/4 rounded to even: number of scanlines to circle edge
$04:F474 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:F475 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$04:F477 38           SEC                             ; } A = $80 - radius: window left edge
$04:F478 ED 89 1B     SBC.W $1B89                     ; /
$04:F47B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:F47D A0 48        LDY.B #$48                      ; Y = $48
$04:F47F 99 48 05     STA.W $0548,Y                   ; Store window edge in the lower half of the table
$04:F482 9D 90 05     STA.W $0590,X                   ; Store window edge in the upper half of the table
$04:F485 88           DEY                             ; \
$04:F486 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:F487 CA           DEX                             ; } Y -= 2, X -= 2
$04:F488 CA           DEX                             ; /
$04:F489 10 F4        BPL $F47F                       ; Loop
$04:F48B 9C 01 07     STZ.W $0701                     ; Clear $0701
$04:F48E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:F490 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$04:F492 85 41        STA $41                         ; / [$41] = $22: window mask W12SEL (BG1/BG2 window 1)
$04:F494 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$04:F496 4C 95 DB     JMP.W $DB95                     ; Set [$43] = $20 and enable HDMA ($DB95)


}

;;; $F513: Lives exchange: input and drawing ;;;
{
;; Handles the two-player lives screen: Start continues, the other buttons choose a player and give one life
;;     to the other player (cap 98), then draws the player names, lives and blinking cursor.
$04:F513 AD A6 0D     LDA.W RAM_OWControllerA         ; \
$04:F516 0D A7 0D     ORA.W $0DA7                     ; / Start pressed on either controller?
$04:F519 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; Mask $10
$04:F51B F0 0E        BEQ $F52B                       ; No: handle left/right selection
$04:F51D AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; X = [$0DB3]: current player
$04:F520 BD B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; \
$04:F523 8D BE 0D     STA.W RAM_StatusLives           ; / Status bar lives = current player lives
$04:F526 22 13 9C 00  JSL.L $9C13                     ; Advance to the next state ($9C13: [$1B87]++, [$1B88]++)
$04:F52A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:F52B AD A6 0D     LDA.W RAM_OWControllerA         ; A = controller 1 buttons
$04:F52E 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; Mask $C0
$04:F530 D0 09        BNE $F53B                       ; Pressed: handle selection
$04:F532 AD A7 0D     LDA.W $0DA7                     ; A = controller 2 buttons
$04:F535 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; Mask $C0
$04:F537 F0 33        BEQ $F56C                       ; Nothing pressed: just draw the screen
$04:F539 49 C0        EOR.B #$C0                      ; Controller 2: invert so the choice matches controller 1
$04:F53B A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1
$04:F53D 0A           ASL                             ; Shift bit 7 into carry
$04:F53E B0 01        BCS $F541                       ; Bit 7 set: keep X = 1
$04:F540 CA           DEX                             ; Bit 6 set: X = 0
$04:F541 EC 8A 1B     CPX.W $1B8A                     ; Same player as before?
$04:F544 F0 05        BEQ $F54B                       ; Yes: no change
$04:F546 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$04:F548 8D 8B 1B     STA.W $1B8B                     ; / Restart the cursor blink timer [$1B8B] = $18
$04:F54B 8E 8A 1B     STX.W $1B8A                     ; [$1B8A] = chosen player
$04:F54E 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:F54F 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Y = other player (X xor 1)
$04:F551 A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:F552 BD B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; A = lives of the chosen player
$04:F555 F0 15        BEQ $F56C                       ; Zero lives: nothing to give
$04:F557 30 13        BMI $F56C                       ; Negative (game over): nothing to give
$04:F559 B9 B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives,Y         ; A = lives of the other player
$04:F55C C9 62        CMP.B #$62                      ; Compare with $62 (98 lives)
$04:F55E 10 0C        BPL $F56C                       ; Already at the cap: no transfer
$04:F560 1A           INC A                           ; Other player lives + 1
$04:F561 99 B4 0D     STA.W RAM_PlayerLives,Y         ; Store
$04:F564 DE B4 0D     DEC.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; Chosen player lives - 1
$04:F567 A9 23        LDA.B #$23                      ; \
$04:F569 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $23
$04:F56C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:F56E A9 48 78     LDA.W #$7848                    ; \
$04:F571 8D 9C 02     STA.W $029C                     ; / OAM sprite 39: X = $48, Y = $78
$04:F574 A9 90 78     LDA.W #$7890                    ; \
$04:F577 8D A0 02     STA.W $02A0                     ; / OAM sprite 40: X = $90, Y = $78
$04:F57A A9 0A 34     LDA.W #$340A                    ; \
$04:F57D 8D 9E 02     STA.W $029E                     ; / OAM sprite 39: tile $0A, properties $34
$04:F580 A9 0A 36     LDA.W #$360A                    ; \
$04:F583 8D A2 02     STA.W $02A2                     ; / OAM sprite 40: tile $0A, properties $36
$04:F586 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:F588 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:F58A 8D 47 04     STA.W $0447                     ; / OAM size bit for sprite 39: large
$04:F58D 8D 48 04     STA.W $0448                     ; OAM size bit for sprite 40: large
$04:F590 22 F2 DB 05  JSL.L $DBF2                     ; Build the status text/images ($DBF2)
$04:F594 A0 50        LDY.B #$50                      ; Y = $50: size of the stripe image - 1
$04:F596 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:F597 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F598 6F 7B 83 7F  ADC.L $7F837B                   ; } Stripe write index += $51; X = new end
$04:F59C 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; /
$04:F5A0 AA           TAX 
$04:F5A1 B9 B2 F4     LDA.W $F4B2,Y                   ; Copy the stripe image $F4B2 backwards into the buffer
$04:F5A4 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Store byte
$04:F5A8 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:F5A9 88           DEY                             ; / X--, Y--
$04:F5AA 10 F5        BPL $F5A1                       ; Loop for the whole image
$04:F5AC E8           INX                             ; X = start of this image in the buffer
$04:F5AD C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:F5AF AC B4 0D     LDY.W RAM_PlayerLives           ; Y = Mario lives
$04:F5B2 30 0B        BMI $F5BF                       ; Negative (out of lives): leave marker tiles
$04:F5B4 A9 FC 38     LDA.W #$38FC                    ; Blank tile $FC, attr $38
$04:F5B7 9F C1 83 7F  STA.L $7F83C1,X                 ; Erase Mario marker tile 1
$04:F5BB 9F C3 83 7F  STA.L $7F83C3,X                 ; Erase Mario marker tile 2
$04:F5BF AC B5 0D     LDY.W $0DB5                     ; Y = Luigi lives
$04:F5C2 30 0B        BMI $F5CF                       ; Negative: leave marker tiles
$04:F5C4 A9 FC 38     LDA.W #$38FC                    ; Blank tile
$04:F5C7 9F C9 83 7F  STA.L $7F83C9,X                 ; Erase Luigi marker tile 1
$04:F5CB 9F CB 83 7F  STA.L $7F83CB,X                 ; Erase Luigi marker tile 2
$04:F5CF E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:F5D1 EE 8B 1B     INC.W $1B8B                     ; Cursor blink timer [$1B8B]++
$04:F5D4 AD 8B 1B     LDA.W $1B8B                     ; \
$04:F5D7 29 18        AND.B #$18                      ; / Timer & $18
$04:F5D9 F0 25        BEQ $F600                       ; Zero: cursor off this half of the cycle
$04:F5DB AD 8A 1B     LDA.W $1B8A                     ; \
$04:F5DE 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = [$1B8A] * 2: selected player
$04:F5DF A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:F5E0 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:F5E2 B9 03 F5     LDA.W $F503,Y                   ; A = cursor tiles for this player
$04:F5E5 9F B1 83 7F  STA.L $7F83B1,X                 ; Write into the stripe (left arrow top)
$04:F5E9 B9 07 F5     LDA.W $F507,Y                   ; A = next tiles
$04:F5EC 9F B3 83 7F  STA.L $7F83B3,X                 ; Write into the stripe
$04:F5F0 B9 0B F5     LDA.W $F50B,Y                   ; A = next tiles
$04:F5F3 9F B9 83 7F  STA.L $7F83B9,X                 ; Write into the stripe
$04:F5F7 B9 0F F5     LDA.W $F50F,Y                   ; A = next tiles
$04:F5FA 9F BB 83 7F  STA.L $7F83BB,X                 ; Write into the stripe
$04:F5FE E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:F600 AD B4 0D     LDA.W RAM_PlayerLives           ; A = Mario lives
$04:F603 20 0E F6     JSR.W $F60E                     ; Write Mario lives digits
$04:F606 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:F607 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F608 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; } X += $0A: Luigi lives digits record
$04:F60A AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:F60B AD B5 0D     LDA.W $0DB5                     ; A = Luigi lives
$04:F60E 1A           INC A                           ; A = lives + 1 (displayed value)
$04:F60F DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$04:F610 22 4C 97 00  JSL.L $974C                     ; Convert to decimal (HexToDec): X = tens, A = ones
$04:F614 9B           TXY                             ; Y = tens
$04:F615 D0 02        BNE $F619                       ; Tens non-zero: keep it
$04:F617 A2 FC        LDX #$FC                        ; Tens = $FC (blank)

$04:F619 9B           TXY                             ; Y = tens tile
$04:F61A FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$04:F61B 9F A1 83 7F  STA.L $7F83A1,X                 ; Write ones digit
$04:F61F 98           TYA                             ; A = tens tile
$04:F620 9F 9F 83 7F  STA.L $7F839F,X                 ; Write tens digit
$04:F624 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F675: Initialise overworld sprites ;;;
{
;; Called when loading the title screen. Fills 13 overworld sprite slots from the table at $04F616 and runs
;;     the main routine for slots $0D-$0F to warm them up.
;; Interpretation is partial.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9AA4: Detect connected controllers into [$0DA0] (SetUp0DA0GM4)
$04:F675 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$04:F676 4B           PHK                             ; Data bank = program bank ($04)
$04:F677 AB           PLB 
$04:F678 A2 0C        LDX.B #$0C                      ; X = $0C: 13 overworld sprite slots
$04:F67A A0 4B        LDY.B #$4B                      ; Y = $4B: offset of the last 5-byte entry
$04:F67C B9 16 F6     LDA.W ADDR_04F616,Y             ; A = entry byte 0: sprite type
$04:F67F 9D E8 0D     STA.W $0DE8,X                   ; Sprite type [$0DE8+X]
$04:F682 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Type 1?
$04:F684 F0 04        BEQ $F68A                       ; Yes: set timer
$04:F686 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Type 2?
$04:F688 D0 05        BNE $F68F                       ; Neither: skip
$04:F68A A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; A = $40
$04:F68C 9D 58 0E     STA.W $0E58,X                   ; Sprite timer [$0E58+X] = $40
$04:F68F B9 17 F6     LDA.W Instr04F617,Y             ; \
$04:F692 9D 38 0E     STA.W $0E38,X                   ; / Entry byte 1: [$0E38+X] (X position low)
$04:F695 B9 18 F6     LDA.W ADDR_04F618,Y             ; \
$04:F698 9D 68 0E     STA.W $0E68,X                   ; / Entry byte 2: [$0E68+X]
$04:F69B B9 19 F6     LDA.W $F619,Y                   ; \
$04:F69E 9D 48 0E     STA.W $0E48,X                   ; / Entry byte 3: [$0E48+X] (Y position low)
$04:F6A1 B9 1A F6     LDA.W $F61A,Y                   ; \
$04:F6A4 9D 78 0E     STA.W $0E78,X                   ; / Entry byte 4: [$0E78+X]
$04:F6A7 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:F6A8 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:F6A9 E9 05        SBC.B #$05                      ; } Y -= 5: previous entry
$04:F6AB A8           TAY                             ; /
$04:F6AC CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$04:F6AD 10 CD        BPL $F67C                       ; Loop for 13 slots
$04:F6AF A2 0D        LDX.B #$0D                      ; X = $0D: first of the extra slots
$04:F6B1 9E 25 0E     STZ.W $0E25,X                   ; Clear [$0E25+X]
$04:F6B4 AD 22 FD     LDA.W $FD22                     ; \
$04:F6B7 3A           DEC A                           ; } [$0EB5+X] = $FD22 - 1
$04:F6B8 9D B5 0E     STA.W $0EB5,X                   ; /
$04:F6BB BD 65 F6     LDA.W $F665,X                   ; A = $F665[X]: number of updates
$04:F6BE 48           PHA                             ; Save the count
$04:F6BF 8E DE 0D     STX.W $0DDE                     ; Current slot [$0DDE] = X
$04:F6C2 20 53 F8     JSR.W $F853                     ; Run the sprite main routine once ($F853)
$04:F6C5 68           PLA                             ; Restore the count
$04:F6C6 3A           DEC A                           ; Count--
$04:F6C7 D0 F5        BNE $F6BE                       ; Loop until the sprite has been advanced
$04:F6C9 E8           INX                             ; Next slot
$04:F6CA E0 10        CPX.B #$10                      ; Compare with $10
$04:F6CC 90 E3        BCC $F6B1                       ; Loop for slots $0D-$0F
$04:F6CE AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$04:F6CF 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $F708: Process all overworld sprites ;;;
{
;; Per-frame overworld sprite handler. 1) Valley of Bowser only (hide mask $F7 = submap 4): thunder flash.
;;     [$1FFC] counts down to a random
;; flash, [$1FFB] = flash steps; each step copies a color from the palette mirror ([$0753+2*step]) into CGRAM
;;     color $47 via the special palette buffer at [$0681].
;; 2) Keeps cloud sprites (type 5) alive in slots 0-2, spawning them just outside the screen edges at a random
;;     height.
;; 3) Sorts the slot order list [$0DE0]-[$0DE4] by Y position (slots 0-4), sets [$0DDF] = $30 and [$0EF7] = 0,
;;     then runs every slot from 15 to 0.
;; Overworld sprite arrays (index = slot 0-15): [$0DE5] type, [$0DF5]/[$0E05]/[$0E15] state and flags, [$0E25]
;;     timer, [$0E35]/[$0E65] X, [$0E45]/[$0E75] Y,
;; [$0E55] height (Z), [$0E95]/[$0EA5]/[$0EB5] X/Y/Z speed. [$0DDE] = slot being run, [$0DDF] = next free OAM
;;     offset, [$0EF7] = slot touching Mario.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:840D: Game mode 0E: overworld (GameMode_0E_Prim)
$04:F708 A9 F7        LDA.B #$F7                      ; \
$04:F70A 20 82 F8     JSR.W $F882                     ; |
$04:F70D D0 5F        BNE $F76E                       ; / Hide mask $F7: lightning runs only on submap 4 (Valley of Bowser); else go to clouds
$04:F70F AC FB 1F     LDY.W $1FFB                     ; \
$04:F712 D0 27        BNE $F73B                       ; / [$1FFB] = flash steps left; non-zero: a flash is running, go to $04F73B
$04:F714 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:F716 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:F717 90 55        BCC $F76E                       ; / Idle: only count down on odd frames, else go to clouds
$04:F719 CE FC 1F     DEC.W $1FFC                     ; \
$04:F71C D0 50        BNE $F76E                       ; / [$1FFC]-- (delay to next flash); not zero yet: go to clouds
$04:F71E A8           TAY                             ; Y = [$13] / 2: frame counter used as a pseudo-random index
$04:F71F B9 08 F7     LDA.W $F708,Y                   ; \
$04:F722 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$04:F724 AA           TAX                             ; / X = random 0-7: low 3 bits of a byte of this routine's own code at $04F708+Y
$04:F725 BD F8 F6     LDA.W $F6F8,X                   ; \
$04:F728 8D FC 1F     STA.W $1FFC                     ; / [$1FFC] = $F6F8[X]: delay until the next flash
$04:F72B BC 00 F7     LDY.W $F700,X                   ; \
$04:F72E 8C FB 1F     STY.W $1FFB                     ; / [$1FFB] = $F700[X]: number of flash steps
$04:F731 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$04:F733 8D FD 1F     STA.W $1FFD                     ; / [$1FFD] = 8: frames for the first step
$04:F736 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$04:F738 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $18 ([$1DFC]), probably thunder
$04:F73B CE FD 1F     DEC.W $1FFD                     ; \
$04:F73E 10 08        BPL $F748                       ; / [$1FFD]--; still >= 0: keep the current step
$04:F740 CE FB 1F     DEC.W $1FFB                     ; [$1FFB]--: next flash step
$04:F743 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:F745 8D FD 1F     STA.W $1FFD                     ; / [$1FFD] = 4: frames per later step
$04:F748 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:F749 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:F74A A8           TAY                             ; / Y = flash step * 2: word offset into the palette mirror
$04:F74B AE 81 06     LDX.W $0681                     ; X = [$0681]: write index of the special palette upload buffer
$04:F74E A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:F750 9D 82 06     STA.W $0682,X                   ; / Record byte count = 2 (one color)
$04:F753 A9 47        LDA.B #$47                      ; \
$04:F755 9D 83 06     STA.W $0683,X                   ; / CGRAM color index = $47
$04:F758 B9 53 07     LDA.W $0753,Y                   ; \
$04:F75B 9D 84 06     STA.W $0684,X                   ; / Color low byte = [$0753+Y]
$04:F75E B9 54 07     LDA.W $0754,Y                   ; \
$04:F761 9D 85 06     STA.W $0685,X                   ; / Color high byte = [$0754+Y]
$04:F764 9E 86 06     STZ.W $0686,X                   ; End of the record list
$04:F767 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:F768 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F769 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$04:F76B 8D 81 06     STA.W $0681                     ; / [$0681] += 4: advance the buffer index
$04:F76E A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: check the three cloud slots 2, 1, 0
$04:F770 BD E5 0D     LDA.W $0DE5,X                   ; \
$04:F773 D0 36        BNE $F7AB                       ; / Slot in use ([$0DE5+X] != 0): skip to the next slot
$04:F775 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$04:F777 9D E5 0D     STA.W $0DE5,X                   ; / Spawn sprite type 5 (cloud) in this slot
$04:F77A 20 5B FE     JSR.W $FE5B                     ; \
$04:F77D 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$04:F77F A8           TAY                             ; / Y = random 0-7 (frame counter + per-slot offset)
$04:F780 B9 D0 F6     LDA.W $F6D0,Y                   ; \
$04:F783 9D 55 0E     STA.W $0E55,X                   ; / Cloud height [$0E55+X] = $F6D0[Y]
$04:F786 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:F787 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:F788 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = Y * 2: word index
$04:F789 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:F78B A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$04:F78D 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F78E 79 D8 F6     ADC.W $F6D8,Y                   ; |
$04:F791 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / A = screen left edge [$1A] + $F6D8[Y] (X offset, signed word)
$04:F793 9D 35 0E     STA.W $0E35,X                   ; \
$04:F796 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:F797 9D 65 0E     STA.W $0E65,X                   ; / Cloud X position low/high = A
$04:F79A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:F79C A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$04:F79E 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F79F 79 E8 F6     ADC.W $F6E8,Y                   ; |
$04:F7A2 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / A = screen top edge [$1C] + $F6E8[Y] (Y offset)
$04:F7A4 9D 45 0E     STA.W $0E45,X                   ; \
$04:F7A7 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:F7A8 9D 75 0E     STA.W $0E75,X                   ; / Cloud Y position low/high = A
$04:F7AB CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:F7AC 10 C2        BPL $F770                       ; / Next cloud slot
$04:F7AE A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4
$04:F7B0 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:F7B1 9D E0 0D     STA.W $0DE0,X                   ; |
$04:F7B4 CA           DEX                             ; |
$04:F7B5 10 F9        BPL $F7B0                       ; / [$0DE0+X] = X: start with slots 0-4 in identity order
$04:F7B7 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: sort the list [$0DE0]-[$0DE4] by sprite Y position
$04:F7B9 86 00        STX $00                         ; [$00] = X: outer loop counter
$04:F7BB 86 01        STX $01                         ; [$01] = X: inner loop counter
$04:F7BD A6 00        LDX $00                         ; \
$04:F7BF BC E0 0D     LDY.W $0DE0,X                   ; / Y = slot at list position [$00]
$04:F7C2 B9 45 0E     LDA.W $0E45,Y                   ; \
$04:F7C5 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$04:F7C7 B9 75 0E     LDA.W $0E75,Y                   ; |
$04:F7CA 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$02] = Y position of that slot (low, high)
$04:F7CC A6 01        LDX $01                         ; \
$04:F7CE BC DF 0D     LDY.W $0DDF,X                   ; / Y = slot at list position [$01] - 1
$04:F7D1 B9 75 0E     LDA.W $0E75,Y                   ; \
$04:F7D4 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:F7D5 B9 45 0E     LDA.W $0E45,Y                   ; / A = Y position of that slot (16-bit)
$04:F7D8 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:F7DA C5 02        CMP $02                         ; |
$04:F7DC E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; |
$04:F7DE 10 0D        BPL $F7ED                       ; / Compare with [$02]; A >= [$02] (signed): keep the order
$04:F7E0 5A           PHY                             ; \
$04:F7E1 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; |
$04:F7E3 B9 E0 0D     LDA.W $0DE0,Y                   ; |
$04:F7E6 9D DF 0D     STA.W $0DDF,X                   ; |
$04:F7E9 68           PLA                             ; |
$04:F7EA 99 E0 0D     STA.W $0DE0,Y                   ; / Swap the list entries at positions [$01] - 1 and [$00]
$04:F7ED CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:F7EE D0 CB        BNE $F7BB                       ; / Inner loop: X--, repeat until X = 0
$04:F7F0 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; \
$04:F7F2 CA           DEX                             ; |
$04:F7F3 D0 C4        BNE $F7B9                       ; / Outer loop: [$00]--, repeat until 0
$04:F7F5 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$04:F7F7 8D DF 0D     STA.W $0DDF                     ; / [$0DDF] = $30: first free OAM offset (from $0240) for dynamically placed tiles
$04:F7FA 9C F7 0E     STZ.W $0EF7                     ; [$0EF7] = 0: no sprite touching Mario yet
$04:F7FD A2 0F        LDX.B #$0F                      ; X = $0F: loop over the 16 slots from 15 down to 0
$04:F7FF A0 2D        LDY.B #$2D                      ; Y = $2D (not used afterwards)
$04:F801 E0 0D        CPX.B #$0D                      ; \
$04:F803 B0 08        BCS $F80D                       ; / Slots 13-15 have no timer: skip
$04:F805 BD 25 0E     LDA.W $0E25,X                   ; \
$04:F808 F0 03        BEQ $F80D                       ; |
$04:F80A DE 25 0E     DEC.W $0E25,X                   ; / If the timer [$0E25+X] is non-zero, decrement it
$04:F80D E0 05        CPX.B #$05                      ; \
$04:F80F 90 08        BCC $F819                       ; / Slots 0-4 go through the sorted list, 5-15 are used directly
$04:F811 8E DE 0D     STX.W $0DDE                     ; [$0DDE] = X: current sprite slot
$04:F814 20 53 F8     JSR.W $F853                     ; Run this sprite ($F853)
$04:F817 80 0C        BRA $F825                       ; Go to the next slot

$04:F819 DA           PHX                             ; Save the slot counter
$04:F81A BD E0 0D     LDA.W $0DE0,X                   ; \
$04:F81D AA           TAX                             ; / X = [$0DE0+X]: slot in sorted order
$04:F81E 8E DE 0D     STX.W $0DDE                     ; [$0DDE] = X: current sprite slot
$04:F821 20 53 F8     JSR.W $F853                     ; Run this sprite ($F853)
$04:F824 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the slot counter
$04:F825 CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:F826 10 D9        BPL $F801                       ; / X--, loop until X < 0
$04:F828 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F829..F831: Table: sprite type hide masks ;;;
{
;; Indexed by sprite type 1-10. A set bit hides the type on that submap; bit order is $F875 ($80 =
;;     submap 0).
$04:F829              .db $7F,$21,$7F,$7F,$7F,$77,$3F,$F7 ; Hide masks for sprite types 1-8 (bit set = hidden on that submap, see $F875)
$04:F831              .db $F7,$00                     ; Hide masks for sprite types 9 and 10

}

;;; $F833..F83B: Table: per-slot random offsets ;;;
{
;; Added to the frame counter [$13] by $FE5B to get a different pseudo-random value per slot.
$04:F833              .db $00,$52,$31,$19,$45,$2A,$03,$8B ; Per-slot offsets added to [$13] for pseudo-random values, slots 0-7
$04:F83B              .db $94,$3C,$78,$0D,$36,$5E,$87,$1F ; Per-slot offsets, slots 8-15
}

;;; $F843..F84B: Table: OAM offsets per sprite slot ;;;
{
;; OAM offset (from $0240) used by $FB06 for sprites that own an OAM entry. Slots 0-4 share $F4.
$04:F843              .db $F4,$F4,$F4,$F4,$F4,$9C,$3C,$48 ; OAM offsets (from $0240) for slots 0-7; slots 0-4 all share $F4
$04:F84B              .db $C8,$CC,$A0,$A4,$D8,$DC,$E0,$E4 ; OAM offsets (from $0240) for slots 8-15

}

;;; $F853: Run one overworld sprite ;;;
{
;; Parameters: X: slot, also [$0DDE]. Skips the sprite when it is hidden on the current submap, else jumps to
;;     the routine for its type.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:F6C2: Initialise overworld sprites
;;     $04:F814: Process all overworld sprites
;;     $04:F821: Process all overworld sprites
$04:F853 20 7C F8     JSR.W $F87C                     ; \
$04:F856 D0 D0        BNE $F828                       ; / Return if this sprite type is hidden on the current submap
$04:F858 BD E5 0D     LDA.W $0DE5,X                   ; \
$04:F85B 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run the routine for sprite type [$0DE5+X] (pointer table below)

}

;;; $F85F: Overworld sprite pointers, submap check (OWSprites?) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table of the 11 sprite type routines (type 0 = empty), then $F875 (submap bit masks) and the
;;     visibility check.
;; $F87C: A = hide mask for the slot's type. Entry $04F882 takes A as the mask directly.
;; Returns: Z set = sprite is shown on the current submap; Z clear = hidden. While [$13D9] = $0A the sprites
;;     are hidden unless [$1DE8] = 1.
$04:F85F 28 F8        .dw $F828                       ; Type 0: empty slot (RTS)
$04:F861 CC F8        .dw $F8CC                       ; Type 1: hovering creature with shadow
$04:F863 B8 F9        .dw $F9B8                       ; Type 2: chases Mario's X position
$04:F865 3E FA        .dw $FA3E                       ; Type 3: leaping sprite with splash (probably a fish)
$04:F867 F1 FA        .dw $FAF1                       ; Type 4: piranha plant
$04:F869 37 FB        .dw $FB37                       ; Type 5: cloud
$04:F86B 98 FB        .dw $FB98                       ; Type 6: walks in when Mario stands on tiles $49-$4B
$04:F86D 46 FC        .dw $FC46                       ; Type 7: smoke puffs
$04:F86F E1 FC        .dw $FCE1                       ; Type 8: Bowser's sign
$04:F871 24 FD        .dw $FD24                       ; Type 9: bouncing-speed sprite, tile $68 (code in the next chunk)
$04:F873 70 FD        .dw $FD70                       ; Type 10: sprite with tile $60 (code in the next chunk)

$04:F875              .db $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02 ; Submap 0-6 -> bit mask $80, $40, $20, $10, $08, $04, $02

$04:F87C BC E5 0D     LDY.W $0DE5,X                   ; \
$04:F87F B9 28 F8     LDA.W $F828,Y                   ; / A = hide mask for this sprite type: byte at $04F828 + type ($F829)
$04:F882 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = hide mask (the lightning code enters here with its own mask)
$04:F884 AC D9 13     LDY.W $13D9                     ; \
$04:F887 C0 0A        CPY.B #$0A                      ; |
$04:F889 D0 07        BNE $F892                       ; / [$13D9] = $0A (an overworld process, purpose unclear)? No: normal check at $04F892
$04:F88B AC E8 1D     LDY.W $1DE8                     ; \
$04:F88E C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; |
$04:F890 D0 11        BNE $F8A3                       ; / In that process sprites only show while [$1DE8] = 1, else hide (A = 1)
$04:F892 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:F895 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:F896 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:F897 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$0DD6] / 4: player index
$04:F898 B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; \
$04:F89B A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$1F11+Y]: submap the player is on
$04:F89C B9 75 F8     LDA.W $F875,Y                   ; \
$04:F89F 25 00        AND $00                         ; |
$04:F8A1 F0 02        BEQ $F8A5                       ; / A = $F875[submap] AND mask; zero: visible, return with Z set
$04:F8A3 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: hidden, return with Z clear
$04:F8A5 60           RTS                             ; Return: Z set = draw and run the sprite, Z clear = skip it


}

;;; $F8A6..F8CA: Table: sprite 1 movement parameters ;;;
{
;; Offsets, turn-around thresholds and speed steps/limits used by sprite 1 (and the steps/limits by sprite 2).
$04:F8A6              .db $01,$01,$03,$01,$01,$01,$01,$02 ; Sprite 1: X offsets between the four small tiles (index 0-7)
$04:F8AE              .db $0C,$0C,$12,$12,$12,$12,$0C,$0C ; Sprite 1: Y offsets of the small tiles below the body (index 0-7)
$04:F8B6              .db $10,$00,$08,$00,$20,$00,$20,$00 ; Sprite 1: X distance thresholds for turning around, words indexed by [$0DF5]
$04:F8BE              .db $10,$00,$30,$00,$08,$00,$10,$00 ; Sprite 1: Y distance thresholds, words indexed by [$0DF5]
$04:F8C6              .db $01,$FF                     ; Speed steps: +1, -1

$04:F8C8              .db $10,$F0                     ; Speed limits: +$10, -$10

$04:F8CA              .db $10,$F0                     ; Z speed limits: +$10, -$10 (bobbing turns around here)

}

;;; $F8CC: Overworld sprite 1: hovering creature ;;;
{
;; Moves by its speeds, draws a small shadow, four small 8x8 tiles ($28) hanging below a 16x16 body ($26).
;; Z speed bobs between +/-$10. It stays near Mario: when it is heading away on an axis and farther than a
;;     random threshold, that axis' direction
;; flag ([$0E05] bit 6 = X, bit 7 = Y) flips; X and Y speeds then accelerate toward the flagged direction up
;;     to +/-$10.
;; If [$0E15,X] is non-zero (set elsewhere) it jumps to the homing code at $FF2E. What this creature is
;;     in game terms is not clear.
$04:F8CC 20 90 FE     JSR.W $FE90                     ; Move the sprite: X, Y and Z position += speeds ($FE90)
$04:F8CF 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:F8D0 20 00 FE     JSR.W $FE00                     ; / Draw the small ground shadow (carry clear = 8x8 tiles)
$04:F8D3 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position: [$00] = X, [$02] = Y - height
$04:F8D6 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:F8D8 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; |
$04:F8DA 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$04:F8DC E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / [$04] = [$02]: base Y for the small tiles
$04:F8DE 20 5B FE     JSR.W $FE5B                     ; \
$04:F8E1 A2 06        LDX.B #$06                      ; |
$04:F8E3 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$04:F8E5 F0 01        BEQ $F8E8                       ; |
$04:F8E7 E8           INX                             ; / X = 6, or 7 if bit 4 of the random value is set (makes the tiles jitter)
$04:F8E8 86 06        STX $06                         ; [$06] = X: tile loop index
$04:F8EA A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:F8EC 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F8ED 7D A6 F8     ADC.W $F8A6,X                   ; |
$04:F8F0 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$04:F8F2 90 02        BCC $F8F6                       ; |
$04:F8F4 E6 01        INC $01                         ; / [$00]/[$01] += $F8A6[X] (16-bit, accumulates)
$04:F8F6 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$04:F8F8 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F8F9 7D AE F8     ADC.W $F8AE,X                   ; |
$04:F8FC 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$04:F8FE A5 05        LDA $05                         ; |
$04:F900 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$04:F902 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$02]/[$03] = [$04]/[$05] + $F8AE[X]
$04:F904 A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; \
$04:F906 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:F907 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; |
$04:F909 20 7B FB     JSR.W $FB7B                     ; / Draw 8x8 tile $28, properties $32, at the dynamic OAM slot
$04:F90C A6 06        LDX $06                         ; \
$04:F90E CA           DEX                             ; |
$04:F90F CA           DEX                             ; |
$04:F910 10 D6        BPL $F8E8                       ; / X = [$06] - 2; repeat until X < 0 (four tiles)
$04:F912 AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = [$0DDE]: current sprite slot
$04:F915 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position again: [$00], [$02]
$04:F918 A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; \
$04:F91A EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:F91B A9 26        LDA.B #$26                      ; |
$04:F91D 20 7A FB     JSR.W $FB7A                     ; / Draw 16x16 body tile $26, properties $32
$04:F920 BD 15 0E     LDA.W $0E15,X                   ; \
$04:F923 F0 03        BEQ $F928                       ; |
$04:F925 4C 2E FF     JMP.W $FF2E                     ; / [$0E15+X] != 0 (set elsewhere): fly toward Mario instead ($FF2E)

$04:F928 BD 05 0E     LDA.W $0E05,X                   ; \
$04:F92B 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$04:F92D A8           TAY                             ; / Y = bit 0 of [$0E05+X]: Z speed direction (0 = up)
$04:F92E BD B5 0E     LDA.W $0EB5,X                   ; \
$04:F931 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F932 79 C6 F8     ADC.W $F8C6,Y                   ; |
$04:F935 9D B5 0E     STA.W $0EB5,X                   ; / Z speed [$0EB5+X] += $F8C6[Y] (+1 or -1)
$04:F938 D9 CA F8     CMP.W $F8CA,Y                   ; \
$04:F93B D0 08        BNE $F945                       ; / Reached the Z speed limit?
$04:F93D BD 05 0E     LDA.W $0E05,X                   ; \
$04:F940 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$04:F942 9D 05 0E     STA.W $0E05,X                   ; / Yes: flip the direction bit [$0E05+X] bit 0
$04:F945 20 EF FE     JSR.W $FEEF                     ; Distance to Mario: [$00], [$02] = signed dx, dy; [$06], [$08] = |dx|, |dy|
$04:F948 BC F5 0D     LDY.W $0DF5,X                   ; Y = [$0DF5+X]: random threshold index (even)
$04:F94B BD 04 0E     LDA.W $0E04,X                   ; \
$04:F94E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:F94F 45 00        EOR $00                         ; |
$04:F951 10 0A        BPL $F95D                       ; / Word at [$0E04+X]: bit 14 = X direction flag; EOR sign of dx. Same sign: go to Y check
$04:F953 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; \
$04:F955 D9 B6 F8     CMP.W $F8B6,Y                   ; |
$04:F958 A9 40 00     LDA.W #$0040                    ; |
$04:F95B B0 10        BCS $F96D                       ; / Heading away and |dx| >= $F8B6[Y]: A = $0040 (flag to flip), go to $04F96D
$04:F95D BD 04 0E     LDA.W $0E04,X                   ; \
$04:F960 45 02        EOR $02                         ; |
$04:F962 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:F963 90 08        BCC $F96D                       ; / Y axis: [$0E05+X] bit 7 vs sign of dy; same: nothing to flip
$04:F965 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$04:F967 D9 BE F8     CMP.W $F8BE,Y                   ; |
$04:F96A A9 80 00     LDA.W #$0080                    ; / |dy| >= $F8BE[Y]? A = $0080 (flag to flip)
$04:F96D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit; carry set = a direction flag must flip
$04:F96F 90 0E        BCC $F97F                       ; No flip: go to the speed update
$04:F971 5D 05 0E     EOR.W $0E05,X                   ; \
$04:F974 9D 05 0E     STA.W $0E05,X                   ; / [$0E05+X] ^= A: reverse that axis' direction flag
$04:F977 20 5B FE     JSR.W $FE5B                     ; \
$04:F97A 29 06        AND.B #$06                      ; |
$04:F97C 9D F5 0D     STA.W $0DF5,X                   ; / [$0DF5+X] = random AND 6: new threshold index
$04:F97F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:F980 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F981 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$04:F983 AA           TAX                             ; / X += $10: index of the Y speed array ([$0EA5]) and of [$0DF5+$10] = [$0E05]
$04:F984 BD F5 0D     LDA.W $0DF5,X                   ; \
$04:F987 0A           ASL                             ; / Y direction flag (bit 7 of [$0E05]) -> carry
$04:F988 20 93 F9     JSR.W $F993                     ; Accelerate the Y speed ($F993)
$04:F98B AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = [$0DDE]: current sprite slot
$04:F98E BD 05 0E     LDA.W $0E05,X                   ; \
$04:F991 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:F992 0A           ASL                             ; / X direction flag (bit 6 of [$0E05]) -> carry; falls into the speed update
$04:F993 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$04:F995 B0 01        BCS $F998                       ; |
$04:F997 C8           INY                             ; / Y = 0 (step +1) if carry set, else 1 (step -1)
$04:F998 BD 95 0E     LDA.W $0E95,X                   ; \
$04:F99B 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F99C 79 C6 F8     ADC.W $F8C6,Y                   ; |
$04:F99F D9 C8 F8     CMP.W $F8C8,Y                   ; |
$04:F9A2 F0 03        BEQ $F9A7                       ; |
$04:F9A4 9D 95 0E     STA.W $0E95,X                   ; / Speed [$0E95+X] += step, unless it is at the limit ($F8C8)
$04:F9A7 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F9A8..F9B4: Table: sprite 2 small tile animation ;;;
{
;; Tile number and X/Y offsets of sprite 2's small part, 4 animation frames.
$04:F9A8              .db $4E,$4F,$5E,$4F             ; Sprite 2: tile numbers of the small part, 4 frames

;;; $F9B8: Overworld sprite 2: chases Mario's X ;;;
{
;; Accelerates toward Mario's X position (limit +/-$10), copies Mario's Y position, draws a small shadow, a
;;     16x16 body ($4C, X flipped by direction)
;; and a small 8x8 part that jitters randomly between 4 frames.
$04:F9B8 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:F9B9 20 00 FE     JSR.W $FE00                     ; / Draw the small ground shadow
$04:F9BC 20 EF FE     JSR.W $FEEF                     ; Distance to Mario: [$00] = dx, [$06] = |dx| (16-bit)
$04:F9BF E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:F9C1 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$04:F9C3 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; |
$04:F9C5 30 01        BMI $F9C8                       ; |
$04:F9C7 C8           INY                             ; / Y = 0 if the sprite is left of Mario (dx < 0), else 1
$04:F9C8 BD 95 0E     LDA.W $0E95,X                   ; \
$04:F9CB 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:F9CC 79 C6 F8     ADC.W $F8C6,Y                   ; |
$04:F9CF D9 C8 F8     CMP.W $F8C8,Y                   ; |
$04:F9D2 F0 03        BEQ $F9D7                       ; |
$04:F9D4 9D 95 0E     STA.W $0E95,X                   ; / X speed += $F8C6[Y] (accelerate toward Mario), limited to +/-$10
$04:F9D7 AC D6 0D     LDY.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:F9DA B9 19 1F     LDA.W $1F19,Y                   ; |
$04:F9DD 9D 45 0E     STA.W $0E45,X                   ; / Sprite Y position low = Mario's Y position low ([$1F19+player*4])
$04:F9E0 B9 1A 1F     LDA.W $1F1A,Y                   ; \
$04:F9E3 9D 75 0E     STA.W $0E75,X                   ; / Sprite Y position high = Mario's Y position high
$04:F9E6 20 90 FE     JSR.W $FE90                     ; Move the sprite
$04:F9E9 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position
$04:F9EC A9 36        LDA.B #$36                      ; \
$04:F9EE BC 95 0E     LDY.W $0E95,X                   ; |
$04:F9F1 30 02        BMI $F9F5                       ; |
$04:F9F3 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; / Properties $36, X flipped ($40) when moving right
$04:F9F5 48           PHA                             ; \
$04:F9F6 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:F9F7 A9 4C        LDA.B #$4C                      ; |
$04:F9F9 20 7A FB     JSR.W $FB7A                     ; / Save the properties, draw 16x16 body tile $4C at the dynamic OAM slot
$04:F9FC 68           PLA                             ; \
$04:F9FD EB           XBA                             ; / Restore the properties into B
$04:F9FE 20 5B FE     JSR.W $FE5B                     ; \
$04:FA01 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FA02 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FA03 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FA04 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$04:FA06 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = random 0-3: animation frame of the small part
$04:FA07 B9 AC F9     LDA.W $F9AC,Y                   ; \
$04:FA0A 3C 95 0E     BIT.W $0E95,X                   ; |
$04:FA0D 30 03        BMI $FA12                       ; |
$04:FA0F B9 B0 F9     LDA.W $F9B0,Y                   ; / A = X offset: $F9AC[Y] moving left, $F9B0[Y] moving right
$04:FA12 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:FA13 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$04:FA15 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$04:FA17 90 02        BCC $FA1B                       ; |
$04:FA19 E6 01        INC $01                         ; / [$00] += A (16-bit)
$04:FA1B B9 B4 F9     LDA.W $F9B4,Y                   ; \
$04:FA1E 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FA1F 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$04:FA21 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$04:FA23 90 02        BCC $FA27                       ; |
$04:FA25 E6 03        INC $03                         ; / [$02] += $F9B4[Y] (16-bit)
$04:FA27 B9 A8 F9     LDA.W $F9A8,Y                   ; \
$04:FA2A 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FA2B 4C 7B FB     JMP.W $FB7B                     ; / Draw 8x8 tile $F9A8[Y] at the dynamic OAM slot and return


}
