;;; $FA3E: Overworld sprites 3-5 and OAM tile draw ;;;
{
;; Sprite 3 ($FA3E): idle until Mario stands on tile $4E-$50 ([$13C1]), then appears at one of three
;;     fixed spots, launched upward (Z speed $24) with sound $0E.
;; Z speed drops by 1 per frame; falling flips the sprite. A 2-tile splash is shown for $0F frames at launch
;;     and again at Z speed $E4 (landing). Probably a jumping fish.
;; Sprite 4 ($FAF1): stationary piranha plant, 16x16 tile $2A/$2C swapped every 8 frames, reports
;;     touching Mario.
;; $FB06/04FB0A: draws one OAM tile. A = tile, B = properties, Y = OAM offset from $0240, [$00]/[$02] =
;;     screen X/Y (16-bit), carry set = 16x16.
;; Skips off-screen positions; returns Y - 4. $FB7A/7B draw at the dynamic offset [$0DDF] and advance
;;     it.
;; Sprite 5 ($FB37): cloud, speed (2, -1), two 16x16 tiles ($44, right one X flipped); freed when it
;;     leaves the screen.
$04:FA3E BD F5 0D     LDA.W $0DF5,X                   ; \
$04:FA41 D0 40        BNE $FA83                       ; / State [$0DF5+X] != 0: active, go to $04FA83
$04:FA43 AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; \
$04:FA46 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:FA47 E9 4E        SBC.B #$4E                      ; |
$04:FA49 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$04:FA4B B0 35        BCS $FA82                       ; / Idle: start only when Mario stands on overworld tile $4E-$50 ([$13C1])
$04:FA4D A8           TAY                             ; Y = tile - $4E (0-2)
$04:FA4E B9 2E FA     LDA.W $FA2E,Y                   ; \
$04:FA51 9D 35 0E     STA.W $0E35,X                   ; / X position low = $FA2E[Y]
$04:FA54 B9 31 FA     LDA.W $FA31,Y                   ; \
$04:FA57 9D 65 0E     STA.W $0E65,X                   ; / X position high
$04:FA5A B9 34 FA     LDA.W $FA34,Y                   ; \
$04:FA5D 9D 45 0E     STA.W $0E45,X                   ; / Y position low
$04:FA60 B9 37 FA     LDA.W $FA37,Y                   ; \
$04:FA63 9D 75 0E     STA.W $0E75,X                   ; / Y position high
$04:FA66 20 5B FE     JSR.W $FE5B                     ; \
$04:FA69 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FA6A 6A           ROR                             ; |
$04:FA6B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FA6C 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; |
$04:FA6E 09 12        ORA.B #$12                      ; |
$04:FA70 9D F5 0D     STA.W $0DF5,X                   ; / [$0DF5+X] = $12, plus X flip ($40) at random: active flag and properties
$04:FA73 A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; \
$04:FA75 9D B5 0E     STA.W $0EB5,X                   ; / Z speed [$0EB5+X] = $24 (launched upward)
$04:FA78 A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; \
$04:FA7A 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $0E ([$1DF9])
$04:FA7D A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$04:FA7F 9D 25 0E     STA.W $0E25,X                   ; / Splash timer [$0E25+X] = $0F (also called when the sprite lands)
$04:FA82 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FA83 DE B5 0E     DEC.W $0EB5,X                   ; \
$04:FA86 BD B5 0E     LDA.W $0EB5,X                   ; |
$04:FA89 C9 E4        CMP.B #$E4                      ; |
$04:FA8B D0 03        BNE $FA90                       ; / Z speed-- (gravity); not $E4 yet: go on
$04:FA8D 20 7D FA     JSR.W $FA7D                     ; Z speed hit $E4 (landing): start the landing splash
$04:FA90 20 90 FE     JSR.W $FE90                     ; Move the sprite
$04:FA93 BD 55 0E     LDA.W $0E55,X                   ; \
$04:FA96 1D 25 0E     ORA.W $0E25,X                   ; |
$04:FA99 D0 03        BNE $FA9E                       ; |
$04:FA9B 9E F5 0D     STZ.W $0DF5,X                   ; / Height and splash timer both 0: deactivate ([$0DF5+X] = 0)
$04:FA9E 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position
$04:FAA1 BD F5 0D     LDA.W $0DF5,X                   ; A = state/properties [$0DF5+X]
$04:FAA4 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; Y = 8: animation frame mask
$04:FAA6 3C B5 0E     BIT.W $0EB5,X                   ; \
$04:FAA9 10 04        BPL $FAAF                       ; |
$04:FAAB 49 C0        EOR.B #$C0                      ; |
$04:FAAD A0 10        LDY.B #$10                      ; / Falling (Z speed negative): flip both axes and Y = $10
$04:FAAF EB           XBA                             ; \
$04:FAB0 98           TYA                             ; |
$04:FAB1 A0 4A        LDY.B #$4A                      ; |
$04:FAB3 25 13        AND RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$04:FAB5 F0 02        BEQ $FAB9                       ; |
$04:FAB7 A0 48        LDY.B #$48                      ; |
$04:FAB9 98           TYA                             ; / B = properties; tile $4A, or $48 when [$13] AND mask is set (flap animation)
$04:FABA 20 06 FB     JSR.W $FB06                     ; Draw 16x16 tile at this slot's own OAM entry
$04:FABD 20 4E FE     JSR.W $FE4E                     ; \
$04:FAC0 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:FAC1 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$04:FAC3 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$04:FAC5 B0 02        BCS $FAC9                       ; |
$04:FAC7 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; / [$02]/[$03] = ground Y - 8: splash position
$04:FAC9 A9 36        LDA.B #$36                      ; \
$04:FACB EB           XBA                             ; / B = properties $36 for the splash
$04:FACC BD 25 0E     LDA.W $0E25,X                   ; \
$04:FACF F0 B1        BEQ $FA82                       ; / Splash timer = 0: nothing more to draw
$04:FAD1 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:FAD2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FAD3 5A           PHY                             ; |
$04:FAD4 A8           TAY                             ; |
$04:FAD5 B9 3A FA     LDA.W $FA3A,Y                   ; |
$04:FAD8 7A           PLY                             ; / A = $FA3A[timer / 4], splash tile (Y preserved)
$04:FAD9 48           PHA                             ; \
$04:FADA 20 ED FA     JSR.W $FAED                     ; / Save the tile, draw the left half (8x8) at the next OAM slot
$04:FADD C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:FADF A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$04:FAE1 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FAE2 69 08 00     ADC.W #$0008                    ; |
$04:FAE5 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$04:FAE7 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / [$00] += 8: position of the right half
$04:FAE9 A9 76        LDA.B #$76                      ; \
$04:FAEB EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:FAEC 68           PLA                             ; / B = $76 (X-flipped splash), A = saved tile; falls into the draw
$04:FAED 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:FAEE 4C 0A FB     JMP.W $FB0A                     ; / Draw an 8x8 tile (carry clear) at OAM offset Y ($FB0A)

$04:FAF1 20 D7 FE     JSR.W $FED7                     ; Mario touching the sprite? Sets [$0EF7] = slot ($FED7)
$04:FAF4 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position (without this the sprite would not appear)
$04:FAF7 20 5B FE     JSR.W $FE5B                     ; A = [$13] + per-slot offset: animation timer (without it the sprite stops animating)
$04:FAFA A0 2A        LDY.B #$2A                      ; \
$04:FAFC 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$04:FAFE F0 02        BEQ $FB02                       ; |
$04:FB00 A0 2C        LDY.B #$2C                      ; / Tile $2A, or $2C when bit 3 of A is set: 2-frame animation
$04:FB02 A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; \
$04:FB04 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:FB05 98           TYA                             ; / B = properties $32, A = tile; falls into the draw
$04:FB06 38           SEC                             ; \
$04:FB07 BC 43 F8     LDY.W $F843,X                   ; / Draw a 16x16 tile (carry set) at this slot's OAM offset $F843[X]
$04:FB0A 99 42 02     STA.W $0242,Y                   ; OAM tile low: tile number = A
$04:FB0D EB           XBA                             ; A = properties (from B)
$04:FB0E 99 43 02     STA.W $0243,Y                   ; OAM tile high: properties = A
$04:FB11 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$04:FB13 D0 21        BNE $FB36                       ; / X position high byte [$01] != 0: off screen, return
$04:FB15 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:FB17 99 40 02     STA.W $0240,Y                   ; / OAM X position = [$00]
$04:FB1A A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$04:FB1C D0 18        BNE $FB36                       ; / Y position high byte [$03] != 0: off screen, return
$04:FB1E 08           PHP                             ; Save carry (size flag)
$04:FB1F A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:FB21 99 41 02     STA.W $0241,Y                   ; / OAM Y position = [$02]
$04:FB24 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:FB25 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FB26 4A           LSR                             ; / A = OAM offset / 4
$04:FB27 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry
$04:FB28 5A           PHY                             ; Save the OAM offset
$04:FB29 A8           TAY                             ; Y = A: index into the OAM size table
$04:FB2A 2A           ROL                             ; \
$04:FB2B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:FB2C 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$04:FB2E 99 30 04     STA.W $0430,Y                   ; / [$0430+Y] = carry << 1: size bit (16x16 if carry was set), X bit 8 clear
$04:FB31 7A           PLY                             ; \
$04:FB32 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:FB33 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:FB34 88           DEY                             ; |
$04:FB35 88           DEY                             ; / Restore Y and subtract 4: next OAM slot (grows downward)
$04:FB36 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FB37 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:FB39 9D 95 0E     STA.W $0E95,X                   ; / X speed [$0E95+X] = 2 (drifts right)
$04:FB3C A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$04:FB3E 9D A5 0E     STA.W $0EA5,X                   ; / Y speed [$0EA5+X] = $FF (drifts up slowly)
$04:FB41 20 90 FE     JSR.W $FE90                     ; Move the sprite
$04:FB44 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position
$04:FB47 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:FB49 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$04:FB4B 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FB4C 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; |
$04:FB4F C9 40 01     CMP.W #$0140                    ; |
$04:FB52 B0 09        BCS $FB5D                       ; / Screen X + $20 >= $140: off screen horizontally, skip the Y test
$04:FB54 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$04:FB56 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FB57 69 80 00     ADC.W #$0080                    ; |
$04:FB5A C9 A0 01     CMP.W #$01A0                    ; / Screen Y + $80 >= $1A0: off screen vertically (carry)
$04:FB5D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:FB5F 90 03        BCC $FB64                       ; \
$04:FB61 9E E5 0D     STZ.W $0DE5,X                   ; / Off screen: free the slot ([$0DE5+X] = 0)
$04:FB64 A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; \
$04:FB66 20 77 FB     JSR.W $FB77                     ; / Left half: properties $32, tile $44
$04:FB69 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$04:FB6B A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$04:FB6D 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FB6E 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; |
$04:FB71 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$04:FB73 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / [$00] += $10: right half
$04:FB75 A9 72        LDA.B #$72                      ; A = $72: properties X-flipped for the right half
$04:FB77 EB           XBA                             ; B = properties
$04:FB78 A9 44        LDA.B #$44                      ; A = tile $44 (cloud, 16x16)
$04:FB7A 38           SEC                             ; Carry set: 16x16 tile
$04:FB7B AC DF 0D     LDY.W $0DDF                     ; Y = [$0DDF]: next free dynamic OAM offset
$04:FB7E 20 0A FB     JSR.W $FB0A                     ; Draw the tile
$04:FB81 8C DF 0D     STY.W $0DDF                     ; [$0DDF] = Y: move on to the next slot

;;; $FB98: Overworld sprite 6: walks in on tiles $49-$4B ;;;
{
;; Idle until Mario stands on tile $49-$4B ([$13C1]) and that instance's bit in [$0EF5] is clear. Spawns at
;;     one of three spots, state 2, walking left.
;; At each stop (X low nibble = $FB95[state]) the state drops, X speed becomes 4 and it waits $60
;;     frames. Drawn as 16x16 tile $6A, X flip toggling.
;; Touching Mario sets [$0EF7] = slot | $80. Purpose in game terms is not clear.
$04:FB98 BD F5 0D     LDA.W $0DF5,X                   ; \
$04:FB9B D0 3B        BNE $FBD8                       ; / State [$0DF5+X] != 0: active, go to $FBD8
$04:FB9D AD C1 13     LDA.W $13C1                     ; \
$04:FBA0 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:FBA1 E9 49        SBC.B #$49                      ; |
$04:FBA3 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$04:FBA5 B0 DD        BCS $FB84                       ; / Idle: start only when Mario stands on overworld tile $49-$4B ([$13C1])
$04:FBA7 A8           TAY                             ; Y = tile - $49 (0-2)
$04:FBA8 8D F6 0E     STA.W $0EF6                     ; [$0EF6] = which of the three (probably read by the touch handling)
$04:FBAB AD F5 0E     LDA.W $0EF5                     ; \
$04:FBAE 39 85 FB     AND.W $FB85,Y                   ; |
$04:FBB1 D0 D1        BNE $FB84                       ; / [$0EF5] bit $FB85[Y] already set: sprite used up, return
$04:FBB3 B9 88 FB     LDA.W $FB88,Y                   ; \
$04:FBB6 9D 35 0E     STA.W $0E35,X                   ; / X position low = $FB88[Y]
$04:FBB9 B9 8B FB     LDA.W $FB8B,Y                   ; \
$04:FBBC 9D 65 0E     STA.W $0E65,X                   ; / X position high
$04:FBBF B9 8E FB     LDA.W $FB8E,Y                   ; \
$04:FBC2 9D 45 0E     STA.W $0E45,X                   ; / Y position low
$04:FBC5 B9 91 FB     LDA.W $FB91,Y                   ; \
$04:FBC8 9D 75 0E     STA.W $0E75,X                   ; / Y position high
$04:FBCB A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$04:FBCD 9D F5 0D     STA.W $0DF5,X                   ; / State = 2
$04:FBD0 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$04:FBD2 9D 95 0E     STA.W $0E95,X                   ; / X speed = $F0 (walks left)
$04:FBD5 9E 25 0E     STZ.W $0E25,X                   ; Wait timer [$0E25+X] = 0
$04:FBD8 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position
$04:FBDB BD 25 0E     LDA.W $0E25,X                   ; \
$04:FBDE D0 20        BNE $FC00                       ; / Timer running: skip the movement, just draw
$04:FBE0 FE 05 0E     INC.W $0E05,X                   ; Animation counter [$0E05+X]++
$04:FBE3 20 AB FE     JSR.W $FEAB                     ; Move in X by the X speed ($FEAB)
$04:FBE6 BC F5 0D     LDY.W $0DF5,X                   ; Y = state
$04:FBE9 BD 35 0E     LDA.W $0E35,X                   ; \
$04:FBEC 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$04:FBEE D9 95 FB     CMP.W $FB95,Y                   ; |
$04:FBF1 D0 0D        BNE $FC00                       ; / X low nibble = $FB95[state]? If not, keep moving
$04:FBF3 DE F5 0D     DEC.W $0DF5,X                   ; State--: next phase
$04:FBF6 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:FBF8 9D 95 0E     STA.W $0E95,X                   ; / X speed = 4 (slow)
$04:FBFB A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$04:FBFD 9D 25 0E     STA.W $0E25,X                   ; / Wait timer [$0E25+X] = $60 frames
$04:FC00 B9 93 FB     LDA.W $FB93,Y                   ; \
$04:FC03 A0 22        LDY.B #$22                      ; |
$04:FC05 3D 05 0E     AND.W $0E05,X                   ; |
$04:FC08 D0 02        BNE $FC0C                       ; |
$04:FC0A A0 62        LDY.B #$62                      ; / Properties $22, or $62 (X flip) when the animation counter AND $FB93[state] is 0
$04:FC0C 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:FC0D EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:FC0E A9 6A        LDA.B #$6A                      ; |
$04:FC10 20 06 FB     JSR.W $FB06                     ; / B = properties, draw 16x16 tile $6A at this slot's OAM entry
$04:FC13 20 D7 FE     JSR.W $FED7                     ; Touching Mario? Sets [$0EF7] = slot; carry set = not touching
$04:FC16 B0 05        BCS $FC1D                       ; \
$04:FC18 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; |
$04:FC1A 8D F7 0E     STA.W $0EF7                     ; / Touching: [$0EF7] = slot OR $80 (marks it as hit)
$04:FC1D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$04:FC1E              .db $38                         ; Sprite 7: X positions, one word per submap ($0038, $0068)

$04:FC1F              .db $00,$68,$00

$04:FC22              .db $8A                         ; Sprite 7: Y positions, one word per submap ($018A, $006A)

$04:FC23              .db $01,$6A,$00

$04:FC26              .db $01,$02,$03,$04,$03,$02,$01,$00 ; Sprite 7: X wobble, steps 0-7
$04:FC2E              .db $01,$02,$03,$04,$03,$02,$01,$00 ; Sprite 7: X wobble, steps 8-15
}

;;; $FC36..FC3E: Table: sprite 7 rise offsets ;;;
{
;; Signed Y offsets for the three puffs, 16 animation steps.
$04:FC36              .db $FF,$FF,$FE,$FD,$FD,$FC,$FB,$FB ; Sprite 7: Y offsets (rising), steps 0-7
$04:FC3E              .db $FA,$F9,$F9,$F8,$F7,$F7,$F6,$F5 ; Sprite 7: Y offsets (rising), steps 8-15

}

;;; $FC46: Overworld sprites 7 and 8 ;;;
{
;; Sprite 7: fixed position per submap (0 or 1), three small 8x8 tiles ($28/$5F flicker) rising and wobbling,
;;     animation phase [$0DF5] advances every 16 frames. Probably chimney smoke.
;; Sprite 8 ($FCE1, label 'Bowser's sign' in the source): four 8x8 tiles $6C-$6F in a row going left,
;;     palette cycling 0-3 with the frame counter.
$04:FC46 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; \
$04:FC49 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FC4A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FC4B A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$0DD6] / 4: player index
$04:FC4C B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; \
$04:FC4F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:FC50 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = submap of that player * 2
$04:FC51 B9 1E FC     LDA.W $FC1E,Y                   ; \
$04:FC54 9D 35 0E     STA.W $0E35,X                   ; / X position low = $FC1E[Y]
$04:FC57 B9 1F FC     LDA.W $FC1F,Y                   ; \
$04:FC5A 9D 65 0E     STA.W $0E65,X                   ; / X position high
$04:FC5D B9 22 FC     LDA.W $FC22,Y                   ; \
$04:FC60 9D 45 0E     STA.W $0E45,X                   ; / Y position low
$04:FC63 B9 23 FC     LDA.W $FC23,Y                   ; \
$04:FC66 9D 75 0E     STA.W $0E75,X                   ; / Y position high
$04:FC69 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:FC6B 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$04:FC6D D0 0D        BNE $FC7C                       ; / Only every 16th frame advance the animation
$04:FC6F BD F5 0D     LDA.W $0DF5,X                   ; \
$04:FC72 1A           INC A                           ; |
$04:FC73 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; |
$04:FC75 90 02        BCC $FC79                       ; |
$04:FC77 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$04:FC79 9D F5 0D     STA.W $0DF5,X                   ; / [$0DF5+X] = ([$0DF5+X] + 1) wrapped at 12: animation phase
$04:FC7C A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$04:FC7E 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = 3: number of puffs
$04:FC80 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:FC82 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = [$13]: counter for the size flicker
$04:FC84 64 07        STZ $07                         ; [$07] = 0: accumulated Y offset
$04:FC86 BC 43 F8     LDY.W $F843,X                   ; Y = OAM offset of this slot ($F843)
$04:FC89 BD F5 0D     LDA.W $0DF5,X                   ; \
$04:FC8C AA           TAX                             ; / X = [$0DF5+X]: animation index
$04:FC8D 5A           PHY                             ; \
$04:FC8E DA           PHX                             ; / Save the OAM offset and the animation index
$04:FC8F AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = [$0DDE]: current sprite slot
$04:FC92 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position
$04:FC95 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the animation index into X
$04:FC96 A5 07        LDA $07                         ; \
$04:FC98 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FC99 7D 36 FC     ADC.W $FC36,X                   ; |
$04:FC9C 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FC9D 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$04:FC9F 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$04:FCA1 B0 02        BCS $FCA5                       ; |
$04:FCA3 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; / [$02]/[$03] += [$07] + $FC36[X] (puff rises)
$04:FCA5 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:FCA7 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FCA8 7D 26 FC     ADC.W $FC26,X                   ; |
$04:FCAB 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$04:FCAD 90 02        BCC $FCB1                       ; |
$04:FCAF E6 01        INC $01                         ; / [$00]/[$01] += $FC26[X] (puff wobbles)
$04:FCB1 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FCB2 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FCB3 69 0C        ADC.B #$0C                      ; |
$04:FCB5 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; |
$04:FCB7 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$04:FCB9 AA           TAX                             ; / X = (X + 12) AND $0F: animation index of the next puff (carry = wrapped)
$04:FCBA 90 06        BCC $FCC2                       ; \
$04:FCBC A5 07        LDA $07                         ; |
$04:FCBE E9 0C        SBC.B #$0C                      ; |
$04:FCC0 85 07        STA $07                         ; / Wrapped: [$07] -= $0C (later puffs sit higher)
$04:FCC2 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$04:FCC4 EB           XBA                             ; |
$04:FCC5 A0 28        LDY.B #$28                      ; / B = properties $30; Y = tile $28 (small puff)
$04:FCC7 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; \
$04:FCC9 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FCCA 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; |
$04:FCCC 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] += $0A
$04:FCCE 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; \
$04:FCD0 F0 02        BEQ $FCD4                       ; |
$04:FCD2 A0 5F        LDY.B #$5F                      ; / Tile $5F instead when bit 5 of [$06] is set (flicker)
$04:FCD4 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:FCD5 7A           PLY                             ; / A = tile, Y = OAM offset again
$04:FCD6 20 ED FA     JSR.W $FAED                     ; Draw an 8x8 tile (carry clear) at OAM offset Y; Y -= 4
$04:FCD9 C6 04        DEC $04                         ; \
$04:FCDB D0 B0        BNE $FC8D                       ; / Next puff (3 in total)
$04:FCDD AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = [$0DDE]: current sprite slot
$04:FCE0 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Bowser's sign code starts here.
$04:FCE1 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position
$04:FCE4 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$04:FCE6 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = 4: number of tiles in Bowser's sign
$04:FCE8 A9 6F        LDA.B #$6F                      ; \
$04:FCEA 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = $6F: tile number of the rightmost tile
$04:FCEC BC 43 F8     LDY.W $F843,X                   ; Y = OAM offset of this slot ($F843)
$04:FCEF A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$04:FCF1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FCF2 29 06        AND.B #$06                      ; |
$04:FCF4 09 30        ORA.B #$30                      ; |
$04:FCF6 EB           XBA                             ; / B = properties $30 + (([$13] / 2) AND 6): cycles palette 0-3 (flashing)
$04:FCF7 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$04:FCF9 20 ED FA     JSR.W $FAED                     ; / A = tile [$05]; draw 8x8 via $FAED
$04:FCFC A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:FCFE 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:FCFF E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$04:FD01 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] -= 8: next tile to the left
$04:FD03 C6 05        DEC $05                         ; Tile number--
$04:FD05 C6 04        DEC $04                         ; \
$04:FD07 D0 E6        BNE $FCEF                       ; / Tiles left--; loop until all 4 are drawn
$04:FD09 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $FD0A..FD18: Table: masks and steps for sprites 9, 10 ;;;
{
;; Timer masks for sprite 10 and the +1/-1 speed step pairs used by sprites 9 and 10.
$04:FD0A              .db $07,$07,$03,$03,$5F,$5F     ; Sprite 10: masks ANDed with its timer (indexed [$0DF5] OR 4; exact use unclear)

$04:FD10              .db $01,$FF,$01,$FF,$01,$FF,$01,$FF ; Sprites 9 and 10: speed steps, +1/-1 pairs
$04:FD18              .db $01,$FF                     ; Sprites 9 and 10: speed steps, last pair

}

;;; $FD1A..FD22: Table: speed limits for sprites 9, 10 ;;;
{
;; Speed limit pairs (+/-) for sprites 9 and 10.
$04:FD1A              .db $18,$E8,$0A,$F6,$08,$F8,$03,$FD ; Sprites 9 and 10: speed limits, +/- pairs ($18, $0A, $08, $03, $01)
$04:FD22              .db $01,$FF                     ; Sprites 9 and 10: speed limits, last pair

}

;;; $FD24: Overworld sprites 9 and 10: drifting movement ;;;
{
;; Main routines for overworld sprite types 9 ($04FD24) and 10 ($04FD70) in the OWSprites pointer table.
;;     Neither is named here (purpose unclear).
;; Each applies speed to position, draws one tile with X flip following X speed, then makes each speed swing
;;     between +/- limits:
;; every axis adds +1/-1 per step ($FD10) and reverses at the limit in $FD1A. Type 9 steps every
;;     second frame.
;; Type 10 steps X, Y and Z at different rates via masks $FD0A against a phase counter [$0E25], and is
;;     hidden (Y position forced off-screen) on some submaps.
;; Parameters: X = sprite slot [$0DDE]. Speed at [$0E95+$10*axis,X], direction index at [$0DF5+$10*axis,X].
$04:FD24 20 90 FE     JSR.W $FE90                     ; Move by speed ($FE90)
$04:FD27 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; \
$04:FD2A 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; / Screen X in [$00], screen Y (minus height) in [$02]; done twice, redundant
$04:FD2D A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Property = $00 (no flip)
$04:FD2F BC 95 0E     LDY.W $0E95,X                   ; Y = X speed (sets N flag)
$04:FD32 30 02        BMI $FD36                       ; Moving left: no flip
$04:FD34 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; Moving right: property = $40 (X flip)
$04:FD36 EB           XBA                             ; Property into B
$04:FD37 A9 68        LDA.B #$68                      ; A = tile $68
$04:FD39 20 06 FB     JSR.W $FB06                     ; Write tile and position to OAM ($FB06)
$04:FD3C FE 15 0E     INC.W $0E15,X                   ; Animation counter [$0E15,X]++
$04:FD3F BD 15 0E     LDA.W $0E15,X                   ; A = counter
$04:FD42 4A           LSR                             ; Counter bit 0 into carry
$04:FD43 B0 2A        BCS $FD6F                       ; Odd counts: return (speeds change every other frame)
$04:FD45 BD 05 0E     LDA.W $0E05,X                   ; A = Y-axis direction index [$0E05,X]
$04:FD48 09 02        ORA.B #$02                      ; OR 2: use the second step/limit pair
$04:FD4A A8           TAY                             ; Y = table index
$04:FD4B 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FD4C 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } X += $10: Y-axis slot (carry is clear)
$04:FD4E AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:FD4F 20 55 FD     JSR.W $FD55                     ; Step the Y-axis speed ($FD55)
$04:FD52 BC F5 0D     LDY.W $0DF5,X                   ; Y = X-axis direction index [$0DF5,X]; falls into the X-axis step
$04:FD55 BD 95 0E     LDA.W $0E95,X                   ; A = speed [$0E95,X]
$04:FD58 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:FD59 79 10 FD     ADC.W $FD10,Y                   ; Speed += $FD10[Y] (+1 or -1)
$04:FD5C 9D 95 0E     STA.W $0E95,X                   ; Store new speed
$04:FD5F D9 1A FD     CMP.W $FD1A,Y                   ; Reached the limit $FD1A[Y]?
$04:FD62 D0 04        BNE $FD68                       ; No: keep direction
$04:FD64 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:FD65 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$04:FD67 A8           TAY                             ; } Y ^= 1: reverse direction (accelerate the other way)
$04:FD68 98           TYA                             ; \
$04:FD69 9D F5 0D     STA.W $0DF5,X                   ; / Save direction index in [$0DF5,X]
$04:FD6C AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = sprite slot [$0DDE]
$04:FD6F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FD70 20 90 FE     JSR.W $FE90                     ; Move by speed ($FE90)
$04:FD73 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; \
$04:FD76 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; / Screen X in [$00], screen Y (minus height) in [$02]; done twice, redundant
$04:FD79 AC B3 0D     LDY.W $0DB3                     ; Y = [$0DB3] (player index)
$04:FD7C B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; A = [$1F11,Y] (probably the player's current submap)
$04:FD7F F0 24        BEQ $FDA5                       ; Main map (0): no position offset
$04:FD81 E0 0F        CPX.B #$0F                      ; Slot $0F?
$04:FD83 D0 09        BNE $FD8E                       ; No: apply offset
$04:FD85 AD 07 1F     LDA.W $1F07                     ; A = [$1F07] (probably level-beaten flags)
$04:FD88 29 12        AND.B #$12                      ; Test bits $12
$04:FD8A D0 02        BNE $FD8E                       ; Either set: apply offset
$04:FD8C 86 03        STX $03                         ; Neither set: [$03] = X (non-zero) hides the sprite
$04:FD8E 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FD8F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:FD90 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = X * 2: word table index
$04:FD91 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:FD93 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = screen X [$00]
$04:FD95 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:FD96 79 4C F6     ADC.W $F64C,Y                   ; / + $F64C[Y]: per-slot X offset
$04:FD99 85 00        STA $00                         ; Store screen X
$04:FD9B A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = screen Y [$02]
$04:FD9D 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:FD9E 79 52 F6     ADC.W $F652,Y                   ; / + $F652[Y]: per-slot Y offset
$04:FDA1 85 02        STA $02                         ; Store screen Y
$04:FDA3 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:FDA5 A9 34        LDA.B #$34                      ; Property = $34
$04:FDA7 BC 95 0E     LDY.W $0E95,X                   ; Y = X speed (sets N flag)
$04:FDAA 30 02        BMI $FDAE                       ; Moving left: keep $34
$04:FDAC A9 44        LDA.B #$44                      ; Moving right: property = $44 (X flip)
$04:FDAE EB           XBA                             ; Property into B
$04:FDAF A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; A = tile $60
$04:FDB1 20 06 FB     JSR.W $FB06                     ; Write tile and position to OAM ($FB06)
$04:FDB4 BD 25 0E     LDA.W $0E25,X                   ; A = phase counter [$0E25,X]
$04:FDB7 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = counter; masks the acceleration steps below
$04:FDB9 FE 25 0E     INC.W $0E25,X                   ; Phase counter++
$04:FDBC 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FDBD 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FDBE 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; } X += $20: Z-axis slot
$04:FDC0 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:FDC1 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8: timing table index base for Z
$04:FDC3 20 D2 FD     JSR.W $FDD2                     ; Step the Z-axis speed if the timing mask allows
$04:FDC6 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FDC7 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FDC8 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } X += $10: Y-axis slot
$04:FDCA AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:FDCB A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; A = 6: timing table index base for Y
$04:FDCD 20 D2 FD     JSR.W $FDD2                     ; Step the Y-axis speed if the timing mask allows
$04:FDD0 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: timing base for X; falls through with X = sprite slot
$04:FDD2 1D F5 0D     ORA.W $0DF5,X                   ; A |= direction index [$0DF5,X]
$04:FDD5 A8           TAY                             ; Y = table index
$04:FDD6 B9 06 FD     LDA.W ADDR_04FD06,Y             ; A = timing mask ($07 X, $03 Y, $5F Z) from $FD0A
$04:FDD9 25 00        AND $00                         ; AND the phase counter [$00]
$04:FDDB D0 8B        BNE $FD68                       ; Non-zero: skip this step, just save direction ($FD68)
$04:FDDD 4C 55 FD     JMP.W $FD55                     ; Zero: step the speed ($FD55)


}

;;; $FDE0..FDE8: Table: X offset of first tile by height ;;;
{
$04:FDE0              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$02,$02,$02 ; $00-$07: small sprite, indexed by height / 16
$04:FDE8              .db $00,$00,$01,$01,$02,$02,$03,$03 ; $08-$0F: large sprite
}

;;; $FDF0..FDF8: Table: X offset of second tile by height ;;;
{
$04:FDF0              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$07,$06,$05,$05 ; $00-$07: small sprite, indexed by height / 16
$04:FDF8              .db $00,$00,$0E,$0E,$0C,$0C,$0A,$0A ; $08-$0F: large sprite

}

;;; $FE00: Overworld sprite helpers: draw, move, home in ;;;
{
;; $04FE00: draws a two-tile mirrored sprite whose tile size and X spacing depend on the Z height. Carry on
;;     entry = 16x16 flag.
;; $04FE4E: [$02] += Z height. $04FE5B: A = [$13] + $F833[X]. $04FE62: screen X in [$00], screen Y minus
;;     height in [$02].
;; $04FE90: apply X/Y/Z speeds to positions (Z clamped at 0). $04FEAB: one axis, speed in 1/16 pixel per
;;     frame, fraction in [$0EC5,X].
;; $04FED7: sets [$0EF7] = slot if the sprite is within 8 pixels of the player's map position. $04FEEF: dx,
;;     dy, |dx|, |dy| to the player.
;; $04FF2E: sets X/Y/Z speed to head toward the player (longest axis $20, others scaled); at the target zeroes
;;     speeds and Z height = $40.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:F8D0: Overworld sprite 1: hovering creature
;;     $04:F9B9: Overworld sprite 2: chases Mario's X
$04:FE00 66 04        ROR $04                         ; Carry from caller into bit 7 of [$04]: 1 = 16x16 size
$04:FE02 20 62 FE     JSR.W $FE62                     ; Screen position in [$00]/[$02] ($FE62)
$04:FE05 20 4E FE     JSR.W $FE4E                     ; Add height back to [$02]: ground-level Y ($FE4E)
$04:FE08 BD 55 0E     LDA.W $0E55,X                   ; A = Z height [$0E55,X]
$04:FE0B 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:FE0C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FE0D 4A           LSR                             ; } A = height / 16
$04:FE0E 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:FE0F A0 29        LDY.B #$29                      ; Y = $29: tile for the small version
$04:FE11 24 04        BIT $04                         ; Test bit 7 of [$04] (size flag)
$04:FE13 10 05        BPL $FE1A                       ; Clear: keep small tile
$04:FE15 A0 2E        LDY.B #$2E                      ; Y = $2E: tile for the large version
$04:FE17 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:FE18 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; / A += 8: use the large half of the offset tables
$04:FE1A 84 05        STY $05                         ; [$05] = tile number
$04:FE1C A8           TAY                             ; Y = table index
$04:FE1D 84 06        STY $06                         ; [$06] = table index (kept for the second tile)
$04:FE1F A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = screen X [$00]
$04:FE21 18           CLC                             ; \
$04:FE22 79 E0 FD     ADC.W $FDE0,Y                   ; / + $FDE0[Y]: offset of first tile
$04:FE25 85 00        STA $00                         ; Store screen X
$04:FE27 90 02        BCC $FE2B                       ; No carry: skip
$04:FE29 E6 01        INC $01                         ; Carry: [$01]++ (X high byte)
$04:FE2B A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; A = $32: property (priority 3, palette 1)
$04:FE2D BC 43 F8     LDY.W $F843,X                   ; Y = OAM slot offset $F843[X]
$04:FE30 20 45 FE     JSR.W $FE45                     ; Draw first tile ($FE45)
$04:FE33 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y (OAM index, already moved to the next slot)
$04:FE34 A4 06        LDY $06                         ; Y = saved table index [$06]
$04:FE36 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$04:FE38 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FE39 79 F0 FD     ADC.W $FDF0,Y                   ; } Screen X += $FDF0[Y]: offset of second tile
$04:FE3C 85 00        STA $00                         ; Store screen X
$04:FE3E 90 02        BCC $FE42                       ; No carry: skip
$04:FE40 E6 01        INC $01                         ; Carry: [$01]++ (X high byte)
$04:FE42 A9 72        LDA.B #$72                      ; A = $72: property, X-flipped mirror of first tile
$04:FE44 7A           PLY                             ; Y = OAM slot for the second tile
$04:FE45 EB           XBA                             ; Property into B
$04:FE46 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; A = [$04]
$04:FE48 0A           ASL                             ; ASL: carry = bit 7 (16x16 size flag)
$04:FE49 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; A = tile number [$05]
$04:FE4B 4C 0A FB     JMP.W $FB0A                     ; Write tile, property, position and size bit to OAM ($FB0A)

$04:FE4E A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = screen Y low [$02]
$04:FE50 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:FE51 7D 55 0E     ADC.W $0E55,X                   ; + Z height [$0E55,X]
$04:FE54 85 02        STA $02                         ; Store screen Y
$04:FE56 90 02        BCC $FE5A                       ; No carry: skip
$04:FE58 E6 03        INC $03                         ; Carry: [$03]++
$04:FE5A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FE5B A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter [$13]
$04:FE5D 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:FE5E 7D 33 F8     ADC.W $F833,X                   ; + per-slot offset $F833[X] (staggers animation)
$04:FE61 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FE62 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FE63 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FE64 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } X += $10: Y-axis slot
$04:FE66 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:FE67 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: index of the screen Y scroll
$04:FE69 20 7D FE     JSR.W $FE7D                     ; [$02] = Y position - screen Y scroll ($FE7D)
$04:FE6C AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = sprite slot [$0DDE]
$04:FE6F A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = screen Y [$02]
$04:FE71 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$04:FE72 FD 55 0E     SBC.W $0E55,X                   ; - Z height [$0E55,X]
$04:FE75 85 02        STA $02                         ; Store screen Y
$04:FE77 B0 02        BCS $FE7B                       ; No borrow: skip
$04:FE79 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; Borrow: [$03]--
$04:FE7B A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: index of the screen X scroll
$04:FE7D BD 65 0E     LDA.W $0E65,X                   ; A = position high byte [$0E65,X]
$04:FE80 EB           XBA                             ; Into B
$04:FE81 BD 35 0E     LDA.W $0E35,X                   ; A = position low byte [$0E35,X]
$04:FE84 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:FE86 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$04:FE87 F9 1A 00     SBC.W RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,Y      ; - screen scroll ([$1A] for Y = 0, [$1C] for Y = 2)
$04:FE8A 99 00 00     STA.W $0000,Y                   ; Store screen-relative position in [$00,Y]
$04:FE8D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:FE8F 60           RTS                             ; Return
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Modify the overworld sprite slot index to handle XYZ speed.
;
;SpriteSlotIndex+($10*Type)
;where:
;Type = 0: X speed
;Type = 1: Y speed
;Type = 2: Z speed
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
$04:FE90 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FE91 18           CLC                             ; |
$04:FE92 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; } X += $20: Z-axis slot
$04:FE94 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:FE95 20 AB FE     JSR.W $FEAB                     ; Move Z position by Z speed ($FEAB)
$04:FE98 BD 35 0E     LDA.W $0E35,X                   ; A = Z position low [$0E55,X]
$04:FE9B 10 03        BPL $FEA0                       ; Not negative: keep
$04:FE9D 9E 35 0E     STZ.W $0E35,X                   ; Below ground: Z position = 0
$04:FEA0 8A           TXA                             ; \
$04:FEA1 38           SEC                             ; |
$04:FEA2 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; } X -= $10: Y-axis slot
$04:FEA4 AA           TAX                             ; /
$04:FEA5 20 AB FE     JSR.W $FEAB                     ; Move Y position by Y speed
$04:FEA8 AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = sprite slot: fall into the X-axis update
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Update overworld sprite XYZ position by speed. This is similar to Player's
;version at $00DC4F, and even more similar to $01ABD8 (SubSprYPosNoGrvty).
;
;There are 16 ($10) slots, numbered from $00-$0F (00-15) for overworld
;sprites, and we have 3 axis to handle, so indexes as follows.
;If X index is:
;$00-$0F (00-15; SpriteSlotIndex + $00): Handle X speed
;$10-$1F (16-31; SpriteSlotIndex + $10): Handle Y speed
;$20-$2F (32-47; SpriteSlotIndex + $20): Handle Z speed
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
$04:FEAB BD 95 0E     LDA.W $0E95,X                   ; A = speed [$0E95,X] (1/16 pixel per frame)
$04:FEAE 0A           ASL                             ; \
$04:FEAF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$04:FEB0 0A           ASL                             ; } A = speed * 16 (fraction part)
$04:FEB1 0A           ASL                             ; /
$04:FEB2 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:FEB3 7D C5 0E     ADC.W $0EC5,X                   ; Add to sub-pixel fraction [$0EC5,X]
$04:FEB6 9D C5 0E     STA.W $0EC5,X                   ; Store; carry = one extra pixel
$04:FEB9 BD 95 0E     LDA.W $0E95,X                   ; A = speed
$04:FEBC 08           PHP                             ; Save flags (carry, N = speed sign)
$04:FEBD 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:FEBE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$04:FEBF 4A           LSR                             ; } A = speed / 16 (whole pixels)
$04:FEC0 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:FEC1 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte of the movement
$04:FEC3 28           PLP                             ; Restore flags
$04:FEC4 10 03        BPL $FEC9                       ; Speed positive: skip
$04:FEC6 09 F0        ORA.B #$F0                      ; Negative: sign-extend A
$04:FEC8 88           DEY                             ; Y = $FF: high byte of the movement
$04:FEC9 7D 35 0E     ADC.W $0E35,X                   ; Position low += pixels + carry
$04:FECC 9D 35 0E     STA.W $0E35,X                   ; Store
$04:FECF 98           TYA                             ; A = high byte of the movement
$04:FED0 7D 65 0E     ADC.W $0E65,X                   ; Position high += high byte + carry
$04:FED3 9D 65 0E     STA.W $0E65,X                   ; Store
$04:FED6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FED7 20 EF FE     JSR.W $FEEF                     ; Get distances to the player ($FEEF)
$04:FEDA A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = |dx| [$06]
$04:FEDC C9 08 00     CMP.W #$0008                    ; Within 8 pixels?
$04:FEDF B0 05        BCS $FEE6                       ; No: not touching
$04:FEE1 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; A = |dy| [$08]
$04:FEE3 C9 08 00     CMP.W #$0008                    ; Within 8 pixels?
$04:FEE6 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit; carry set = not touching
$04:FEE8 8A           TXA                             ; A = sprite slot
$04:FEE9 B0 03        BCS $FEEE                       ; Not touching: return
$04:FEEB 8D F7 0E     STA.W $0EF7                     ; [$0EF7] = slot of the sprite the player is touching
$04:FEEE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FEEF BD 65 0E     LDA.W $0E65,X                   ; A = X position high byte [$0E65,X]
$04:FEF2 EB           XBA                             ; Into B
$04:FEF3 BD 35 0E     LDA.W $0E35,X                   ; A = X position low byte [$0E35,X]
$04:FEF6 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:FEF8 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:FEF9 69 08 00     ADC.W #$0008                    ; + 8: sprite center
$04:FEFC AC D6 0D     LDY.W $0DD6                     ; Y = [$0DD6] (player index)
$04:FEFF 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$04:FF00 F9 17 1F     SBC.W $1F17,Y                   ; - player map X [$1F17,Y]
$04:FF03 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = dx
$04:FF05 10 04        BPL $FF0B                       ; Positive: skip
$04:FF07 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$04:FF0A 1A           INC A                           ; / A = -A (negate)
$04:FF0B 85 06        STA $06                         ; [$06] = |dx|
$04:FF0D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:FF0F BD 75 0E     LDA.W $0E75,X                   ; A = Y position high byte [$0E75,X]
$04:FF12 EB           XBA                             ; Into B
$04:FF13 BD 45 0E     LDA.W $0E45,X                   ; A = Y position low byte [$0E45,X]
$04:FF16 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:FF18 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$04:FF19 69 08 00     ADC.W #$0008                    ; + 8: sprite center
$04:FF1C AC D6 0D     LDY.W $0DD6                     ; Y = [$0DD6] (player index)
$04:FF1F 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$04:FF20 F9 19 1F     SBC.W $1F19,Y                   ; - player map Y [$1F19,Y]
$04:FF23 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = dy
$04:FF25 10 04        BPL $FF2B                       ; Positive: skip
$04:FF27 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$04:FF2A 1A           INC A                           ; / A = -A (negate)
$04:FF2B 85 08        STA $08                         ; [$08] = |dy|
$04:FF2D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FF2E 20 EF FE     JSR.W $FEEF                     ; Get dx, dy, |dx|, |dy| ($FEEF)
$04:FF31 46 06        LSR $06                         ; [$06] = |dx| / 2
$04:FF33 46 08        LSR $08                         ; [$08] = |dy| / 2
$04:FF35 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:FF37 BD 55 0E     LDA.W $0E55,X                   ; A = Z height [$0E55,X]
$04:FF3A 4A           LSR                             ; Height / 2
$04:FF3B 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; [$0A] = height / 2
$04:FF3D 64 05        STZ $05                         ; [$05] = 0: Z delta positive (so Z speed ends up negative)
$04:FF3F A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4: assume Z is the longest distance
$04:FF41 C5 08        CMP $08                         ; height / 2 >= |dy| / 2?
$04:FF43 B0 04        BCS $FF49                       ; Yes: keep Y = 4
$04:FF45 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: Y is longer
$04:FF47 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; A = |dy| / 2
$04:FF49 C5 06        CMP $06                         ; >= |dx| / 2?
$04:FF4B B0 04        BCS $FF51                       ; Yes: keep
$04:FF4D A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: X is the longest
$04:FF4F A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = |dx| / 2
$04:FF51 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Longest distance >= 1?
$04:FF53 B0 12        BCS $FF67                       ; Yes: head for the player
$04:FF55 9E 15 0E     STZ.W $0E15,X                   ; Arrived: clear animation counter [$0E15,X]
$04:FF58 9E 95 0E     STZ.W $0E95,X                   ; X speed = 0
$04:FF5B 9E A5 0E     STZ.W $0EA5,X                   ; Y speed = 0
$04:FF5E 9E B5 0E     STZ.W $0EB5,X                   ; Z speed = 0
$04:FF61 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; A = $40
$04:FF63 9D 55 0E     STA.W $0E55,X                   ; Z height = $40
$04:FF66 60           RTS                             ; Return

$04:FF67 84 0C        STY $0C                         ; [$0C] = index of the longest axis
$04:FF69 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: start with Z
$04:FF6B E4 0C        CPX $0C                         ; This the longest axis?
$04:FF6D D0 04        BNE $FF73                       ; No: scale its speed
$04:FF6F A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; Longest axis: speed magnitude = $20 (maximum)
$04:FF71 80 1E        BRA $FF91                       ; Go apply the sign

$04:FF73 9C 04 42     STZ.W $4204                     ; Dividend low byte = 0
$04:FF76 B5 06        LDA $06,X                       ; Dividend high byte = this axis distance [$06,X]
$04:FF78 8D 05 42     STA.W $4205                     ; Store in $4205
$04:FF7B B9 06 00     LDA.W $0006,Y                   ; A = longest distance
$04:FF7E 8D 06 42     STA.W $4206                     ; Divisor = longest distance
$04:FF81 EA           NOP                             ; \
$04:FF82 EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:FF83 EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:FF84 EA           NOP                             ; } Wait for the hardware divide to finish
$04:FF85 EA           NOP                             ; |
$04:FF86 EA           NOP                             ; /
$04:FF87 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$04:FF89 AD 14 42     LDA.W $4214                     ; A = quotient (distance * 256 / longest distance)
$04:FF8C 4A           LSR                             ; \
$04:FF8D 4A           LSR                             ; } A = quotient / 8: speed proportional to distance (max $20)
$04:FF8E 4A           LSR                             ; /
$04:FF8F E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$04:FF91 34 01        BIT $01,X                       ; Test sign of delta (high byte at [$01,X])
$04:FF93 30 03        BMI $FF98                       ; Negative delta: speed stays positive
$04:FF95 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$04:FF97 1A           INC A                           ; / Positive delta: negate (move toward the player)
$04:FF98 95 00        STA $00,X                       ; Store speed in [$00,X] ($00 X, $02 Y, $04 Z)
$04:FF9A CA           DEX                             ; \
$04:FF9B CA           DEX                             ; / X -= 2: next axis
$04:FF9C 10 CD        BPL $FF6B                       ; Loop for X = 4, 2, 0
$04:FF9E AE DE 0D     LDX.W $0DDE                     ; X = sprite slot [$0DDE]
$04:FFA1 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = X speed
$04:FFA3 9D 95 0E     STA.W $0E95,X                   ; Store [$0E95,X]
$04:FFA6 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = Y speed
$04:FFA8 9D A5 0E     STA.W $0EA5,X                   ; Store [$0EA5,X]
$04:FFAB A5 04        LDA $04                         ; A = Z speed
$04:FFAD 9D B5 0E     STA.W $0EB5,X                   ; Store [$0EB5,X]
$04:FFB0 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $FFB1..FFF9: Freespace padding ;;;
{
$04:FFB1              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFB9              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFC1              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFC9              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFD1              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFD9              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFE1              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFE9              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFF1              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$04:FFF9              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
